title: Production Manager
description:
**Key Responsibilities**

Strong leadership, problem-solving, coordination, and communication skills.

* Proficiency in speaking Malayalam is mandatory.

title: Factory Manager
description:
**ABOUT THE COMPANY**

K P Namboodiri's Ayurvedics (KPNA) is a heritage Ayurvedic products company founded in 1925, headquartered in Thrissur, Kerala. Oral care is its core category, with skin care and hair care as growth areas. The Company is strengthening its manufacturing and functional leadership to support its next phase of growth.

**ROLE OVERVIEW**

The Factory Manager will run KPNA's personal care manufacturing unit at Vadakkekad, Thrissur. The role is accountable for production output, quality, cost, safety and people at the unit. It reports to the DGM, Operations. This is a hands-on role, based at the plant, with close involvement in daily shopfloor work.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**1. Plant Operations**

•   
Run the day-to-day operations of the unit, covering production, maintenance, in-process quality checks and in-plant stores.

•   
Meet the monthly production plan for volume, quality and cost.

•   
Make good use of manpower, machines and materials across shifts.

•   
Keep production records, batch documents and daily reports accurate and up to date.

**2. Production Planning and Coordination**

•   
Prepare weekly and daily production schedules from the plan agreed with the DGM, Operations.

•   
Give material requirements to Supply Chain and Purchase on time, and flag shortages early.

•   
Coordinate with the Central Depot on the transfer of finished goods.

**3. Quality and Compliance**

•   
Make sure every batch is produced as per approved formulas, SOPs and Good Manufacturing Practice.

•   
Work with Quality Control on in-process checks, rejections and customer complaints, and close the root causes.

•   
Keep the plant ready for statutory and licensing inspections, and maintain the records these require.

**4. Maintenance and Hygiene**

•   
Plan and carry out preventive maintenance, and keep breakdowns and downtime low.

•   
Maintain hygiene and housekeeping standards suited to personal care manufacturing.

**5. Safety**

•   
Own workplace safety on the factory floor. This covers safe work practices, use of protective equipment, and reporting and follow-up of incidents.

**6. Cost and Improvement**

•   
Track and reduce wastage, rework and material loss.

•   
Suggest and carry out practical improvements to output, yield and changeover time.

**7. People**

•   
Lead supervisors and workers across shifts. Assign work, set daily targets and review progress.

•   
Assess manpower needs and raise requisitions through the DGM, Operations. HR handles recruitment, statutory welfare compliance and grievances.

•   
Train and develop supervisors to take on more responsibility.

**KEY SUCCESS METRICS**

•   
Adherence to the production plan

•   
Conversion cost per unit

•   
Wastage, rejection and rework levels

•   
First Pass Yield and customer complaints traced to manufacturing

•   
Machine downtime

•   
Safety incidents, and closure of inspection and audit observations

**CANDIDATE PROFILE**

•   
Graduate in engineering, chemistry or pharmacy.

•   
10 to 15 years of manufacturing experience, with recent experience leading production.

•   
Experience in FMCG or related industries is preferred, but is not a pre-requisite for the right candidate.

•   
Working knowledge of Good Manufacturing Practice.

•   
Willing to be based in Thrissur. Knowledge of Malayalam is preferred.

**CAPABILITIES**

•   
Hands-on shopfloor leadership

•   
Production planning and scheduling

•   
Practical problem solving on quality and machine issues

•   
Awareness of cost and wastage

•   
Ability to train and manage a shopfloor team

•   
Clear and regular reporting

**WHY THIS ROLE**

The role offers full charge of an established plant making products for a brand with a century-old heritage. The Factory Manager will have a clear reporting line and defined support from Supply Chain, Quality Control and HR. There is room to grow as KPNA expands its manufacturing.

title: Financial Controller
description:
K P Namboodiri's Ayurvedics (KPNA) is a heritage Ayurvedic and herbal wellness brand with a legacy spanning generations, best known for personal care products and now growing into skin and hair care. As we enter our next phase of growth, we're building institutional strength across the organisation, starting with finance.

We're looking for a Finance Controller to build a structured, data-driven finance function from the ground up. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role reporting to the Finance Head, and it sits at the center of how KPNA makes decisions on cost, pricing, and growth.

**WHAT YOU'LL OWN**

**Financial Closing and MIS**

–  Set up and run a disciplined monthly closing process

–  Standardise reporting so leadership gets consistent, timely visibility into revenue, cost, and profitability

**Costing and Profitability**

–  Build SKU-level costing frameworks and standard costing models

–  Drive variance analysis and profitability insights by product and channel

–  Support pricing and margin decisions with real numbers, not estimates

**Inventory and Working Capital**

–  Strengthen inventory tracking, reconciliation, and ageing analysis

–  Improve control and visibility over working capital

**Finance Operations and Controls**

–  Own the accuracy and integrity of day-to-day financial records

–  Build the processes and controls that don't exist yet, not just maintain the ones that do

**Business Partnering**

–  Work directly with sales, marketing, manufacturing, and supply chain to turn numbers into decisions

–  Support the Finance Head in business reviews and planning

**Team Building**

–  Recruit, train, and grow the finance team as the function scales

–  Build capability and a culture of discipline and ownership within the team

**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR**

–  8 to 14 years in finance, ideally in manufacturing or FMCG

–  Strong background in financial reporting, costing, and operational finance

–  Comfortable with financial modelling and finance systems

–  CA or CMA preferred, not mandatory for the right candidate

–  Malayalam or Tamil speaking

**WHY THIS ROLE**

This isn't a maintenance job. KPNA is at a stage where the finance function is being built, not just run, and this role shapes what it becomes. If you want ownership over systems and decision-support rather than routine reporting, this is that role.

**LOCATION**

Thrissur, Kerala (on-site)

description:

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Oracle Fusion Program / Project Manager - Manager**
**(Oracle Fusion Implementation, OUM, Agile & Program Governance)**
**Summary:**
We are seeking an experienced Oracle Fusion Program / Project Manager at Manager level with proven, hands-on experience leading end-to-end Oracle Fusion Cloud implementation projects across ERP, SCM, HCM, EPM, or related workstreams. The ideal candidate will be well versed in Oracle Unified Method (OUM), Application Implementation Methodology (AIM), Testing and Change Management (TCM), Agile and hybrid delivery models, and the complete project lifecycle. The role requires strong ownership of program governance, integrated planning, financial and resource management, RAID and dependency management, executive status reporting, and client discussions from mobilization through go-live and Hypercare.
  
  
**Primary Responsibilities and Accountabilities:**

* Lead end-to-end Oracle Fusion Cloud implementation programs from mobilisation, discovery, design, configuration, build, testing, deployment, go-live, Hypercare, and transition to support.
* Create and manage integrated program plans covering scope, milestones, workstreams, critical paths, dependencies, resources, budgets, environments, deliverables, and release schedules.
* Apply and tailor OUM, AIM, TCM, Agile, Waterfall, and hybrid delivery approaches based on project complexity, contractual commitments, and client governance requirements.
* Establish program governance, decision rights, escalation paths, stage gates, quality controls, meeting cadence, and reporting standards across functional and technical workstreams.
* Own RAID management by identifying, assessing, assigning, tracking, mitigating, escalating, and closing risks, assumptions, issues, and dependencies with clear owners and due dates.
* Prepare and present weekly and monthly status reports, executive dashboards, steering committee packs, milestone health, effort and budget variance, resource outlook, decision logs, and recovery plans.
* Lead client workshops, governance meetings, scope and design discussions, status reviews, risk escalations, steering committees, and executive communications, driving timely decisions and stakeholder alignment.
* Manage scope, schedule, cost, quality, resources, change requests, contracts, and deliverable acceptance while protecting project outcomes and commercial commitments.
* Coordinate solution design, configuration, integrations, data migration, reporting, security, testing, change management, training, cutover, and business readiness across all workstreams.
* Drive fit-to-standard adoption, design governance, traceability, deliverable quality, defect closure, cutover rehearsals, go-live criteria, and production stabilisation.
* Prepare, baseline, maintain, and control Microsoft Project Plan (MPP) schedules, including work breakdown structures, task dependencies, milestones, critical paths, resource assignments, progress updates, schedule variance, forecasting, and management reporting.
* Manage system integrators, Oracle, third-party vendors, internal teams, and client stakeholders, ensuring accountability for scope, timelines, service levels, and quality.

**Job Requirements:**

* Minimum 10 years of overall experience, including at least 5 years in project or program management and proven hands-on leadership of multiple end-to-end Oracle Fusion Cloud implementations.
* Strong delivery experience across one or more Oracle Fusion domains such as ERP, SCM, HCM, EPM, Procurement, Projects, or cross-pillar transformation programs.
* Thorough knowledge of OUM, AIM, TCM, Agile, Scrum, Waterfall, and hybrid project lifecycles.
* Demonstrated experience establishing governance, PMO controls, steering committees, stage gates, design authority, change control, delivery cadence, and quality assurance.
* Strong command of scope, schedule, budget, effort, forecasting, resource capacity, dependency, critical-path, milestone, and benefits tracking.
* Hands-on expertise in RAID logs, issue resolution, risk mitigation, decision logs, assumptions, actions, change requests, recovery plans, and executive escalation management.
* Experience managing requirements, design, Conference Room Pilots, configuration, integrations, data migration, testing, defect management, security, training, cutover, go-live, Hypercare, and support transition.
* Mandatory real hands-on expertise in Microsoft Project and MPP files, including creating and managing detailed schedules, baselines, dependencies, critical paths, milestones, resources, actuals, remaining work, slippage, variance, and forecasts.
* Ability to generate schedule, milestone, resource, cost, and executive status reports directly from MPP and explain schedule health, delays, impacts, and recovery actions to senior stakeholders.

Enhance forecasting, valuation, and analytics capabilities by documenting business requirements, conducting analytical testing, strengthening controls, and supporting new investment strategies.

Incumbent is responsible for managing issues related to Fund Transfer, Bank statements, static data maintenance and user access in TRAX (Payment Hub), Quantum (Treasury Management tools) and eBAM(Bank account management) applications. The role will also require supporting issues or queries from end users and onboarding New Bank/Country/Payments into TRAX (Payment Hub). This role will also require supporting system deployments and upgrades. Performs treasury technology services in the most cost effective and high-quality way possible to customers.
  
  
This is an exciting opportunity to play a key role within the Treasury team and support the Treasury Technology Center of Excellence.
  
  
The preference for this role is to be based out of
**Bangalore-Shared Services**
****What You Will Do****
**Job Duties/ Responsibilities will include, but are not limited to:**

* Maintaining Static Data in FIS Treasury applications (TRAX/Payment Hub, Quantum and eBAM)
* User access Management in FIS applications (TRAX/Payment Hub, Quantum, eBAM and Bank Portals)
* Support onboarding new Banks or Payment Types into TRAX/Payment Hub
* Support Treasury projects and initiatives (i.e. third-party customer support, SWIFT and bank connectivity projects, ERP connectivity etc.)

* Bank Signer management
* To independently perform Treasury technology functions

* Participate in the improvement ideas and projects

+ Advise employees and entry level finance professionals
+ Generate reports and provide commentary

title: Associate Strategist
description:
At Moody's, we unite the brightest minds to turn today’s risks into tomorrow’s opportunities. We do this by striving to create an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcome to be who they are—with the freedom to exchange ideas, think innovatively, and listen to each other and customers in meaningful ways. Moody’s is transforming how the world sees risk. As a global leader in ratings and integrated risk assessment, we’re advancing AI to move from insight to action—enabling intelligence that not only understands complexity but responds to it. We decode risk to unlock opportunity, helping our clients navigate uncertainty with clarity, speed, and confidence.
  
  
If you are excited about this opportunity but do not meet every single requirement, please apply! You still may be a great fit for this role or other open roles. We are seeking candidates who model our values: invest in every relationship, lead with curiosity, champion diverse perspectives, turn inputs into actions, and uphold trust through integrity.
  
  
**Skills And Competencies**

* 3–5 years of experience in strategy, customer analytics, or business intelligence, ideally within the banking industry
* Strong, hands-on proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint is essential; working knowledge of Power BI, Alteryx, or SQL is a strong plus
* Working knowledge of CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce/ SFDC) for generating reports and building, maintaining, and monitoring dashboards
* Comfortable handling large sets of sparse and multi-source data (quantitative and qualitative); translating raw data into forecasts, ARR/ retention analysis, and portfolio-level insight that supports business decisions
* Demonstrated analytical thinking — able to identify patterns in data and draw sound business inferences, not simply produce reports
* Curious and self-directed; picks up new tools, datasets, or business questions with minimal handholding. Quick learner
* Comfortable adapting across strategy execution, analytics, and reporting priorities as team needs shift

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Engineering, or a related field required; MBA or postgraduate degree preferred but not required at this level

**Responsibilities**

* Support Banking's Commercial Strategy team with pricing, customer, and portfolio analytics that inform deal-desk decisions and broader strategic initiatives
* Build and maintain customer and market analytics, deal-desk support models, and ARR/ retention dashboards for the Banking business
* Develop forecasting models, segmentation analysis and portfolio-level analysis to support strategic decisions
* Support execution monitoring and process governance cadences for key strategic initiatives, coordinating with senior strategists as needed
* Maintain and evolve data models and automation/ AI-enabled workflows that improve the speed and accuracy of recurring analysis
* Support ongoing initiatives such as the Banking Hub and OKR monitoring with foundational data and reporting
* Translate analysis into clear, decision-ready recommendations for senior strategists — not just status updates
* Adapt across strategy execution and analytics support as priorities shift across the team

**About The Team**
The Banking Commercial Strategy team drives strategic growth across Moody's Banking solutions through deep customer and market analytics. We deliver data-driven insights that inform market led strategy — helping shape Moody's long-term vision for the Banking business
  
  
Our work sits at the center of Moody's efforts to deliver differentiated value to commercial banking clients. By joining us, you will contribute to impactful initiatives spanning strategy formulation, market intelligence, pricing, and customer analytics — while collaborating closely with product, sales, finance, senior leadership, and product/domain and central strategy teams
  
  
Moody’s is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender expression, gender identity or any other characteristic protected by law.
  
  
Candidates for Moody's Corporation may be asked to disclose securities holdings pursuant to Moody’s Policy for Securities Trading and the requirements of the position. Employment is contingent upon compliance with the Policy, including remediation of positions in those holdings as necessary.

title: General Manager- Business Finance
description:
**Location:**
Bangalore

**Way of working:**
In-office, full-time from the Bangalore base location

**Experience:**
7–10 years post-qualification

**About Swiggy Instamart**

Swiggy Instamart is pioneering quick-commerce grocery delivery across India, fulfilling over 30,000 SKUs to consumers in just 10–15 minutes. Dedicated to redefining modern shopping through seamless instant delivery, Instamart currently spans more than 100 Indian cities and maintains a strong trajectory of rapid expansion.

**The Role**

As GM – Business Finance for Instamart, you will be the finance partner to the business leadership team, owning planning, P&L performance, commercials and cost efficiency for a high-growth quick commerce business. The role calls for a strategic, analytical leader who can manage the finances of a fast-scaling business and influence decisions across categories, operations and growth.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Strategic Planning & Forecasting**

• Own long-term strategic planning, quarterly and annual operating plans, budgeting and forecasting for the business.

• Lead planning, execution tracking and delivery for festive and event-led peaks.

**P&L Ownership & Business Partnering**

• Act as a co-pilot to business leaders, owning outcomes and driving decisions amid uncertainty.

• Manage the P&L day to day, using data-driven trend analysis of revenue and P&L metrics to improve the shape of the P&L and surface key insights for leadership.

• Build a deep understanding of Instamart’s consumers, categories and cross-functional levers, including the drivers of revenue and the impact of pricing on growth.

• Set and drive targets with business teams, leading gap analysis and improvement plans.

• Run weekly business and financial reviews, providing data-backed recommendations and ensuring follow-through with business leaders.

**Commercials & Category Partnership**

• Partner with category teams on category development and growth.

• Evaluate and structure commercial proposals for category margins, and lead negotiations.

**Cost Optimisation & Governance**

• Work with operations leaders to eliminate inefficient costs and build processes for a sustainable, steady-state cost structure.

• Design processes for new initiatives and strengthen existing ones, with a focus on governance and plugging cost leakage.

**Working Capital**

• Drive working capital management, including inventory and return per square foot, to improve returns and support top-line growth.

**Reporting, Analytics & Automation**

• Own financial reporting, financial modelling and ad-hoc business analysis built on key business input levers.

• Automate reporting using Business Intelligence tools.

**What We’re Looking For**

• CA or MBA (Finance/Strategy) preferred, with 7–10 years of post-qualification experience.

• Strong grounding in Business Finance/ FP&A, P&L management, financial modelling and commercial negotiations.

• Ability to work with and influence senior, cross-functional stakeholders.

• Self-starter who takes ownership with minimal direction and brings fresh approaches to business problems.

• Continuous-improvement mindset and the ability to learn fast.

• Excellent verbal and written communication.

*We are an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law.*

****Job Description:****

**Principal – ERP Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A)**
**Location:**
Global Capability Center (Offshore)
  
  
**Department:**
Business Technology – Global Capability Center (GCC)
  
  
****Overview****
Client Corporation is seeking an experienced
**Principal – ERP R2R - Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A)**
to join the Global Capability Center (GCC) and provide functional leadership for enterprise planning, budgeting, forecasting, and management reporting solutions supporting global Finance operations, ERP transformation, and mergers & acquisitions.
  
  
This offshore leadership role will serve as the primary SAP R2R - FP&A functional expert within the GCC, partnering closely with Global Finance, Corporate FP&A, Business Technology, Enterprise Architecture, and implementation partners to deliver scalable planning and reporting capabilities across the enterprise.
  
  
The Principal will support the BD integration program and future acquisitions by helping standardize planning processes, financial reporting, and performance management while leveraging SAP S/4HANA, Group Reporting, SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC), and related planning technologies.
  
  
****Key Responsibilities****
**FP&A Solution Leadership**

* Serve as the Global Capability Center functional lead for ERP R2R - Financial Planning & Analysis solutions.
* Partner with Global FP&A, Finance leadership, and Business Process Owners to define and implement future-state planning and performance management processes.
* Drive global standardization of budgeting, forecasting, long-range planning, management reporting, and financial performance analysis.
* Support ERP transformation initiatives and finance process improvements aligned with SAP best practices.
* Recommend scalable planning and reporting solutions that improve forecasting accuracy, reporting efficiency, and decision support.

**SAP Planning & Reporting**
Lead functional design, configuration, and support for enterprise planning solutions including: SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) Planning, SAP S/4HANA Finance integration, Financial Planning and Forecasting, Annual Budgeting, Long-Range Planning, Driver-Based Planning, Profitability and Margin Analysis, Cost Center Planning, Profit Center Planning, Capital Planning, Workforce Planning, Management Reporting, Financial Dashboards and KPI Reporting, SAP Group Reporting integration
  
  
**Financial Data & Analytics**

* Design planning models and reporting structures supporting enterprise performance management.
* Ensure alignment between planning data and SAP S/4HANA Finance actuals.
* Collaborate with Finance teams to define KPIs, reporting hierarchies, planning dimensions, and business drivers.
* Support financial data governance, master data alignment, and planning data integrity.
* Develop standardized reporting and analytics to support executive decision-making.

title: Financial Market Analyst Intern
description:
Job Title: Financial Market Analyst Intern
  
Location: Remote
  
Organization: PipRaisers
  
Stipend: Up to ₹20,000/month (Performance Based)
  
Duration: 2 Months
  
Opportunities: Pre-Placement Offer (PPO) & Letter of Recommendation (LOR)
  
  
About PipRaisers
  
PipRaisers is a market intelligence and proprietary trading research firm that empowers trading talent with robust analytical tools, structured insights, and strategic thinking. We focus on high-impact trading in global markets—spanning currencies, commodities, indices, and digital assets. Our mission is to cultivate sharp market minds through research-backed execution frameworks.
  
  
Role Overview
  
As a Financial Market Analyst Intern at PipRaisers, you will work at the intersection of macro research and market strategy. You will be responsible for decoding market-moving data, identifying trading opportunities, and crafting actionable insights that directly influence trade setups and risk positioning across asset classes.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
1. Conduct macroeconomic and geopolitical research to understand global market trends
  
2. Track and interpret central bank policies, inflation data, and global risk factors
  
3. Analyze key drivers of asset classes like forex, commodities, indices, and crypto
  
4. Support the creation of daily/weekly market commentary, sector outlooks, and research decks
  
5. Combine technical indicators and fundamental narratives to propose trade-worthy ideas
  
6. Align analysis with proprietary strategies and execution goals
  
7. Participate in research calls, idea generation sessions, and post-event briefings
  
  
Who Should Apply?
  
1. Final-year students or graduates in Economics, Finance, or Business Analytics
  
2. Passion for global markets, monetary policy, and cross-asset research
  
3. Proficiency in using charting platforms, data portals, and economic calendars
  
4. Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and written communication
  
5. Bonus: Previous experience with investment research, blogs, trading journals, or macro commentary
  
  
What You’ll Gain
  
1. Real-time exposure to global market analysis and trading desk collaboration
  
2. Training in multi-asset research frameworks and real-world market interpretation
  
3. Stipend of up to ₹20,000/month based on research quality and involvement
  
4. Internship Certificate and Letter of Recommendation (LOR)
  
5. PPO opportunity for outstanding contributors and long-term analysts
  
6. Weekly mentorship from experienced market strategists and trading professionals
  
  
  
Start Date: Immediate preferred

title: Senior Financial Analyst
description:
**Senior Financial Analyst**
**Hybrid, Bangalore or Pune, India**
**JOB OVERVIEW**
Legion is seeking a Senior Financial Analyst to help drive disciplined planning, forecasting and decision support across a growing SaaS business. This role will own assigned forecasts and reporting, build scalable financial models, analyze financial and operating performance, and translate findings into clear recommendations for leaders.
  
  
The successful candidate combines strong FP&A fundamentals with commercial judgment, comfort working with SaaS metrics and systems, and the ability to partner effectively with both finance and non-finance stakeholders.
  
  
**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Assist Financial Planning and Analysis Director in managing the strategic planning, budgeting, and forecasting processes.
* Own designated components of the annual budget, periodic forecasts and long-range plan, including assumptions, scenario analysis and consolidation support.
* Develop and maintain driver-based financial models for revenue, headcount, operating expenses, pricing, investments and strategic initiatives
* Deep understanding of SaaS financial and operational KPIs, a strong ability to analyze data to identify trends, actual performance against budget, forecast, prior periods risks, opportunities for growth. Monitor key KPIs and recommend corrective actions.
* Prepare accurate monthly and quarterly management reporting, dashboards, executive presentations and decision-support materials.
* Investigate revenue, cost, margin, and operational variances and explain key business drivers.
* Partner with business functions to evaluate performance and support commercial decisions.
* Perform profitability, pricing, cost-benefit, ROI, sensitivity and ad hoc analyses to support business cases and investment decisions.
* Support month-end and quarter-end closing activities in coordination with accounting teams by reviewing results, validating data and resolving reporting discrepancies.
* Ensure the accuracy, consistency, integrity of financial data and reports through standardization, automation and effective use of finance systems.
* Maintain appropriate financial controls, documentation and data integrity, and support audit or compliance requests related to assigned work.

**REQUIREMENTS:**

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, or a related field. MBA is required or relevant professional qualification is preferred
* 5+ years of experience in in FP&A, strategic finance, business finance or a closely related analytical finance role in a SaaS, enterprise-software company
* Proficiency with NetSuite required;
* Advanced financial modelling skills, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills.
* Strong knowledge of budgeting, forecasting, financial reporting, and management accounting , financial statement and operation analysis.
* Ability to synthesize complex financial and operational data into concise insights and practical recommendations.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
* Strong attention to detail, problem-solving abilities, and a results-driven mindset.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively across functions.
* Demonstrated commitment to confidentiality, integrity, and professional ethics.
* Experience with BI or data tools such as Tableau, Power BI or SQL, and an interest in using automation or AI to improve finance workflows

**KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS**

* Accuracy and timeliness of budgets, forecasts, and management reports.
* Quality and relevance of financial insights and recommendations.
* Forecast accuracy and variance management.
* Achievement of cost-optimization and profitability-improvement targets.
* Timely completion of financial analyses and strategic projects.
* Stakeholder satisfaction and effectiveness of finance business partnering.

**COMPENSATION & BENEFITS**
At Legion, we offer competitive compensation and benefits packages to all employees. As a fully remote employer, pay for positions is determined using local, national, and industry-specific survey data.
  
  
We strive to make competitive offers allowing employees room for future growth. Salaries will be based on the applicant’s location, level of experience, education, and specialized knowledge and skills. Additionally, we consider the external market rate, the amount we have budgeted internally, and internal equity within the company for the same position.
  
  
Benefits include, but are not limited to:
  
  

* Health Benefits
* Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays
* Parental Leave
* Equity
* Monthly Wellness Reimbursement
* Monthly Lunch on Legion

**ABOUT LEGION**
Join Legion's mission to turn hourly jobs into good jobs. We're a remote, mission-driven team seeking exceptional talent to propel this vision. Embrace a culture that's collaborative, fast-paced, and entrepreneurial. With us, you'll grow your skills, work closely with experienced executives, and contribute significantly to our mission. Legion Technologies delivers the industry’s most innovative workforce management platform. It enables businesses to maximize labor efficiency and employee engagement simultaneously. The award-winning, AI-driven Legion WFM platform is intelligent, automated, and employee-centric. It’s proven to deliver 13x ROI through schedule optimization, reduced attrition, increased productivity, and increased operational efficiency. Legion delivers cutting-edge technology in an easy-to-use platform and mobile app that employees love. If you're ready to make an impact and grow your career, Legion is where you belong. Join us in making hourly work rewarding and fulfilling.
  
  
**BACKGROUND AND OPPORTUNITY**
There are almost 75 million hourly workers in the United States, representing more than half of the entire workforce. Historically, managing hourly employees has been difficult due to high attrition (average of 60%) and high replacement costs (average of $3,200 per employee in retail). The ongoing labor shortage and competition from the gig economy make it more difficult to attract and retain hourly employees. The top reasons hourly employees leave their jobs are a lack of schedule empowerment, poor communication with employers, and an inability to get paid early. Gen Z and the millennial workforce demand gig-like flexibility, modern technology, and compelling work options. Legion’s mission is to turn hourly jobs into good jobs, serving the hourly workers who make up the majority of the US workforce. We believe in empowering employees and helping employers be efficient and innovative by enabling intelligent automation powered by Legion’s Workforce Management platform to optimize labor efficiency and enhance the employee experience simultaneously. Legion WFM was built for the cloud with AI at the core and designed to handle the complexity of modern businesses and meet the needs of today’s hourly employees. Our team is comprised of dedicated individuals from all backgrounds and experiences, globally distributed across all time zones.
  
  
For more information, visit https://legion.co

title: Lead Service Finance Analyst
description:
**Job Description Summary**
The Lead Service Finance Analyst partners with the regional and zone Service Finance teams to deliver financial planning, performance analysis, reporting, and operational finance support for the after-sales services business ("Service organization"). The role reports into the Global Markets Service Income Leader with a dotted line to the regional Service Senior Finance Manager.
  
  
The position plays a key role in supporting forecasting, budgeting, month-end close, performance management, and business intelligence activities. The analyst is expected to independently manage recurring reporting processes, provide actionable financial insights, drive reporting simplification initiatives, and support finance leaders in business decision-making across multiple geographies.
  
  
GE Healthcare is a leading global medical technology and digital solutions innovator. Our mission is to improve lives in the moments that matter. Unlock your ambition, turn ideas into world-changing realities, and join an organization where every voice makes a difference, and every difference builds a healthier world
  
  
**Job Description**
**Financial reporting & data extraction**

* Lead recurring financial reporting processes, ensuring timely and accurate delivery of management reports and business performance dashboards.
* Extract, validate, consolidate, and analyse financial data from multiple systems and databases.
* Develop meaningful insights on business performance, highlighting risks, opportunities, and key operational drivers.
* Drive process improvement and standardization in financial reporting.

**Forecasting, Budgeting & Planning**

* Support monthly forecasts, annual Budgeting, and strategic planning processes.
* Partner with finance managers to identify performance risks and opportunities and recommend corrective actions.
* Support headcount planning, workforce analysis, and productivity tracking.

**Closing & accounting support**

* Lead preparation and booking of assigned Manual Journal Entries (MJEs) and ensure compliance with internal controls and accounting policies.
* Support month-end and quarter-end close activities in partnership with finance and controllership teams.

**Business Intelligence & Power BI**

* Manage and continuously enhance Power BI reports and dashboards.
* Identify opportunities to automate reporting processes and improve data quality.
* Partner with stakeholders to develop new analytical tools and self-service reporting capabilities.
* Support implementation of standardized reporting frameworks.

**Ad hoc analysis & projects**

* Support zone-specific initiatives and finance projects. Respond to business requests such as historical account trending and performance analysis.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of reporting and analytical processes.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Economics, or a related field.
* Typically 7-10 years of experience in FP&A, Financial Reporting, Accounting, Business Finance, or related finance roles.
* Fluent in English.
* Experience working with large datasets and financial reporting systems.

**Desired Characteristics**

* Strong analytical and financial modelling capabilities with the ability to translate financial results into business insights.
* Proven ability to operate independently and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to identify root causes and recommend practical solutions.
* Experience supporting forecasting, budgeting, and month-end closing processes.
* Advanced Excel skills, including data manipulation, modelling, and automation techniques.
* Strong Power BI skills, including report development, maintenance, and dashboard design.
* Experience with ERP and financial systems (e.g., Oracle, SAP, Hyperion, SmartView, or equivalent).
* Effective communication and presentation skills, with the ability to interact confidently with finance and operational stakeholders.
* Demonstrated process improvement mindset and passion for simplification and automation.
* Comfortable operating within a global, matrixed organization.

**Role**

* The Sr. Consultant will support FP&A reporting, financial data management, reconciliation, and the ongoing modernization of the FP&A reporting landscape. A key focus of the role will be supporting the migration of existing financial reports and data processes to Snowflake and the new data platform, while ensuring financial accuracy and continuity of reporting.

The individual should be able to understand financial data flows, reconcile reporting results back to source financial systems, investigate discrepancies, and work with stakeholders to resolve data and reporting issues.
* The position will also be cross-trained as a backup for critical FP&A COE Reporting Delivery activities, particularly month-end data processing, reconciliations, and recurring financial reporting.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Develop, maintain, and enhance FP&A financial reports and dashboards.
* Support the migration of financial reporting and data processes to Snowflake/new data platforms, including validation and reconciliation of migrated data.
* Perform financial reconciliations between SAP, Snowflake, and other financial reporting systems, investigating and resolving differences.
* Support month-end financial close, including data validation, reconciliation, and reporting activities.
* Understand financial data flows and master data across source and reporting systems.
* Partner with Finance and FP&A stakeholders to troubleshoot reporting, mapping, master-data, and data-quality issues.
* Identify opportunities to standardize, simplify, and improve reporting and reconciliation processes.
* Become cross-trained on designated critical team activities and provide backup coverage when required.

**Must-Have Skills:**

* 7+ years of experience in FP&A, Finance, Accounting, financial reporting, analytics, or related roles.
* Strong understanding of accounting and financial reporting concepts.
* Strong knowledge and hands-on experience with financial reconciliations and data validation.
* Good understanding of month-end financial close processes and associated reporting timelines.
* Working knowledge of SAP financial data and the ability to reconcile reporting results back to SAP/source financial systems.
* Good understanding of finance master data, including GL accounts, cost centers, profit centers, legal entities, hierarchies, and financial mappings.
* Experience supporting financial reporting solutions, preferably Power BI and Excel/Power Query.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate financial data discrepancies and identify root causes.
* Ability to work effectively during critical month-end close and reporting cycles.
* Strong communication, documentation, and stakeholder-management skills.

**Preferred Skills:**

* Experience with Snowflake and financial data/reporting migrations to modern data platforms.
* Experience querying data using SQL for analysis, validation, and reconciliation.
* Experience with Power BI development and financial reporting.
* Exposure to Anaplan, HANA, HFM, Management Reporting, or similar finance and reporting platforms.
* Experience with financial data transformation, master-data mappings, and reporting-system integrations.
* Experience improving or automating financial reporting and reconciliation processes.

title: Senior Operations Insights Specialist
description:
Are you a data-driven professional with a passion for turning complex information into meaningful business insights? Do you thrive at the intersection of analytics, financial monitoring and operational excellence? If so, this could be the role for you. Join a dynamic, globally connected team where your expertise will directly shape how we manage and grow one of the most exciting portfolios in Life & Health Reinsurance.
  
  
**About The Role**
As the APAX markets continue to grow in scale and strategic importance, the L&H Operations Insights team sits right at the heart of that momentum. In this role, you will be a key contributor to enhancing client service delivery and strengthening operational efficiency by combining deep data expertise with sharp business acumen to drive decisions that matter. From advanced validation and regulatory reporting to financial monitoring and automation, your work will have real, measurable impact across the Asia Pacific and ANZ regions.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Data Quality & Risk Management**

* Identify risks and process gaps and recommend monitoring tools and controls to strengthen governance across TA Operations, Operations Insights and Stargate or data-related projects and initiatives
* Drive data quality improvements in collaboration with enabling teams to reduce risk exposure and optimize resource utilization
* Provide audit and regulatory support by coordinating with TA Operations, Regional Relationship Managers and local or branch-level auditors

**Advanced Validation & Reporting**
  
  

* Manage regulatory reporting requirements for APAX and ANZ, including VAT/GST and APRA-related submissions
* Review contractual agreements and perform detailed validations related to premiums, claims and underwriting clauses for APAX and ANZ
* Prepare product-level summaries to generate actionable insights for Operations, Portfolio Management, Actuarial and Product teams

+ Validate new business deals and complex treaties, support actuarial modelling across the Asia region
+ Perform premium rate and complex data validations using Python, SQL, and formula-driven logic to identify variances and provide quality assurance
+ Support automation initiatives by defining validation logic, contributing to coding and data structuring and enhancing end-to-end validation workflows
+ Develop dashboards and insights using Power BI and other visualization tools to communicate findings clearly and effectively

**Financial Monitoring**

* Support Actuarial and Finance teams with financial monitoring for the L&H business
* Conduct financial comparisons including Actuals vs. Estimates, Actuals vs. Actuals and Cash flow variance analysis, collaborating across teams to resolve discrepancies
* Lead quarterly monitoring activities and prepare reports supporting regional closing cycles
* Analyze revenue trends and key statistical metrics during periodic closing
* Perform pre- and post-closing activities and publish control and monitoring reports
* Compare new business volumes with client-reported data to support accurate financial projections
* Conduct simplified lapse studies to identify early warning indicators and highlight business-impacting trends

**About The Team**
The L&H Operations Insights team is an integral part of Life & Health Operations, playing a pivotal role in delivering high-quality operational insights, maintaining robust financial controls and enabling proactive risk mitigation. With the growing scale and complexity of APAX markets, the team ensures agility, client-centricity and proactive performance monitoring across key portfolios. We are a collaborative, multicultural group that values curiosity, accountability and continuous improvement - we take pride in the meaningful contribution we make to the broader L&H business.
  
  
**About You**
You are an analytical thinker and a confident communicator who brings both technical depth and business perspective to everything you do. You are comfortable navigating complexity, challenging the status quo and working across diverse, cross-functional teams in a virtual environment. You take ownership of your work, lead with integrity and are motivated by delivering outcomes that genuinely make a difference for clients and the business.
  
  
**We Are Looking For Candidates Who Meet These Requirements**

* 4–6 years of experience in Life & Health Insurance or Reinsurance, preferably with exposure to Financial Planning and Analysis
* Strong technical proficiency in Excel, SAS/SQL and Stargate, with demonstrated ability to perform complex data validations and financial analysis
* Advanced analytical skills with a solid understanding of L&H concepts and an end-to-end value chain perspective
* Regulatory and audit experience, including familiarity with VAT/GST, APRA submissions, or similar compliance frameworks
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Actuarial Science, Finance, Accounting, Insurance or related field. IFRS 17 knowledge or certification is preferred

**These Are Additional Nice To Haves**

* Experience with Python, Machine Learning or AI tools for data analysis and automation
* Proficiency in Power BI or other data visualization platforms to build dashboards and communicate insights
* Stakeholder management experience across multicultural and cross-functional teams in a virtual or matrixed environment
* Experience in coaching or mentoring team members or prior involvement in project management, stakeholder engagement or training initiatives
* Familiarity with actuarial support or collaboration with Actuarial and Finance teams
* An agile mindset with the ability to manage multiple workstreams simultaneously while maintaining a strong sense of accountability and commitment

Our company has a hybrid work model where the expectation is that you will be in the office at least three days per week.
  
  
**About Swiss Re**
Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. We cover both Property & Casualty and Life & Health. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 15,000 employees across the world.
  
  
Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. We embrace a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.

We may use AI-powered tools to support the review and evaluation of applications for this position. These tools provide additional insights to our recruitment teams, but all hiring decisions are carefully reviewed and made by people. To learn more about how we use AI in recruitment and how we handle your personal data, please review our Data Privacy Statement before applying.

We are seeking a highly detail-oriented and tech-forward Corporate Accounting Analyst to join our fast-paced corporate accounting team. In this role, you will play a critical part in managing General Ledger (GL) activities, ensuring accurate close processes, and driving accounting precision across specialized technical areas, including debt, prepaids, intercompany transactions, and lease accounting .
  
  
The ideal candidate holds a Chartered Accountant (CA) qualification, possesses 4–6 years of progressive accounting experience, and brings a modern, tech-enabled mindset—specifically the ability to leverage AI tools, automation, and advanced analytics to streamline workflows and solve complex accounting problems in a rapidly evolving environment.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Own end-to-end accounting schedules, journal entries, and balance sheet reconciliations for corporate accounting areas .
* Manage month-end, quarter-end, and year-end closing activities within prescribed timelines.
* Conduct variance analyses on P&L and Balance Sheet line items, investigating unexpected fluctuations and providing actionable commentary to management.
* Support internal and external audit requests by preparing audit schedules, supporting documentation, and clear accounting workpapers.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams (F&S, FinOps, Tax, Operations) to ensure accurate accounting treatment for complex transactions.
* Leverage ERP automation, analytical capabilities and AI-driven tools (e.g., prompt engineering, automated reconciliation workflows, intelligent data extraction) to enhance accuracy and timeliness.
* Identify bottlenecks in the financial close cycle and implement automated solutions or streamlined workflows.
* Utilize advanced data tools to process large volumes of financial data accurately under tight deadliness.

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

* Education & Certification: Chartered Accountant (CA) or equivalent professional accounting designation is mandatory.
* Experience: 4 to 6 years of post-qualification core corporate accounting experience, with strong hands-on expertise in General Ledger operations.
* AI & Tech Proficiency: Demonstrated ability to adopt and operate AI tools (e.g., generative AI for documentation/analysis, workflow automation software, advanced ERP modules) to optimize accounting tasks.

Key Competencies & Soft Skills
  
  

* Fast-Paced Adaptability: Ability to prioritize effectively, meet tight monthly/quarterly closing deadlines, and thrive in an agile, dynamic environment.
* Analytical & Detail-Oriented: Exceptional problem-solving skills with a high degree of precision in numerical and technical accounting work.
* Communication: Clear verbal and written communication skills to effectively collaborate with remote teams, management, and external auditors.
* Self-Starter: Strong ownership mindset, able to work independently as a contractor with minimal supervision.

Nice to Have
  
  

* Knowledge of (or experience in) the technology or payments industry
* Big4 working experience
* Oracle suite
* Hubble and SQL

In-office expectations
  
  
Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.
  
  
Pay and benefits
  
  
Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally.
  
  
We look forward to hearing from you.
  
  
At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.
  
  
Apply now

title: Senior Vendor Management Analyst - Contingent Labor Managed Services
description:
**How You'll Help Us Keep Climbing (Overview & Key Responsibilities)**
**Responsibilities**
The Digital & Technology Vendor Management Office (VMO) is responsible for maximizing value from Delta's largest technology suppliers through governance, performance management, utilization reporting, and cost optimization. The VMO focuses on three core outcomes:
  
  

* Establish outcome-based vendor performance management
* Drive measurable cost reduction and value realization
* Deliver utilization and workforce reporting that improves decision making

As a Senior Vendor Management Analyst, you will support Delta's Professional Services and Consulting portfolio, partnering closely with vendor leaders, Global Delivery Network leaders, Supply Chain Management, Finance, and technology stakeholders.
  
  
This role partners closely with centralized Sourcing on SOW structuring and commercial terms but is not a standalone contract administration function.
  
  
You will operate as an internal consultant focused on identifying opportunities, analyzing vendor performance, building executive-ready recommendations, and helping leaders execute sourcing, consolidation, workforce productivity, and vendor optimization initiatives across a multi-million-dollar supplier portfolio.
  
  
The Senior Vendor Management Analyst supports governance and optimization of Delta's professional services suppliers including GDP providers, consulting firms, and contingent labor partners.
  
  
The role combines analytics, problem solving, financial analysis, executive communications, and vendor governance. You will help identify savings opportunities, validate business cases, develop performance scorecards, track supplier commitments, and support vendor reviews focused on productivity, workforce efficiency, and value realization.
  
  
Success in this role requires strong analytical thinking, curiosity, executive presence, and the ability to convert data into actionable recommendations.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Vendor Performance & Governance**

* Support governance of strategic professional services suppliers and consulting partners.
* Develop and maintain vendor scorecards measuring delivery performance, workforce efficiency, value realization, and productivity outcomes.
* Prepare executive-ready materials for vendor governance reviews and business reviews.
* Analyze supplier performance trends and identify risks, issues, and opportunities requiring leadership attention.
* Partner with Delta's centralized Sourcing team and IT stakeholders on deal structuring for consulting services SOWs supporting application development and maintenance work, ensuring commercial terms align with delivery and cost objectives.
* Develop fixed-deliverable SOWs with clearly defined milestones, acceptance criteria, and penalty/remedy clauses for delays or missed expectations.
* Develop and champion best-in-class SOW standards and templates for consulting engagements, incorporating industry-leading practices in deliverable definition, governance, and commercial protections.
* Track and manage corrective actions and vendor commitments through closure.
* Track vendor performance against key milestones and deliverables on large, strategic SOWs, escalating and enforcing accountability when commitments are missed.

**Cost Optimization & Value Realization**

* Identify cost reduction opportunities through supplier consolidation, workforce optimization, demand management, and commercial improvements.
* Build financial models and business cases supporting vendor optimization initiatives.
* Quantify savings opportunities, cost avoidance, and realized benefits.
* Benchmark supplier performance and cost structures to identify optimization opportunities.
* Develop and evaluate global consulting rate cards, and apply financial levers — rate benchmarking, blended rate mix, onshore/offshore ratios, and volume/tenure discounts — to reduce consulting services spend.
* Track savings initiatives through identification, approval, implementation, and benefit realization.

**Workforce & Utilization Analytics**

* Analyze supplier workforce data including onshore/offshore mix, labor utilization, staffing trends, rate cards, and delivery productivity.
* Develop reporting that helps leaders understand workforce efficiency and supplier effectiveness.
* Support initiatives focused on increasing offshore leverage and improving delivery economics.
* Build dashboards and reporting to measure workforce productivity and supplier outcomes.

**Strategic Initiatives**

* Support supplier consolidation programs and outcome-based SOW initiatives.
* Analyze AI-driven productivity opportunities across the supplier landscape.
* Assist in developing recommendations that improve output, quality, speed, and cost efficiency.
* Conduct research, analysis, and problem-solving activities supporting new VMO programs and strategic initiatives.

**What You Need To Succeed (Minimum Qualifications)**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Engineering, Information Technology, Economics, or a related field.
* 4-7 years of experience in consulting, vendor management, sourcing, business operations, financial analysis, procurement analytics, or technology strategy.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Experience in management consulting, vendor management, sourcing, procurement, or supplier governance.
* Experience supporting professional services, consulting, contingent labor, or global delivery providers.
* Knowledge of workforce optimization, supplier performance management, or vendor governance practice
* Advanced Excel capabilities including modeling, forecasting, data analysis, and scenario planning.
* Advanced PowerPoint skills with the ability to create executive-level presentations.
* Experience translating complex data into actionable business recommendations.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to independently structure ambiguous business problems and drive analysis to conclusions.
* Experience working across multiple stakeholders and functions.

**Behavioral Competencies**

* Ability to produce high quality results, work in a collaborative environment by embracing diverse perspectives and with a solution-based approach.
* Adapt communication clearly and concisely based on team dynamics and expresses thoughts & ideas effectively.
* Ability to engage effectively with peers and stakeholders to build trust and reliable working relationships.
* Ability to understand business processes, implement innovative solutions, guide juniors on continuous improvement by constantly updating oneself on current technology & trends.
* Inquisitive to understand customer and business expectations while creating value addition on technical solutions.

**What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)**

* Experience in management consulting, vendor management, sourcing, procurement, or supplier governance.
* Experience supporting professional services, consulting, contingent labor, or global delivery providers.
* Knowledge of workforce optimization, supplier performance management, or vendor governance practices.
* Experience quantifying business cases, savings opportunities, and ROI.
* Experience with Power BI or similar analytics platforms.
* Exposure to Agile delivery models and software development organizations.
* Experience working in globally distributed organizations and offshore delivery environments.

**What Will Make You Successful**
We're looking for someone who thinks like a consultant and executes like an operator. The strongest candidates will demonstrate:
  
  

* Structured problem-solving
* Data-driven decision making
* Executive communication
* Financial and analytical acumen
* Curiosity and ownership
* Ability to influence without authority
* Comfort working in ambiguous environments
* Relentless focus on measurable outcomes

**About The Company**
What started as a humble, little aerial crop-dusting operation called Huff Daland Dusters in 1924 has now grown into the U.S. global airline leader in safety, innovation, reliability, and customer experience. Headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, Delta Air Lines is known for its operational excellence and award-winning customer service.
  
  
Powered by our employees worldwide, Delta has led the airline industry in operational excellence for a decade while maintaining our reputation for award-winning customer service. With our mission of connecting the people and cultures of the globe, Delta strives to foster understanding across a diverse world and serve as a force for social good.
  
  
In 2026, Delta Air Lines continued to earn global recognition for its performance, culture and operational excellence. Delta was named to Glassdoor’s 2026 Top 100 Best Places to Work list for the ninth time, standing as the only airline recognized. Delta also secured the 11th spot on Fortune’s World’s Most Admired Companies list, marking its 13th consecutive year earning this distinction. Delta was also recognized by Cirium as the top on-time airline in North America for the fifth consecutive year, underscoring its unwavering commitment to reliability and customer experience.
  
  
**About The Delta Technology Hub (DTH), Bangalore**
The DTH is one of Delta Air Lines' investments in world-class business capabilities and technology aimed at transforming how Delta Air Lines operates and provides world-class travel experiences to its customers through innovation and cutting-edge methodologies. By continuously reimagining processes and driving technology-led transformation, the Delta Technology Hub plays a pivotal role in Scripting The Future Of Aviation. The organization is certified by the Great Place to Work Institute (India). The Delta Technology Hub was a finalist for the iVolunteer Awards 2024/2025 in the "Leader in Employee Volunteering" category. This nomination highlights our remarkable volunteering initiatives and the outstanding practices we implement to encourage and support our employee volunteering program.
  
  
For more information, please visit www.deltatechhub.com
  
  
**Why join?**

* Technology is a key enabler of the differentiated services that Delta provides. At the DTH, you get the opportunity to work on projects with a significant impact on business outcomes and customer experience.
* Deepen your knowledge by taking part in multifaceted learning and development programs –exposure to extensive internal and partner repositories, institutional affiliations, and industry SIG (Special Interest Groups) partnerships.
* Immerse yourself in an employee-centric culture.
* Develop deep and broad business acumen on airline operations while retaining focus on cutting-edge technology driven solutions.
* Avail a full range of benefits that support you and your family: Medical Insurance, Transportation to and from the DTH office, Complementary Cafeteria Meals, Special Travel opportunities and Travel Privileges, Car Lease Program, Paid time off, Parental Benefits and National Pension Scheme.

**Responsibilities**

* Validate credit risk models used to measure obligor risk and support early warning tools for corporate and consumer portfolios.
* Conduct data analysis for Loss Given Default studies and contribute directly to model development.
* Evaluate and apply scoring models to strengthen credit risk policies and decision-making.
* Maintain core risk parameters, including default data, rating migration data, usage given default data, and transition matrices.
* Spot gaps in existing risk policies and help shape new ones to close them.
* Translate data analysis into clear recommendations grounded in credit risk expertise.
* Document models, methods, and validation processes so they are clear, reproducible, and audit-ready.

* Strong communication skills, with the ability to present information clearly to different audiences.

**Beneficial Skills & Qualifications**

* Exposure to credit risk analysis, particularly developing early warning tools.
* Familiarity with industry standards and practices in credit risk management.

**What We Offer**

title: Senior Accountant
description:
**Job Summary**
The primary responsibilities of the Senior Accountant are to support the timely and accurate preparation of financial statements in accordance with applicable accounting standards, manage complex general ledger and revenue accounting activities, and ensure revenue is properly recognized in accordance with US GAAP and IFRS. This role encompasses the responsibilities of partnering cross-functionally with Sales, FP&A, Legal, and operations, performing technical accounting research, supporting audits and reporting requirements, and maintaining strong internal controls. The Senior Accountant will also identify process improvements, drive automation, use advanced data and reporting tools, and provide guidance to junior accounting team members.
  
  
**Essential Duties & Responsibilities**

* Executes month-end close activities, including the accurate and timely recording of revenue, expenses, assets, liabilities, and related journal entries in accordance with IFRS, US GAAP, Company policy, ASC 606, and IFRS 15
* Prepares and reviews complex balance sheet and income statement reconciliations, including revenue, deferred revenue, contract assets and liabilities, billings, accounts receivable, and other technical accounts
* Reviews new and existing customer contracts, addendums, sales orders, and non-standard terms to determine proper revenue recognition treatment and ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards
* Serves as a revenue accounting resource for Sales, FP&A, Legal, and business stakeholders during contract negotiation by evaluating revenue impact, communicating implications, and recommending compliant alternatives
* Prepares specialized reports, monthly balance sheet and income statement analyses, variance explanations, and management reporting to support accurate financial results and business decision-making
* Performs technical accounting research and drafts accounting memorandums for revenue recognition and other complex accounting matters
* Monitors relevant IFRS and US GAAP reporting developments, and recommends updates to policies, procedures, controls, and reporting practices as needed
* Develops, documents, and improves revenue recognition and general accounting processes, including internal controls, system modifications, data flows, reconciliations, and reporting enhancements
* Supports the annual audit by preparing schedules, reconciliations, supporting analyses, and technical accounting memos
* Partners with FP&A and leadership on forecasting, budgeting, trend analyses, and ad-hoc financial analysis
* Uses advanced Excel capabilities and data tools, including Power Query, dynamic arrays, complex formulas, pivot tables, VBA, SQL, Power BI, Power Automate, Python, and similar platforms to improve reporting, automate recurring work, and strengthen analytics
* Provides guidance and mentorship to junior accounting staff, answers technical questions, and reviews work as needed
* Provides and maintains excellent customer service to other departments and stakeholders
* Works with the Controller, Assistant Controller, and Supervisor, Accounting on various initiatives and completes special projects and other ad-hoc requests

Education
  
  

* BS or BA in Accounting or equivalent discipline
* CPA or CA Certification preferred

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Minimum of 5 years of financial and accounting experience
* Revenue recognition experience required, including technical knowledge of ASC 606 and IFRS 15
* Public accounting experience preferred
* Software or SaaS revenue recognition experience preferred
* Experience with accounting systems required; Microsoft D365 Finance experience is a plus

Skills/Knowledge
  
  

* Strong technical accounting background with a thorough knowledge of IFRS and US GAAP, including ASC 606, IFRS 15, technical research, and preparation of accounting memorandums
* Strong understanding of revenue recognition, bookings and billings processes, contract review, deferred revenue, contract assets and liabilities, and related internal controls
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including Power Query, dynamic arrays, complex formulas, pivot tables, data modeling, data validation, and macros/VBA
* Experience with SQL and business intelligence, reporting, and automation tools such as Power BI, Power Automate, Python, and similar platforms
* Experience with AI tools is a plus
* Ability to clearly and concisely document and effectively communicate complex accounting and reporting issues to the finance and non-finance teams
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and process-improvement skills, including the ability to convert large data sets into actionable insights
* Highly effective communication skills (verbal and written)
* Ability to work in a fast-paced environment, meet deadlines, multitask efficiently, and manage multiple critical projects
* Detail-oriented with a high level of ethics and integrity
* Ability to mentor team members and collaborate cross-functionally to drive accurate reporting and continuous improvement

**Work Environment/Physical Demands**

* While at work, this position is primarily a sedentary job and requires that the associate be able to work in an environment where they will consistently be seated for the majority of the workday
* This role requires that one can sit and regularly type on a keyboard for the majority of their workday
* This position requires the ability to observe a computer screen for long periods of time to observe their own and others' work, as well as incoming and outgoing communications via the computer and/or mobile devices.
* The role necessitates the ability to listen and speak clearly to customers and other associates
* The work environment is an open room with other associates, and noise from others will be part of the regular workday

title: Senior Data Analyst
description:
**About The Company**
Founders today are building global companies from day one — but the systems that manage their money were built for a different era. Aspire exists to change that!
  
  
We’re building the financial operating system for global founders, bringing banking, software, and automation into a single platform so businesses can move faster across borders and stay focused on building.
  
  
Aspire is built by people who think from first principles, care deeply about solving hard problems, and take real ownership of their work. Our team brings global experience from leading fintech and technology companies, and many of us are former founders and operators who understand what it takes to build thoughtfully, make trade-offs, and deliver at scale in a global environment.
  
  
Backed by leading global investors including Y Combinator, Peak XV, and Lightspeed, Aspire has been trusted by more than 50,000 startups and growing businesses worldwide to manage their finances since 2018. Together with partners like J.P. Morgan, Visa, and Wise, we’re building for the next generation of global companies.
  
  
**About The Role**
We’re looking for a Senior Data Analyst to join our S&P team and help run the engine behind Aspire’s P&L. You’ll work hand-in-hand with our data lead on the monthly data close, reconciliations, and P&L build-out for new products and markets, while owning the data that feeds our scorecards, planning, and investor reporting. This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys getting to the bottom of a number and wants to own core finance data processes as the business scales.
  
  
**About The Team**
At Aspire, the Data and Strategy & Planning (S&P) teams sit at the heart of how the company makes decisions. The Data team turns raw information into trusted insights and scalable infrastructure, helping every team – from Product and Operations to Finance – move faster and act smarter. S&P owns the numbers that steer the business: the P&L, planning and target-setting, performance scorecards, and investor reporting. This role sits across both teams, combining rigorous analytical thinking, deep business understanding, and strong technical skills to make sure our financial data is accurate, well understood, and ready to drive decisions. If you’re passionate about using data to shape the future of a high-growth fintech, you’ll feel right at home with us.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
As a Senior Data Analyst, you will be a key owner of the data behind our P&L and performance reporting. Your responsibilities will include:
  
  

* Run the Monthly Data Close: Prepare and run the monthly data close checklist, making sure P&L, revenue and gross profit data are complete and accurate before sign-off.
* Own Reconciliations: Run the monthly reconciliation between data and Financial Control; investigate breaks, trace them to root cause, and resolve or escalate.
* Maintain the P&L: Make routine fixes and additions to P&L logic (e.g. daily card accruals), keeping definitions consistent as products and pricing change.
* Build P&L for New Products and Markets: Build and test P&L line items for new products and markets, covering payments, cards, receiving, payouts and customer balances across currencies.
* Power Planning & Performance Reporting: Refresh internal scorecards, maintain cohort datasets, and run segment cuts and simulations in Databricks to support planning, target-setting and investor reporting.
* Support the Annual Audit: Prepare data and respond to auditor requests alongside the Financial Control team during the audit cycle.
* Be First Line for Data Requests: Handle ad hoc requests from product teams, from troubleshooting and data clean-ups to reclassifications and data fixes with Engineering.
* Help Modernise Our Data Stack: Contribute to our move to Databricks and the data build initiatives that follow.
* Automate with AI: Use AI tools such as Claude Code to automate recurring checks, reconciliations and reporting.

**We would love to get to know you if you have the following:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
* 5+ years of experience in finance analytics, analytics engineering, or a similar data role.
* Strong SQL is a must: you can write, debug and optimise complex queries independently. Experience with Databricks is a plus.
* AI-native: comfortable using Claude Code and other AI tools in your day-to-day work.
* Advanced Excel / Google Sheets skills and hands-on reconciliation experience.
* Solid understanding of the P&L, revenue and gross profit, and how they are built from transactional data.
* Background in fintech, payments or financial services (e.g. cards, FX, payments, interest/yield) is a strong plus.
* High attention to detail and the persistence to trace a break back to its root cause.
* Clear written English and comfort working asynchronously with a team across time zones.
* An ownership mindset and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

title: Lead Treasury Analyst
description:
**About this role:**

Wells Fargo is seeking a Lead Treasury Analyst will join the Portfolio Strategy and Analytics team and support forecasts for the Wells Fargo Investment Portfolio across capital, interest rate risk, balance sheet, income, and liquidity under multiple scenarios. The role requires expertise in fixed-income modeling, Asset Liability Management, Interest Rate Risk, stress-testing, and model governance, along with strong partnership and matrix-management skills.

**In this role, you will:**

  

* Execute investment portfolio forecasting and analytics, including interest rate risk, valuation, balance sheet, income, capital, and liquidity analysis.
* Analyze month-over-month portfolio and forecast movements, identify material drivers, and translate results into clear business narratives.• Perform sensitivity, attribution, and assumption analysis to support balance sheet and interest rate risk management.
* Validate the accuracy, reasonableness, and consistency of data, assumptions, models, and outputs; maintain strong data quality and controls.
* Deliver recurring analyses accurately and in compliance with treasury risk management, regulatory, model governance, and audit requirements. Enhance forecasting, valuation, and analytics capabilities by documenting business requirements, conducting analytical testing, strengthening controls, and supporting new investment strategies.

description:
