Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**
----------------

As a Credit Risk Model Validation Analyst, you will validate and strengthen the models and tools Citi relies on to measure market, credit, and operational risk. You will work on Loss Given Default studies, credit risk model validation, and early warning tools that directly shape how Citi manages risk across its lending portfolios. This role sits within a team that maintains the analytical foundation behind Citi's risk decisions, offering hands-on exposure to real-world credit risk modeling and data analysis.

**Responsibilities**

* Validate credit risk models used to measure obligor risk and support early warning tools for corporate and consumer portfolios.
* Conduct data analysis for Loss Given Default studies and contribute directly to model development.
* Evaluate and apply scoring models to strengthen credit risk policies and decision-making.
* Maintain core risk parameters, including default data, rating migration data, usage given default data, and transition matrices.
* Spot gaps in existing risk policies and help shape new ones to close them.
* Translate data analysis into clear recommendations grounded in credit risk expertise.
* Document models, methods, and validation processes so they are clear, reproducible, and audit-ready.

* Exposure to credit risk analysis, particularly developing early warning tools.
* Familiarity with industry standards and practices in credit risk management.

You will build deep technical expertise in credit risk modeling while working alongside experienced analysts who shape how Citi measures and manages risk globally.

title: Financial Reporting Manager
description:
Role Overview

The Manager – Financial Reporting will be responsible for overseeing the end-to-end financial reporting process, including the preparation, consolidation, analysis, and disclosure of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements. The role requires strong technical expertise in Ind AS and IFRS, a thorough understanding of regulatory and statutory reporting requirements, and the ability to manage external audits and drive continuous improvements in financial reporting processes.

The incumbent will lead and develop a team of finance professionals, ensure the accuracy and integrity of financial information, strengthen internal financial controls, and collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to deliver timely and compliant financial reporting.

Key Responsibilities

1. Financial Reporting and Consolidation

* Oversee the timely and accurate preparation of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements, including balance sheets, statements of profit and loss, cash flow statements, and related disclosures, in accordance with applicable Ind AS and IFRS requirements.
* Manage the consolidation of financial statements and ensure consistency, accuracy, and compliance across reporting entities.
* Review financial results, account reconciliations, and supporting schedules to ensure the completeness and integrity of reported financial information.
* Ensure adherence to applicable statutory, regulatory, and financial reporting requirements, including relevant SEBI regulations, wherever applicable.

2. Technical Accounting and Compliance

* Lead technical accounting assessments and research for complex transactions, including revenue recognition, lease accounting, mergers and acquisitions, and other significant accounting matters.
* Prepare and review technical accounting memoranda, documenting accounting positions, interpretations, and conclusions in accordance with applicable accounting standards.
* Monitor changes in accounting standards and regulatory requirements and assess their impact on financial reporting and disclosures.
* Ensure compliance with Internal Financial Controls (IFC) requirements and support the design, implementation, and monitoring of relevant financial controls.

3. Audit Management and Stakeholder Coordination

* Act as the primary point of contact for internal and external auditors, coordinating audit planning, schedules, information requests, and issue resolution.
* Manage statutory audit and other assurance-related activities, ensuring timely submission of supporting documentation and closure of audit observations.
* Liaise with finance, tax, corporate finance, and other cross-functional teams to address accounting and reporting matters.
* Track audit findings and remediation actions, ensuring timely resolution and strengthening the overall control environment.

4. Team Leadership and Development

* Lead, mentor, and develop a team of senior and staff financial accountants, fostering accountability, technical excellence, and continuous learning.
* Allocate responsibilities, monitor deliverables, and ensure adherence to reporting timelines and quality standards.
* Conduct performance evaluations, provide constructive feedback, and identify development opportunities to strengthen team capabilities.
* Promote collaboration, knowledge sharing, and process ownership across the financial reporting function.

Additional Responsibilities

* Support corporate finance and tax teams with ad hoc financial analysis, accounting assessments, and statutory audit requirements.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to streamline month-end and year-end closing activities, improve reporting accuracy, and reduce reporting cycle times.
* Identify opportunities to automate manual processes, standardize reporting templates, and enhance financial reporting controls.
* Support the implementation, optimization, and enhancement of financial consolidation tools and ERP systems, including system upgrades and process integration.
* Develop and maintain robust reporting documentation, accounting policies, standard operating procedures, and process controls.

Role Purpose
  
  
The Associate Director / Program Leader will lead FP&A and business finance support for assigned G&A functions and business segments. The role owns budgeting, forecasting, monthly performance management, consolidation of financial results, cost optimization governance, and decision support. The incumbent will serve as the primary finance contact for US stakeholders, translate complex results into clear business narratives, and accelerate finance transformation through automation, dashboards, and process simplification.

Budgeting, Forecasting and Planning
  
  

* Lead the annual operating plan, periodic forecasts, and long-range planning for assigned areas.
* Build driver-based forecasts across headcount, compensation, vendors, projects, technology, facilities, and other operating costs.

Financial Consolidation and Enterprise Performance Management

Monthly Performance Management and Reporting

Cost Optimization and Value Realization
  
  

* Lead governance and tracking of cost savings, productivity, and efficiency initiatives across supported areas.
* Validate initiative baselines, timing, ownership, financial impact, and sustainability of benefits.
* Monitor realized savings against commitments, identify delivery gaps, and facilitate mitigation plans with initiative owners.
* Identify new opportunities through benchmarking, spend analysis, process review, and cross-functional collaboration.

Business Cases and Decision Support
  
  

* Develop robust business cases for strategic investments, automation, location decisions, operating model changes, hiring, and transformation programs.
* Perform ROI, NPV, payback, sensitivity, and scenario analysis, with clear assumptions and decision recommendations.
* Assess financial and operational trade-offs and communicate implications to senior stakeholders.
* Provide ad hoc modeling and analysis for emerging business priorities.

Analytics, Automation and Finance Transformation
  
  

* Simplify and automate recurring finance processes, reporting packs, and data flows to improve speed, quality, and control.
* Develop intuitive Power BI dashboards and self-service reporting that connect financial and operational drivers.
* Partner with Technology and data teams to improve data integrity, scalable reporting architecture, and user adoption.
* Promote a forward-looking finance mindset by shifting effort from data compilation to insight generation and decision support.

Executive Storytelling and Communication
  
  

* Convert complex financial results into a clear, structured, and action-oriented business narrative.
* Prepare high-quality presentations and dashboards for senior management and US stakeholders.
* Explain financial concepts to non-finance audiences using simple language, relevant operational drivers, and focused visuals.
* Communicate issues early, distinguish facts from assumptions, and provide practical recommendations.

Governance and Team Leadership
  
  

* Ensure adherence to planning calendars, reporting timelines, policies, procedures, and internal controls.
* Lead cross-functional programs and coordinate contributors across locations without relying solely on formal authority.
* Coach team members and finance partners on analytical rigor, stakeholder management, and executive communication.
* Drive standardization, continuous improvement, and adoption of FP&A best practices.

**Essential**
Qualifications and Experience
  
  

* Minimum 10+ years of progressive experience in FP&A, business finance, corporate finance, or finance business partnering, with readiness to operate at an Associate Director level.
* CA, CMA, CPA, MBA in Finance, or equivalent professional qualification. A qualification from a leading institution is preferred.
* Demonstrated experience in budgeting, forecasting, monthly performance management, and consolidation across multiple business segments or functions.
* Strong financial modeling and business case development capability, including scenario and investment analysis.
* Hands-on expertise in advanced Excel and Power BI, with proven delivery of automated dashboards or reporting solutions.

* Ability to influence senior stakeholders, challenge constructively, and deliver in a global matrix environment.

**Preferred**

Competency Expected Behaviors

title: Sr. Analyst, Competitive Pricing
description:
Our Company:

With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI.
  
  
**Position Summary**
The Senior Analyst, Competitive Pricing plays a critical role in shaping how Teradata competes in the market. This role is anchored in deep competitive pricing research that directly feeds into pricing analysis, recommendations, and approval — and extends that intelligence into field enablement that equips Sales and Deal Desk to compete and win on price.
  
  
Sitting within Teradata’s Product Marketing team, you will support the Pricing & Packaging team and will partner closely with Product Management, Competitive Intelligence, Product Marketing, Sales, and Deal Desk to build a fact-based view of competitor pricing — and translate those insights into actionable recommendations, pricing decisions, and field-ready tools.
  
  
This is a high-visibility role that directly influences pricing strategy, pricing approvals, deal execution, and competitive positioning.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
Competitive Pricing Research
  
  

* Conduct structured competitive pricing analysis across cloud data platform, analytics, and AI competitors — covering list prices, discount patterns, packaging models, and consumption-based pricing structures.
* Build and maintain a competitive pricing intelligence database that serves as the authoritative source of record for Pricing & Packaging, Product Marketing, and Competitive Intelligence teams — including list prices, discount patterns, packaging models, and TCO benchmarks.
* Develop TCO and price‑performance models comparing Teradata to key competitors across regions, workloads, and deployment models.
* Analyze win/loss pricing patterns to identify risks and opportunities, and translate findings into concrete inputs for pricing recommendations and approval decisions.
* Monitor AI pricing and cloud monetization trends — token-based, consumption-based, and outcome-based models — and surface implications for Teradata’s pricing strategy and competitive positioning.
* Partner with Product Management and Product Marketing to ensure pricing strategy reflects current competitive realities and that research findings are integrated into packaging decisions and pricing recommendations.

Competitive Pricing Enablement

title: O2C Global Process Expert
description:
**Company Description**
Experian is a global data and technology company, powering opportunities for people and businesses around the world. We operate across a range of markets, from financial services to healthcare, automotive, agribusiness, insurance, and many more. Experian invests in people and new advanced technologies to unlock the power of data. We have an amazing team of 25,200 people in 32 countries.
  
  
**Job Description**

* Process expertise and global standards
* Apply detailed end-to-end O2C knowledge across invoicing, accounts receivable, cash application, collections, and customer master data.
* Translate approved global standards into practical processes, functional requirements, documentation, guidance and regional implementation activities.
* Assess and document regional variations, distinguishing justified exceptions from opportunities for standardisation.
* Monitor adherence to approved standards and escalate material deviations, exceptions or design decisions to the GPO.
* Maintain accurate process architecture, controls and supporting documentation as part of the change lifecycle.
* Process analysis and improvement
* Lead structured current-state and future-state assessments for assigned O2C initiatives.
* Identify root causes, process gaps, control weaknesses, manual dependencies and opportunities to simplify, standardise or automate.
* Assess end-to-end impacts across processes, data, controls, customers, regions, systems and operating teams.
* Develop clear business and functional requirements, acceptance criteria and measurable outcomes before technical solution design begins.
* Evaluate options against global standards, business value, scalability, risk, implementation effort and total process impact.
* Prepare evidence-based recommendations for GPO decision, endorsement or prioritisation.
* Project orchestration and delivery
* Act as the process orchestrator within assigned projects and workstreams, connecting business, operational, process, control, data, technology and delivery stakeholders around a coherent end-to-end outcome.
* Establish clarity on process scope, decision rights, owners, dependencies, deliverables and required governance.
* Bring together the right subject matter experts at the right stage, facilitate resolution of cross-functional issues and ensure open decisions are progressed through the appropriate owners.
* Maintain alignment between the approved global process direction and the solution being designed and implemented.
* Partner with the assigned project manager, who retains accountability for overall project planning, governance, resources, timeline and project communications.
* Lead defined process workstreams and coordinate smaller process changes where a dedicated project manager is not required, subject to agreed priorities, governance and capacity.
* Monitor process-related risks, dependencies and delivery gaps, escalating where progress, quality or alignment is at risk.
* Solution development, testing and readiness
* Translate process needs into clear functional requirements and work with functional SMEs, technology teams, architects and developers to support solution assessment.
* Validate that proposed solutions meet the business requirement, approved global standards, control expectations and scalability needs without assuming technical architecture ownership.
* Define or validate process-level acceptance criteria and ensure the appropriate operational SMEs and impacted regions participate in testing.
* Monitor resolution of material defects and consolidate evidence to support business readiness.
* Ensure process, control, data, training, operating-procedure and adoption impacts are addressed before implementation.
* Support post-implementation review and confirm whether the intended process and business outcomes have been achieved.

title: Finance Executive
description:
About Nobero

Nobero is a fast-growing, tech-led D2C apparel brand focused on delivering everyday activewear and comfortable clothing to consumers. As we expand across multiple channels, including e-commerce, marketplaces, and Exclusive Brand Outlets (EBOs), we are looking for a detail-oriented, driven, and agile Finance Executive to manage day-to-day financial operations and reconciliation processes.

Role Overview

As a Finance Executive at Nobero, you will be responsible for brand-level financial operations, marketplace reconciliations, accounts receivable, vendor management, and statutory compliance tracking. You will work closely with cross-functional teams, external auditors, and key partners, including TMRW and KPMG, to ensure smooth cash flow, accurate bookkeeping, and timely compliance.

Key Responsibilities

1. Marketplace & B2B Operations

* **B2B Receivables & PO Validation:**
  Validate B2B Purchase Orders (POs) against agreed pricing and terms, and follow up on timely collections.
* **Proof of Delivery (POD) Management:**
  Track and collect B2B Proofs of Delivery (PODs) and maintain updated delivery trackers.
* **Credit Notes & IRNs:**
  Generate manual Credit Notes (CNs) and Invoice Reference Numbers (IRNs) for Return to Vendor (RTV) cases and B2B discount debits.
* **Stock Transfer IRNs:**
  Identify, process, and resolve pending Stock Transfer IRN cases to prevent tax and compliance discrepancies.

2. Cash, Expense & Retail Reconciliation

* **Marketplace Reconciliation:**
  Perform regular ledger and payout reconciliations across marketplaces such as Amazon, Flipkart, and Myntra to ensure revenue accuracy and completeness.
* **EBO Cash/Card Reconciliation:**
  Monitor retail store petty cash accounts and perform weekly and monthly reconciliations of cash and card settlements.
* **Employee Reimbursements:**
  Validate and process employee business expenses through Enkash, following up on missing receipts and pending approvals.
* **Monthly Expense Analysis:**
  Assist with monthly expense variance analysis against budgets to identify discrepancies and cost-saving opportunities.

3. Vendor Management & Compliance

* **Vendor Payments:**
  Coordinate with vendors for invoice processing, ledger confirmations, and timely payment clearances.
* **PPOB/APOB Tracking:**
  Maintain and regularly update Principal Place of Business (PPOB) and Additional Place of Business (APOB) trackers across states, and follow up to resolve regulatory blocks.

Key Qualifications & Requirements

Education

* Bachelor’s degree in Commerce (B.Com), Finance, Accounting, or an equivalent discipline.
* M.Com or CA Inter qualification will be an added advantage.

Experience

* 2–4 years of hands-on experience in financial operations, preferably within a D2C brand, e-commerce, retail, or apparel company.

Technical Skills

* Proficiency in accounting platforms such as Tally, Zoho, or ERP systems like SAP/NetSuite.
* Hands-on experience with expense management tools such as Enkash.
* Advanced MS Excel skills, including VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, and data manipulation.
* Familiarity with GST compliance, e-invoicing (IRN), and e-Way bills.

Core Competencies

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* High attention to detail and accuracy.
* Proactive follow-up and coordination skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

What We Offer

* An exciting opportunity to work with a fast-growing consumer D2C apparel brand.
* Direct exposure to e-commerce finance operations, marketplace reconciliation processes, and Big Four audit practices.
* Opportunities for professional growth, increased ownership, and collaboration within a dynamic finance team.

title: Finance System Integration Analyst
description:
**About SkySpecs:**

At SkySpecs, our mission is to simplify renewable asset management so less can do more for the planet. SkySpecs is making this possible by automating wind farm operations and maintenance with advanced robotics paired with our custom-built asset performance management software, Horizon.

SkySpecs launched the world’s first completely autonomous blade inspection product in 2016 with a custom-designed drone system. Since then, SkySpecs has inspected over 90% of the US wind turbines and expanded globally, becoming the world leader in understanding the health of turbine blades. Identifying issues with turbine blades is only the first step. In 2019, SkySpecs launched Horizon, a platform for SkySpecs to offer a multi-layered solution for customers that includes: data collection, wind turbine blade engineering expertise, and a place for all stakeholders to collaborate to manage and analyze massive amounts of data, spot trends, and create plans for high-cost repair campaigns. In 2021,

SkySpecs acquired two companies specializing in wind turbine drivetrain monitoring and financial management, further expanding our asset management portfolio. Ultimately, this will help reduce the cost and risk of operations for the industry.

**What will you be getting into?**

We are seeking a highly organised and detail-oriented Finance Systems Integration Analyst to support the implementation and ongoing operation of the Horizon Finance platform. This role will help coordinate integrations between outsourced service providers (OSPs), client accounting systems, and internal reporting platforms.

Working closely with the Portfolio Manager for Integrations, the successful candidate will support data onboarding, monitor integration progress, troubleshoot data issues, and help ensure financial data is accurately uploaded and processed within Horizon Finance.

The role sits at the intersection of finance, technology, and operations, and requires strong analytical, communication, and organisational skills.

**As a Finance Systems Integration Analyst, you will:**

* Assist with onboarding new outsourced service providers (OSPs) to the Horizon Finance platform.
* Coordinate the collection of financial data from external accounting systems.
* Support the mapping of charts of accounts between OSP systems and the Horizon Finance structure.
* Review uploaded financial data for completeness and accuracy.

**Data Management & Validation:**

* Assist in preparing and transforming financial datasets for upload into Horizon Finance.
* Perform quality checks on uploaded accounting data and bank statement files.
* Investigate and resolve data discrepancies or formatting issues.
* Maintain documentation of data structures, mappings, and integration processes.

**Operational Coordination:**

* Act as a point of contact for OSP integration queries and follow up on outstanding data requests.
* Track integration progress across multiple funds and service providers.
* Maintain integration timelines and task lists.
* Assist in organising training sessions and guidance materials for OSP users.

**Reporting & Analysis:**

* Support reconciliation and validation of financial information within the platform.
* Assist in monitoring integration performance and identifying opportunities for process improvement.
* Prepare internal updates on integration progress and key issues.

**Continuous Improvement:**

* Help identify opportunities to streamline data ingestion and automation processes.
* Assist in testing new system features and enhancements within Horizon Finance.
* Support the development of best practices for financial and operational data integration.

**Requirements of the job:**

* 1–3 years of experience in finance operations, data analysis, or financial systems integration.
* Strong communicator who can collaborate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple integration processes and data onboarding timelines simultaneously.
* Solid analytical skills with experience in data mapping, reconciliation, and troubleshooting financial data discrepancies.
* Comfortable working in a fast-moving, evolving technology environment.

**Bonus Points:**

* Strong attention to detail and high accuracy in data entry
* Basic understanding of accounting principles or management accounts
* Solid comprehension of financial data structures and reporting
* Experience or interest in financial systems integration and technology

**Perks of the Job:**

* Time Off: Generous leave policy—among the best in the industry.
* Global Team: Work with teammates across 5 countries and diverse backgrounds.
* Impact: Help build the backbone of clean energy digital infrastructure.

title: Finance Manager, North America Transport Controllership
description:
**Description**
Amazon is seeking a Finance Manager to support Amazon Transportation Services, a leader in the global supply chain revolution through pioneering robotics, revolutionary automation initiatives, seeking sustainable solutions such as electric vehicles, and introducing one-day delivery for millions of products, in order to deliver billions of packages to delight customers.
  
  
The Finance Manager will own Financial Reporting and Analytics and ensure financial statements are correct in the transportation space for small parcels and last mile. Experience in this team opens up several career opportunities across Amazon. You will learn to produce insightful financial reporting, build robust and repeatable financial processes, controls, and perform in-depth analysis on transportation spend numbers. Given the nature of our business, you will learn to venture into unknown territory, and learn how to succeed in a new space.
  
  
This role partners across Transportation, Fulfillment, Supply Chain, and Technology teams to improve efficiencies while improving customer experience globally. This role works with business intelligence engineers, accountants, accounting managers, data engineers, program and product managers. This role creates a “learn by doing” environment by engaging with business and technology to promote and encourage continued customer focus. You will anticipate and resolve bottlenecks while balancing business needs and escalating where appropriate.
  
  
The successful candidate has demonstrated the following abilities: ability to develop insights using activity based costing, data analysis, econometrics, and statistics, and excellent verbal and written communication. This role will work in a dynamic environment working with some of the world's largest data sets in logistics costing. As such, the Finance Manager must combine excellent business analysis skills with the ability to derive actionable cost measures for consumption across Amazon.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Uses solid financial knowledge and business acumen to build financial models, interpret data, draw conclusions, and make recommendations that deliver results, drive improvements, and influence leaders throughout Amazon. These decisions can have global impact.
* Delivers weekly/monthly financial close. Uses financial systems, SQL, and advanced MSExcel functions to work with large data sets. Outputs analytical dashboards and reports, plans, forecasts, budgets, and consolidations.
* Drives continuous improvement and standardization of processes, including implementation of best practices in the controllership area.
* Supports financial reporting and operating planning, demonstrating finance acumen and ability to quickly adapt to different business needs.
* Prepares concise documents, tailored to various levels of stakeholders, and collaborates with operations’ leaders and other teams.
* Uses active listening skills intuitively to communicate data (both written and verbal) in a clear, concise, and unambiguous manner. Adjusts style for various audiences to articulate complex finance issues clearly.
* Collects and analyzes quantitative data to develop relevant reports that drive cost reductions.
* Participates in hiring, developing, and mentoring peers and team members. Seeks and leverages diverse perspectives in all activities.
* Identifies opportunities to resolve defects proactively. Improves, scales, or simplifies finance tools across teams and organizations.

A day in the life
  
  
The Finance Manager blends advanced reporting, data analysis, critical thinking and project management skills while understanding and further developing financial applications. A typical day in this role provides an opportunity to resolve ambiguous problems, build analytical dashboards and reports, own month end close deliverables, work with tech partners to resolve technical issues and ensure successful accounting automation launch for month end close processes.
  
  
**About The Team**
Transportation Controllership is a global finance team responsible for Financial Reporting activities, establishing Financial Control Frameworks and Advanced Analytics in the transportation space, including import, domestic inbound, warehouse transfer, and outbound shipments. We partner closely with transportation business units and tech teams as they work to continually refine and scale the business to keep pace with Amazon's rapid growth. Along with our partners in Accounting, we are responsible for the contractual and managerial closing of the books for Transportation spend.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 5+ years of tax, finance or a related analytical field experience
* 5+ years of multiple finance and accounting roles experience
* 6+ years of Accounts Receivable or Account Payable experience
* 6+ years of applying key financial performance indicators (KPIs) to analyses experience
* 6+ years of building financial and operational reports/data sets that inform business decision-making experience
* 6+ years of creating process improvements with automation and analysis experience
* 6+ years of participating in continuous improvement projects in your team to scale and improve controllership with measurable results experience
* Bachelor's degree in engineering, statistics or business, or Bachelor's degree and 5+ years of quantitative role (engineering, process re-engineering, quality assurance) experience

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 6+ years of identifying incomplete or inaccurate data, identifying the root cause and creating/implementing an escalation plan experience
* 6+ years of solving complex business challenges by delivering accurate and timely financial models, analysis, and recommendations that have a proven impact on business (e.g., financial savings, operational improvements, or customer benefits) experience
* MBA, or CPA
* Knowledge of SQL/ETL
* Experience working with large-scale data mining and reporting tools (examples: SQL, MS Access, Essbase, Cognos) and other financial systems (examples: Oracle, SAP, Lawson, JD Edwards)
* Experience delivering forecasting, budgeting, and variance analysis, and data interpretation of results

* Proven ability to learn and adapt to new standards, processes, and technologies rapidly, especially in AI and automation.
* Strong organizational and prioritization abilities; detail-oriented and skilled at data-driven decision-making.
* Flexible, collaborative, and innovative mindset with a commitment to continuous improvement through technology.
* Professional interpersonal skills; effective communicator and team player in a technology-driven environment.
* Comfortable achieving results against quantitative and qualitative performance metrics, utilizing automation where possible.
* Advanced IT skills, including Excel and Outlook, plus experience in AI and analytics platforms.
* Experience in a large multinational company preferred.

**Executive — Accounts, Admin & HR Support**
Zono Tradetech Pvt. Ltd. (ZoTok.ai)

🧾 Tally-First Accounts Role

* 🎬 HR & Social Media Enthusiasm

**About Zotok.ai**
ZoTok.ai is India's first AI-driven conversational commerce engine on WhatsApp — helping Brands, Distributors and Retailers digitise their order-to-cash flows. We are a fast-growing B2B SaaS product company headquartered in Hyderabad with a team of 80+ and growing.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a sharp, enthusiastic and well-rounded Executive whose core strength is in Accounts — someone who is hands-on with Tally, keeps books clean, and ensures nothing in billing or payments is missed. Beyond that, you will support day-to-day office administration, and bring genuine energy to HR support and employee engagement — including creating fun content for our Instagram and LinkedIn.
  
  
This role is ideal for someone who is not looking to be boxed in — someone who enjoys variety, takes initiative and wants to be a visible, contributing member of a lively team.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
**▸ Tally & Bookkeeping:**
Manage all day-to-day accounting entries in Tally — sales, purchase, receipts, payments, journal entries and bank reconciliation. This is your primary responsibility.
  
  
**▸ Invoice & Bill Processing:**
Collect, verify and process all vendor invoices and bills. Ensure timely entries and follow up with Finance for approvals and payments.
  
  
**▸ Petty Cash Management:**
Handle petty cash disbursements, maintain accurate daily records and submit timely reports.
  
  
**▸ Expense Tracking & Reconciliation:**
Track office expenses, record transactions and support monthly reconciliation with accuracy.
  
  
**▸ GST & Compliance Support:**
Assist with GST data compilation, TDS records and other statutory compliance documentation as directed by the Finance team.
  
  
**▸ Audit Readiness:**
Maintain well-organised records of bills, receipts, vouchers and agreements for audit and compliance purposes.
  
  
**▸ Vendor Coordination:**
Coordinate with vendors for supplies, maintenance and services. Collect invoices, follow up on deliveries and ensure timely closures.
  
  
**▸ Office Upkeep:**
Oversee day-to-day office operations — housekeeping, facility coordination and ensuring a clean, functional workspace.
  
  
**▸ Stock & Stationery Management:**
Maintain stock of office supplies and stationery. Monitor inventory levels and raise purchase requests before items run out.
  
  
**▸ Asset Register:**
Maintain an accurate register of office and IT assets — issuance, returns and condition tracking.
  
  
**▸ Other Admin Support:**
Assist with courier and dispatch, travel coordination, visitor management and any general office requirements as needed.
  
  
**▸ HR Support:**
Assist HR in employee documentation, record maintenance, attendance coordination and onboarding/exit formalities.
  
  
**▸ Employee Engagement Activities:**
Help plan and execute fun team activities, celebrations, birthday shoutouts and office events — your energy and ideas are welcome here.
  
  
**▸ Social Media Content:**
This is where your enthusiasm matters — capture moments from team events, celebrations and office life, and create fun, engaging posts and short videos for ZoTok's Instagram and LinkedIn. A creative eye and comfort with Reels/Shorts is a big plus.
  
  
**▸ Internal Engagement Posts:**
Coordinate with HR for milestone posts, anniversary shoutouts, new joiner welcomes and achievement callouts to keep the team spirit alive online.
  
  
**What We Are Looking For**
**▸ Experience:**
1.5–3 years in an accounts role with hands-on Tally experience. Exposure to admin or HR support is an advantage.
  
  
**▸ Education:**
B.Com, BBA or any graduate. Commerce background preferred.
  
  
**▸ Tally:**
Proficiency in Tally ERP / Tally Prime is essential — non-negotiable.
  
  
**▸ Accounts Knowledge:**
Working knowledge of GST basics, TDS, petty cash, bank reconciliation and expense tracking.
  
  
**▸ MS Office:**
Comfortable with Excel, Word and Google Sheets for day-to-day tracking and reporting.
  
  
**▸ Social Media Enthusiasm:**
Active on Instagram and LinkedIn. Comfortable creating short videos, Reels or fun posts. Formal design training not required — a creative instinct and willingness to try is what matters.
  
  
**▸ Attitude:**
Organised, proactive and cheerful. Someone who genuinely enjoys being around people and contributing to a positive office culture.
  
  
**▸ Communication:**
Good verbal and written communication in English and Telugu / Hindi.
  
  
**WHY ZOTOK?**
You will not be a back-office person here. Your accounts work keeps the company running, your admin support keeps the office humming, and your energy on social media keeps the team proud. If you want a role where your work is noticed across all three — this is it.
  
  
www.zotok.ai

title: Health Economics Associate
description:
**About Parexel**
Parexel is a leading global clinical development partner delivering insights-driven clinical and consulting solutions to the life sciences industry. With 22,000+ employees worldwide, we partner with biopharmaceutical companies and research sites to design and deliver patient-focused clinical trials that broaden access and make research a care option for anyone, anywhere.
  
  
We work with focus, agility, and shared purpose – moving with urgency to address patient needs and accelerate the delivery of new therapies. We embrace bold thinking, adapt quickly to change, and continually raise the bar for the speed and quality of clinical research. We are expanding our team and seeking talented individuals to help drive industry leading innovation, With Heart®.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking a Health Economics Analyst to join our team.As a Health Economics Analyst, you will contribute to the development of health economic models that evaluate the cost-effectiveness of health technologies for global reimbursement applications. This position plays a key role in advancing the economic evidence that supports patient access to innovative therapies worldwide. You'll collaborate with cross-functional teams including clinical, regulatory, and commercial partners, follow industry-standard processes, and contribute to project execution from model conceptualization through final delivery.
  
  
Responsibilities include data analysis, model building support, and assisting senior team members in project execution, with opportunities to deepen your expertise in health economics and expand your skills across clinical research and outcomes analysis. You'll join a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment focused on making a meaningful impact through rigorous economic evaluation and strategic reimbursement solutions. With diverse teams and continuous learning opportunities, the Health Economics Analyst can explore career paths and expand skills across health economics, outcomes research, and global market access.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Perform comprehensive data analysis to support health economic model development and validation
* Assist in building and adapting health economic models for country-specific applications and reimbursement requirements
* Conduct systematic searches for published health economic models and Health Technology Assessment (HTA) body guidance to inform model development
* Check and validate health economic models using appropriate software tools to ensure accuracy and elucidate the economic value of clients' products
* Support senior team members in project execution, including model documentation, quality assurance, and deliverable preparation
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand client needs and translate requirements into model specifications
* Maintain high standards of scientific accuracy and attention to detail in all analytical work and documentation
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of health economic modeling processes and methodologies

**You'll Thrive In This Role If You Bring**

* Strong analytical ability and attention to detail in complex quantitative work
* Advanced computing skills, particularly in Microsoft Excel with proficiency in macros and VBA
* Excellent written and oral communication skills, especially in conveying technical information clearly
* Experience working in healthcare, pharmaceutical, or regulated research environments
* Self-motivation, enthusiasm, and flexibility in a dynamic project-based setting
* Keen interest in medical research, healthcare delivery, and the pharmaceutical industry

**Required Qualifications**

* Master's degree or equivalent in a life science or quantitative discipline (health economics, economics, mathematics, statistics, or related field)
* Strong communication, organization, and problem-solving skills
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel
* High analytical ability and strong written accuracy

title: Sr Data Analyst
description:
‒ Review property, availability, tenancy and comp data as it moves through the Bronze, Silver and Gold layers, and flag quality issues before they reach downstream users.
  
  
‒ Build data validation checks, including AI-assisted checks such as anomaly detection, that catch bad data automatically rather than after the fact.
  
  
‒ Standardize CRE data fields, such as property type, rent type, rate type and lease structure, so the same term means the same thing across every source system.
  
  
‒ Define and track data quality metrics, including completeness, consistency, accuracy, timeliness and duplication rate, and report them to stakeholders on a regular cadence.

‒ Translate findings into business insights for brokers, researchers and leadership: build dashboards, write clear summaries and answer ad hoc questions.
  
  
‒ Partner with data engineers and AI engineers on upstream fixes, so quality issues get solved at the source, not patched downstream.
  
  
‒ Document data lineage, transformation logic and quality rules, so the team can audit and reproduce every number.
  
  
‒ Recommend AI and machine learning approaches to automate data validation work: anomaly detection, deduplication, document classification and similar.

‒ 6+ years of experience as a data analyst, ideally in commercial real estate, financial services or another data-heavy industry.
  
  
‒ Strong SQL skills and hands-on experience with Snowflake or a comparable cloud data warehouse.
  
  
‒ Experience with a Medallion (Bronze, Silver, Gold) or similar layered data architecture.
  
  
‒ A track record of building and improving data quality and validation frameworks, not just running one-off checks.
  
  
‒ Experience applying AI or machine learning to data quality work: anomaly detection, entity resolution, document extraction or similar.
  
  
‒ Comfort working with property, availability, tenancy and comparable sales (comps) data, or the ability to learn the domain quickly.
  
  
‒ Strong business acumen: you connect data findings to what they mean for brokers, asset managers and clients, not just what the numbers say on their own.

‒ Experience with a data catalog or data governance tool.

description:

**Job Description**
The Ares Corporate Treasury Department is responsible for capital planning, global cash and liquidity management, and foreign exchange risk mitigation across the organization’s multi-jurisdictional footprint. The department supports the business through several key functions spanning North America, EMEA, and Asia-Pacific, ensuring effective treasury operations across diverse regulatory, banking, and market environments, including:
  
  

* Balance Sheet Management: Developing strategies to leverage and monetize current and forecasted balance sheet assets across global entities and jurisdictions, while optimizing capital efficiency at both the corporate and regional levels.
* Capital Markets: Monitoring equity, debt, and loan capital markets to execute fundraising transactions that support anticipated capital requirements across multiple currencies and international markets.
* Liquidity and Cash Management: Forecasting and monitoring global cash needs, managing multi-currency liquidity structures, and facilitating cross-border transactions to support international entities and investment platforms.
* Foreign Exchange Risk Management: Identifying, evaluating, and executing derivative transactions to mitigate currency risks.

The Corporate Treasury Senior Associate will provide strategic support for the company’s global treasury team. This role is expected to participate in design, creation and maintenance of financial models and forecasts, the execution
  
  
of critical treasury activities and remain deeply involved in day-to-day cash, liquidity, and risk management across the organization. This role requires knowledge in treasury systems, experience operating in complex international environments, and a strategic mindset to drive global process standardization while accommodating regional requirements.
  
  
**Primary Functions And Essential Responsibilities**

* Perform cash management operations, including multi-currency cash pooling, intercompany funding structures, and short-term investment management across regions.
* Support treasury activities for fund groups, including Secondaries, Private Equity, and Co-investment.
* Support the management of credit facility activities, including forecasting facility requirements.
* Coordinate with regional finance teams across time zones to ensure optimal global cash positioning.
* Assist with the design, creation and implementation of liquidity and capital planning forecast models, including stress-testing functionalities.
* Collaborate with the Capital Solutions team to assess and monitor foreign exchange, interest rate, and counterparty risks.
* Drive initiatives for assessment and implementation of treasury workstations (e.g., Kyriba, FIS), including global system governance, regional workflow optimization, and integration with enterprise platforms.
* Drive enhancements and automation projects to improve visibility, efficiency, and accuracy in liquidity forecasting, cash management, payment processing, and reporting, including creation of PowerBi dashboards.
* Lead coordination for managing global cash positioning, banking relationships, and ensure compliance with internal controls and regulatory requirements.
* Participate to ensure compliance with internal controls, SOX requirements, and country-specific regulatory standards.
* Support global corporate treasury responsibilities, including rating agency relationships, financial commitments tracking, and other strategic transactions.
* Preparation, delivery, and presentation of global treasury reports to executive leadership.

**Qualifications**
**Education:**

* Bachelors Degree in Accounting, Economics or Finance

**Experience Required**

* 6+ years of experience in global Treasury or investment management.
* Demonstrated track record in hands-on forecasting, creation and maintenance of financial models.
* Comprehensive knowledge of treasury operations, including banking and cash management/forecasting in both U.S. and international contexts.
* Demonstrated experience partnering with business units to drive operational efficiency and collaborative outcomes
* Proficiency with treasury tools and banking portals, including familiarity with various payment methods and flows (local and cross-border wires, ACH).
* Strong technical acumen for solving complex problems using enterprise tools (report writers, SQL, Excel, Tableau/PowerBI, or Anaplan).
* Experience in business operations.
* Proven ability to lead process improvement and automation initiatives.
* Exceptional relationship management skills with banks and both internal and external stakeholders.

**General Requirements**

* Flexibility regarding role scope and willingness to take on new projects and acquire new skills.

* Ability to manage multiple priorities and competing demands; strong time management and prioritization skills.

* Sound judgment in escalating issues versus resolving problems independently.
* Analytical mindset with a passion for process efficiency and innovation.
* Comfort with ambiguity and uncertainty in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
* Flexibility in working hours to coordinate with team members across various time zones.

Principal, Treasury

title: Senior Manager - Strategic Finance
description:
**Location: Mumbai**
**Function: Finance**
**Reporting to: Head of Finance**
**About The Role**
We are looking for a high-calibre Senior Manager - Strategic Finance to join the Finance team and work closely with the Head of Finance and senior leadership team on some of CoinDCX's most important strategic, financial and enterprise-wide initiatives.
  
  
This is a high-visibility, high-ownership role for someone who can operate comfortably between strategy and execution. The individual will work on complex business problems, strategic planning, financial analysis, capital allocation, enterprise performance, financial infrastructure, crypto-asset reconciliation frameworks, financial processes and controls, and other high-priority initiatives led by the Head of Finance.
  
  
The ideal candidate will bring the structured problem-solving approach of a top-tier consultant, strong financial acumen and an operator's mindset.
  
  
This is not a traditional FP&A, Business Finance, Controllership or investment-banking role. The role is designed to be a strategic extension of the Head of Finance, focused on solving complex, ambiguous problems and driving high-impact initiatives across the organisation.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Strategic Finance & Enterprise Problem Solving
* Partner closely with the Head of Finance and senior leadership team on high-priority strategic and financial decisions.
* Take ownership of complex, ambiguous and cross-functional problems and develop structured, data-driven solutions.
* Analyse enterprise-level financial and operating drivers to support strategic decision-making, including cost structures, capital allocation, liquidity, cash deployment and operating leverage.
* Build financial models, scenarios and analytical frameworks to evaluate strategic choices and business decisions.
* Identify key risks, opportunities and value-creation levers and translate analysis into clear, actionable recommendations.
* Challenge existing assumptions and bring an objective, fact-based perspective to strategic discussions.
* Support Head of Finance in evaluating new initiatives, business models, strategic investments and other enterprise-level decisions.
* Special Projects
* Lead high-impact strategic projects sponsored by the Head of Finance, often involving multiple functions.
* Work across Finance, Product, Technology, Operations, Risk, Compliance and Business teams to solve complex problems.
* Drive projects end-to-end from problem definition to structuring, analysis, recommendation, stakeholder alignment and execution.
* Prepare high-quality decision-making materials for the Head of Finance, Executive Leadership Team and Board.
* Support strategic initiatives where there is no clearly defined playbook and where strong judgement and problem-solving are required.
* Act as a trusted execution partner and thought partner to the Head of Finance on critical initiatives.
* Establish project governance, milestones, decision points and accountability for Head of Finance-sponsored initiatives.
* Identify execution risks and proactively drive resolution across functions.
* Crypto & Financial Infrastructure
* Partner with Finance, Treasury, Operations, Product and Technology teams to strengthen crypto-asset and fiat reconciliation frameworks.
* Develop and enhance frameworks for reconciliation of customer balances, crypto assets, liabilities and financial records.
* Develop a strong understanding of complex transaction flows across wallets, exchanges, banking partners and internal systems.
* Identify systemic reconciliation gaps, control weaknesses and process inefficiencies and translate them into process, technology and control requirements.
* Design scalable frameworks for digital-asset financial reporting, reconciliation and operational finance.
* Partner with Technology and Controllership teams to drive automation of financial data flows, reconciliations and controls.
* Define requirements, control frameworks, exception-management mechanisms and governance processes for automated reconciliation.
* Monitor the effectiveness of reconciliation and financial-control frameworks through appropriate KPIs, exception reporting and governance mechanisms.
* Financial Strategy & Management Insights
* Develop enterprise-level financial insights beyond standard reporting to support strategic decision-making by the Head of Finance and leadership team.
* Build analytical frameworks to assess revenue drivers, cost structures, cash flows, liquidity, capital requirements and operating leverage.
* Support annual planning, forecasting and scenario analysis on strategic topics, where required.
* Identify opportunities to improve financial efficiency, capital utilisation and operating leverage at an enterprise level.
* Develop dashboards, analytical tools and management frameworks that enable senior leadership to make better decisions.
* Support Head of Finance in evaluating strategic trade-offs across growth, profitability, liquidity, risk and capital allocation.
* Capital Markets & IPO Readiness
* Support Head of Finance on IPO readiness and capital-markets-related initiatives as and when required.
* Work with investment bankers, auditors, lawyers and other external advisors on relevant projects.
* Support benchmarking, financial analysis, investor materials and management presentations.
* Help strengthen financial processes, reporting, governance and internal controls required for a potential public-market environment.
* Support projects relating to equity story, investor readiness, financial disclosures and capital-market benchmarking.
* Coordinate cross-functional workstreams required to close identified IPO-readiness gaps.

**What We Are Looking For**
We are looking for someone with exceptional analytical horsepower, structured thinking, financial depth and the ability to independently drive ambiguous, high-impact problems.
  
  
**Ideal Background**

* 8 to 12 years of experience in a top-tier management consulting firm, investment bank, Big 4 advisory practice, strategic finance or corporate finance role.
* Candidates from McKinsey, BCG, Bain, EY-Parthenon, Strategy&, Kearney, Deloitte, Accenture Strategy, Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley, JPMorgan and similar institutions would be relevant.
* Strong understanding of financial statements, corporate finance, financial modelling and business drivers.
* Excellent Gen AI capabilities.
* Demonstrated ability to break down complex and ambiguous problems into structured analytical frameworks.
* Ability to independently develop a point of view from incomplete or complex information.
* Strong commercial judgement and ability to translate analysis into actionable recommendations.
* Ability to operate independently with limited supervision and significant ambiguity.
* Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills, including the ability to influence senior stakeholders.
* High attention to detail combined with strong strategic judgement.
* Comfortable operating in a fast-moving, entrepreneurial and evolving environment.

**Preferred Experience**

* Strategic Finance / CFO Office experience.
* Top-tier consulting experience with significant exposure to financial services, fintech or technology.
* Experience leading complex, cross-functional transformation or strategic projects.
* Experience designing financial controls, reconciliation frameworks or financial infrastructure.
* Fintech / financial services / digital-asset experience.
* IPO / capital-markets exposure.
* Experience working with technology teams on automation of finance processes and data flows.

**What Success Looks Like**
The successful candidate will be capable of independently taking ownership of important strategic initiatives and driving them from ambiguity to execution.
  
  
**Success will be measured by the individual's ability to:**

* Independently solve high-priority, ambiguous problems.
* Drive strategic initiatives from problem definition through execution.
* Develop high-quality analysis and recommendations that materially improve management decision-making.
* Build scalable frameworks and automation rather than relying on manual processes.
* Strengthen financial governance and infrastructure without becoming the owner of day-to-day Finance operations.
* Work effectively across Finance, Product, Technology, Operations, Risk and Business teams.
* Become a trusted thought and execution partner to the Head of Finance.

title: Corporate Credit Underwriting (India, Bangladesh & Sri Lanka) – Vice President
description:
Whether you’re at the start of your career or looking to discover your next adventure, your story begins here. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to expand your skills and make a difference at one of the world’s most global banks. We’re fully committed to supporting your growth and development from the start with extensive on-the-job training and exposure to senior leaders, as well as more traditional learning. You’ll also have the chance to give back and make a positive impact where we live and work through volunteerism.
  
  
Citi continues to enhance its business control and governance framework by building out Institutional Credit Management (ICM), a first line of defense business line, to house and consistently manage credit risk activities performed for Citi’s institutional clients. ICM’s objective is to provide integrated end-to-end credit underwriting, identification, measurement, management, and monitoring for wholesale credit across the enterprise. Within ICM, the Credit Underwriting function (“ICM UW” or “UW”) provides credit analysis, underwriting, and first line of defense credit approval for periodic / material transaction reviews, and any necessary subsequent credit monitoring across all institutional business including Corporate Banking, Services, and Markets relationships.
  
  
ICM Credit Risk Analysts are responsible for a portfolio of relationships across India/Sri Lanka/Bangladesh, owning the Credit Risk Analysis for those relationships, and being responsible for the continuous monitoring of that portfolio. That includes the production of annual reviews, quarterly reviews, and the support of ad-hoc transactions and portfolio & industry reviews and stress testing, in partnership with Banking and Risk. title: Analyst/Associate – Private High-Grade Credit, Middle Office Operations
description:
Location: Mumbai, Maharashtra Team: PFS Job Requisition #: R266880 Date posted: Oct. 15, 2026

  

**Job description**
-------------------

**About this role**

**Company Description**

HPS Investment Partners, a part of BlackRock, is a leading global, credit-focused alternative investment manager that seeks to provide creative capital solutions and generate attractive risk-adjusted returns for our clients. We manage various strategies across the capital structure, including privately negotiated senior debt; privately negotiated junior capital solutions in debt, preferred and equity formats; liquid credit including syndicated leveraged loans, collateralized loan obligations and high yield bonds; asset-based finance and real estate. The scale and breadth of our platform offers the flexibility to invest in companies large and small, through standard or customized solutions. At our core, we share a common thread of intellectual rigor and discipline that enables us to create value for our clients.

HPS was established in 2007 as a unit of Highbridge Capital Management, LLC (“HCM”), a subsidiary of JPMorgan Asset Management (“JPMAM”). On March 31, 2016, the senior executives of HPS acquired HPS and its subsidiaries from JPMAM and HCM (the “Transaction”).Following the Transaction, JPMAM retained a passive minority investment in HPS, which was subsequently redeemed in April 2022. In June 2018, affiliates of Dyal Capital Partners made a passive minority investment in HPS. In February 2022, an affiliate of The Guardian Life Insurance Company of America made a passive minority investment in HPS, which was subsequently increased in August 2024. On July 1, 2025, BlackRock acquired the business and assets of HPS, with 100% of consideration paid in BlackRock equity (the “HPS/BlackRock Transaction”).

The HPS/BlackRock Transaction brings together BlackRock’s corporate and asset owner relationships with HPS’s diversified origination and capital flexibility. BlackRock and HPS have formed a new private financing solutions business unit (“PFS”) led by Scott Kapnick, Scot French, and Michael Patterson, creating an integrated franchise with approximately $370 billion in client assets, including $205 billion of private credit assets.This combined platform, which has more than 590 investment professionals and approximately 1,300 employees globally, offers broad capabilities across senior and junior credit solutions, asset-based finance, real estate, CLOs and GP-LP solutions. As part of the HPS/BlackRock Transaction, Scott Kapnick, Scot French, and Michael Patterson have joined BlackRock’s Global Executive Committee, and Scott Kapnick has been appointed as an observer to the BlackRock Board.

**Department Description**

The Middle Office team (MO) within Private Financing Solutions (PFS) – Blackrock’s private credit platform – is responsible for ensuring the Fund’s positions and cash balances are accurate. They manage the lifecycle of all trades/investments. They are responsible for trade capture, trade settlement, loan administration, daily cash and position reconciliations, corporate action elections/recordings, audit requests, new mandate onboarding, and PnL break analysis and resolution with fund administrators. MO handles ad-hoc requests that come from the deal team and/or separately managed account clients. The team interacts closely with the Deal Execution, Treasury, Fund Accounting, Fund Finance, Cash Management, Portfolio Analytics, Data Analytics, Valuations and the Deal Teams daily.

**Position Description**

PFS is seeking an Associate to join the High Grade Middle Office (HGMO) team. HGMO is a sub-group within Middle Office that focuses on the High Grade (private investment grade) platform.

The individual should be highly organized with strong attention to detail. They should have the ability to meet strict deadlines, work independently and as part of a team, as well as possess excellent critical thinking/problem-solving skills. The platform is scaling very rapidly, so the desire for a fast-paced environment is crucial.

This individual will be the PFS Middle Office team’s first hire in Mumbai and will have an opportunity to play a key role in building out the PFS Middle Office presence there.

Specific responsibilities will include but not be limited to the following:

* Researching and resolving cash breaks vs. custodians
* Researching and resolving position breaks vs. custodians/clients/administrators/other systems
* Play a key role in the daily reconciliation between HPS & BlackRock’s accounting systems
* Daily oversight of loan and security administration in the firm’s accounting system to support internal post close loan administration: tracking delayed fundings, contracts, coupon payments, factor payments, and maturities
* Investigate any transactional or accrual discrepancies that may arise
* Provide full trade life cycle operational support for products including but not limited to Bonds (Fixed & Floating Rate), Private Placements, ABS, Cross-Currency Swaps, Term Loans, Delayed Draw Term Loans, and Revolvers
* Work closely with custodians daily – fielding questions on how to apply cash, and building/providing amortization schedules for factored securities
* Assemble purchaser schedules with the information needed to close/fund new private placements
* Assist with confirming positions and providing support where needed for both internal and SMA auditors
* Daily interaction with internal and external groups to troubleshoot any booking and/or position discrepancies (Front Office/Fund Accounting/Fund Administrators/SMA Clients/Auditors)
* Assist with monthly tie outs of all positions & cash with SMA Client for AUM, Dry Powder, and Management Fee purposes
* Perform daily transaction reconciliation with Stat Accounting administrator, and monthly position/cost/market value reconciliation during the monthly lockdown process
* Ensure proper recording/accounting and cashflow reconciliation of cross-currency swaps
* Perform Detailed Investment Return reconciliation versus full fund administrator
* Collaborate with technology teams on automation and workflow enhancements; Execute User Acceptance Testing (UAT), including scenario testing and error resolution before production release
* Liaise with multiple internal groups such as accounting, product control, valuations, investment data, etc. to resolve open queries and perform additional responsibilities as required to support team objectives

**Candidate Profile**

* Graduate with a Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, or business related field
* 2-6 years of experience in middle office/operations; accounting experience is a plus
* Strong understanding of fixed income securities (private & public), cross-currency and/or interest rate swaps
* Trading and settlement
* Creation of securities/swaps in security master
* Life-cycle events: coupons, factors, amendments, tenders, maturity
* Cash and position reconciliation
* Strong Excel and Outlook Management Skills
* Use of lookups, pivot tables, and extensive formulas – with the ability to build from scratch at any time
* Ability to sort through high number of emails per day without missing anything important, responding in a timely manner, and escalating when necessary
* Enjoys problem solving and critical thinking
* Ability to resolve complex issues efficiently and independently by leveraging knowledge obtained via training as well as past experiences
* Curiosity; need to not just be willing but wanting to learn and build upon existing knowledge every single day
* Experience using trade/accounting/security master systems; FIS VPM, Aladdin, IVP Products, and/or Clearwater preferred
* Experience with Statutory Accounting is a plus

**Hybrid Work Schedule and Shift Timings**

* 4/1 split
* This role requires working a late shift to support stakeholders across EMEA and US time zones (e.g. 2 PM to 11 PM or 3 PM to 12 AM)

**Our benefits**
  
  
To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.

**Our hybrid work model**

BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.

  

**Guidance on AI use for candidates**

  

At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided **guidance** (opens in new window) on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.

  

**About BlackRock**

  
  

At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.

  
  

This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.

  
  

To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com (opens in new window). We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn (opens in new window), Instagram (opens in new window), YouTube (opens in new window), X (opens in new window), and TikTok (opens in new window).

title: Senior Finance Analyst
description:

DigiCert is a global leader in intelligent trust. We protect the digital world by ensuring the security, privacy, and authenticity of every interaction. Our AI-powered DigiCert ONE platform unifies PKI, DNS, and certificate lifecycle management, to secure infrastructure, software, devices, messages, AI content and agents. **Job summary**

We are looking for a highly analytical and detail-oriented Senior Financial Analyst – GTM FP&A to join our Finance organization. This role will report directly to the VP of FP&A and will play a key role in supporting the company’s GTM planning, reporting, forecasting, and financial modeling.

The ideal candidate has strong financial modeling and analytical skills, excellent attention to detail, and the ability to translate complex SaaS performance data into clear and concise reporting for senior leadership.

This role will have significant exposure to ARR, bookings, revenue, billings, churn, renewals, expansions, contractions, and retention metrics, with a particular focus on building and maintaining reporting models and executive-level reporting decks.

The position will be based in India and will work closely with Finance leadership in both India and the U.S. The role will also have a dotted-line relationship with the Director of Finance – India. 

**What you will do**

**SaaS Topline Reporting & Analysis**

Own and maintain recurring reporting for key SaaS topline metrics, including:

* + ARR
  + Bookings
  + Billings
  + Revenue
  + Dollar-based Gross Retention (GRR)
  + Dollar-based Net Retention (NRR)
  + Churn
  + Contraction
  + Expansion
  + New business
* Analyze monthly and quarterly performance against budget, forecast, and prior periods.
* Identify key drivers and variances within the SaaS topline and clearly communicate findings to Finance leadership.
* Maintain detailed customer and cohort-level analyses to support understanding of topline performance.
* Ensure accuracy and consistency of topline data across reporting models and management reporting.

**Financial Modeling & Forecasting**

* Build, maintain, and enhance financial models supporting SaaS topline forecasting and planning.
* Develop detailed models for ARR movements, customer retention, churn, contraction, expansion, and new business.
* Support monthly forecasting and annual planning processes.
* Perform scenario analysis and sensitivity analysis to evaluate different topline assumptions and business outcomes.
* Develop analytical models to help Finance leadership understand trends, risks, and opportunities within the SaaS business.
* Improve and automate existing models and reporting processes where appropriate.

**Management Reporting & Executive Presentations**

* Prepare recurring reporting packages and executive-level presentations for Finance and senior leadership.
* Build and maintain reporting decks highlighting topline performance, key trends, and variance drivers.
* Translate detailed financial and operational data into clear, concise insights for senior audiences.
* Support preparation of monthly, quarterly, and annual business reviews.
* Ensure reporting materials are accurate, timely, and presented in a clear and executive-friendly format.

**What you will have**

* **3+ years of experience**
  in FP&A, financial analysis, corporate finance, or a similar analytical role.
* Strong experience with
  **financial modeling, forecasting, and management reporting**
  .
* Experience working in a
  **SaaS or recurring-revenue business**
  is strongly preferred.
* Strong understanding of SaaS financial and operating metrics, including ARR, retention, churn, expansion, and contraction.
* Advanced Excel / Google Sheets skills with the ability to build complex financial models.
* Strong PowerPoint / presentation skills and experience creating executive-level reporting decks.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with exceptional attention to detail.
* Ability to work with large datasets and translate detailed analysis into clear business insights.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver accurate work within tight deadlines.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Experience with financial planning systems, BI tools, Salesforce, NetSuite, or similar systems is a plus.

**What We're Looking For**

* **Strong financial modeling skills**
  with a focus on building scalable, accurate models.
* **Exceptional attention to detail**
  and a high level of ownership over reporting accuracy.
* Someone who enjoys working with data and can quickly identify trends, anomalies, and key drivers.
* Strong ability to create
  **clear, polished reporting decks**
  for senior leadership.
* A self-starter who can operate independently while knowing when to escalate issues.
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-growth SaaS environment.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to explain financial concepts clearly.
* A mindset focused on continuously improving models, reporting, and processes.

**Reporting Structure**

This position will
**report directly to the VP of FP&A**
and will be based in India.

The role will also have a
**dotted-line reporting relationship to the Director of Finance – India**
, providing additional alignment with the broader India Finance organization.

**Key Success Measures**

Success in this role will include:

* Accurate and timely SaaS topline reporting.
* High-quality financial models that support forecasting and planning.
* Clear and insightful executive reporting decks.
* Strong understanding and analysis of ARR and retention movements.

**Benefits**

* Generous time off policies
* Top shelf benefits

Responsibilities include overseeing and managing the monthly financial close process, strategic planning, budgeting, and forecasting for the Freight sourcing business.

Improvements, data hygiene & system automation.

**About Cencora & Abfinco**
Cencora (formerly AmerisourceBergen) is a Fortune 10 global pharmaceutical distribution and solutions company operating in more than 65 countries. ABFinco is Cencora’s international in-house bank, providing central cash pooling, foreign exchange and intercompany funding services to international businesses including Alliance Healthcare, World Courier and PharmaLex. ABFinco manages exposures in more than 10 active currencies.
  
  
**ROLE PURPOSE**
The Senior Treasury Accountant will deliver accurate, timely and well-controlled accounting for ABFinco’s foreign exchange, intercompany lending and cash activities. The role owns treasury accounting from transaction capture in Kyriba through posting and reconciliation in SAP, leads the monthly close, and provides quality review and technical support to Shared Service Centre Treasury Analysts.
