title: Senior  Tax & Compliance Analyst - VCS
description:
What You'll Do
  
  
The Senior Analyst, VCS plays a critical role in strengthening the accuracy, scalability, and AI-enabled execution of Avalara’s U.S. Voluntary Compliance Services (VCS) operations across multiple jurisdictions and complex client environments. As client complexity, historical exposure, and voluntary disclosure volumes increase, this role ensures consistent SLA performance, reduces compliance and penalty risk, and embeds AI-driven workflow improvements that enhance productivity and quality. This individual contributor is expected to operate as a Bar Raiser, elevating execution rigor, mentoring junior analysts, and applying AI in measurable ways to improve speed, insight, and operational scale across the VCS lifecycle (from transactional data intake and nexus validation through data manipulation, analysis, processing, and reporting of historical returns prepared for filing).
  
  
**#Hybrid**
**What Your Responsibilities Will Be**
**How This Role Elevates Avalara**

* For Customers Delivers high-accuracy, on-time preparation of historical Sales & Use tax returns for filing — through data manipulation, analysis, processing, and reporting — across multiple jurisdictions, along with voluntary disclosure submissions, proactively mitigating exposure to penalties, interest, and audit risk.
* Acts as a senior point of contact for customers and their project managers, and as liaison with state taxing authorities for state voluntary disclosure / amnesty programs, providing clear status communication and documentation that help customers understand risk remediation and the outcome of their VCS engagements.
* For the Business Improves operational leverage by: Reducing manual effort in transactional data validation, reconciliation, pSTRA preparation, and notice handling.
* Standardizing VCS status, nexus, and exposure reporting. Accelerating turnaround for large historical scopes and complex multi-state disclosures.
* Supports margin and discount discipline by minimizing re-work, return revisions, and avoidable escalations.

**For The Team Raises Talent Density Through**

* Mentorship and coaching of juniors on VCS standards, nexus and exposure judgment, and client communication. Structured review and quality control discipline for voluntary compliance spreadsheets and historical returns.
* Sharing templates, SOPs, and AI-enabled best practices that uplift the whole team.
* For Our AI-First Strategy Improves turnaround time per voluntary disclosure / historical project.
* Increases accuracy and consistency across returns, disclosure spreadsheets, and periods. Raises analyst productivity and independence by leveraging AI-enabled workflows already defined for the team.

**Responsibilities (Outcome-Based Ownership)**

* Own end-to-end preparation, processing, analysis, and quality assurance of historical Sales & Use tax data and returns for multi-period, multi-jurisdiction VCS engagements — including custom pSTRA, Tax Summary Reports, and voluntary compliance spreadsheets submitted to state taxing authorities — so returns are accurate and ready to be filed, delivering ≥99% accuracy and 98–100% on-time SLA adherence.
* Independently manage complex reconciliations and variance analysis between client transactional data, prior filings, and proposed disclosure returns, including altering or adding transaction data where required while maintaining clear audit trails.
* Serve as the senior primary point of contact for customers and their project managers, and as liaison with state taxing authorities for state voluntary disclosure / amnesty programs, owning sensitive negotiations and status conversations.
* Maintain a 24-hour turnaround time for critical client escalations and compliance inquiries related to voluntary disclosures, historical returns, notices, or exposure questions.
* Demonstrate deep understanding of complex, historical transaction-level data and U.S. Sales & Use tax law, ensuring data is accurately validated, troubleshot, transformed, and reported — including nexus setup — so historical returns and disclosures are prepared and ready to be filed.
* Improve document and data retrieval turnaround time by 15–25% using AI-supported research, pattern recognition, and tracking tools.
* Standardize weekly VCS status, nexus, risk, and exposure reporting using AI-enabled formatting and summarization tools.
* Identify and implement at least one scalable AI-enabled workflow enhancement within the first 6 months, with clear measurement of productivity or quality impact.
* Manage relationships with customers, project managers, state taxing authorities, and internal/external Avalara partners throughout the VCS lifecycle to ensure alignment on scope, timelines, risks, and outcomes, including proactive de-escalation through direct customer calls when needed.
* Mentor I1/I2 analysts in independent case handling, nexus and exposure analysis, high-quality documentation, client-ready narratives, and effective, compliant AI usage.
* Maintain and continuously improve SOP documentation for VCS (data intake, nexus validation, reconciliation, pSTRA preparation, disclosure submission, return preparation for filing, notice handling, and closeout) aligned to client contracts, jurisdictional rules, and Avalara standards.
* Provide proactive support to CAMs and Sales to help drive successful voluntary compliance and remediation sales cycles, including answering scoping questions, joining key client calls, and providing clear, data-backed delivery perspectives.

**AI Bar Raiser Expectations**

* The Senior Analyst, VCS must demonstrate exceptional applied AI capability that produces measurable operational impact, not just experimentation.
* This includes: Embedding AI tools into transactional data cleansing and enrichment, reconciliation and variance explanation, nexus and historical exposure summaries, pSTRA preparation, and VCS escalation workflows.
* Quantifying impact (e.g., time saved per engagement, reduction in manual review hours, improved turnaround time per disclosure period, fewer rework cycles).
* Applying AI responsibly while exercising professional judgment, especially for compliance-sensitive topics such as taxability, nexus determinations, exposure estimates, and final return values. Sharing AI best practices (prompts, workflows, validation steps) to elevate team capability and embed them into SOPs.
* Continuously identifying automation opportunities aligned to efficiency, risk reduction, scalability, and consistent client experience.
* Casual or convenience-based AI usage does not meet Avalara’s AI Bar Raiser standard.

**12-Month Success Signals**

* Within 12 months, the Senior Analyst, VCS will demonstrate: Sustained ≥99% preparation accuracy across their VCS portfolio (returns prepared for filing, disclosure spreadsheets, amendments, and corrections).
* 98–100% on-time performance for agreed VCS SLAs, including during peak workload and complex multi-state disclosures.
* 15–25% reduction in document and data retrieval turnaround time through AI-enabled research, tracking, and templated requests.
* Measurable reduction in re-work and re-opened engagements via robust validation controls, better upstream scoping, and AI-supported checks.
* At least one implemented AI-driven workflow enhancement (e.g., automated variance narratives, pSTRA/template builders, data-mapping accelerators) delivering quantifiable productivity gains.
* Documented AI and process best practices adopted across the VCS team and incorporated into SOPs.
* Strong independent handling of complex escalations, including high-exposure periods, nuanced jurisdictional and nexus rules, and sensitive client and state-authority scenarios, with minimal senior intervention, including proactive de-escalation through direct client calls and clear, solution-focused communication.

What You’ll Need To Be Successful
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Commerce, Accounting, Taxation, Finance, or related field; or MBA in Finance.
* 3–4+ years of U.S. indirect tax / Sales & Use tax compliance experience, ideally including voluntary disclosure, amnesty, or remediation programs.
* Demonstrated experience managing multi-jurisdiction return portfolios and handling compliance escalations (e.g., notices, penalty and interest issues, nexus questions).
* Advanced MS Excel proficiency (complex formulas, pivot tables, macros/VBA, large data-set handling) and demonstrated ability to work with complex historical transaction data to prepare accurate disclosures and historical returns ready for filing.
* Proven experience using AI tools to improve operational speed, quality, or scale (for example, in data analysis, documentation, or reporting workflows).
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex historical tax, nexus, and exposure topics in clear, client-friendly language to customers, project managers, and state taxing authorities.
* AI is embedded in our workflows, decision-making, and products. Success here requires embracing AI as an essential capability.
* You’ll bring experience using AI and AI-related technologies, ready to thrive here.
* You’ll apply AI every day to business challenges - improving efficiency, contributing solutions, and driving results for your team, our company, and our customers.
* You’ll grow with AI by staying curious about new trends and best practices, and by sharing what you learn so others can benefit too.

Avalara is an AI-first Company
  
  
AI is embedded in our workflows, decision-making, and products. Success here requires embracing AI as an essential capability.
  
  

* You’ll bring experience using AI and AI-related technologies, ready to thrive here.
* You’ll apply AI every day to business challenges - improving efficiency, contributing solutions, and driving results for your team, our company, and our customers.
* You’ll grow with AI by staying curious about new trends and best practices, and by sharing what you learn so others can benefit too.

How We’ll Take Care Of You
  
  
Total Rewards
  
  
In addition to a great compensation package, paid time off, and paid parental leave, many Avalara employees are eligible for bonuses.
  
  
Health & Wellness
  
  
Benefits vary by location but generally include private medical, life, and disability insurance.
  
  
Inclusive culture and diversity
  
  
Avalara strongly supports diversity, equity, and inclusion, and is committed to integrating them into our business practices and our organizational culture. We also have a total of 8 employee-run resource groups, each with senior leadership and exec sponsorship.
  
  
**What You Need To Know About Avalara**
We’re defining the relationship between tax and tech.
  
  
We’ve already built an industry-leading cloud compliance platform, processing over 54 billion customer API calls and over 6.6 million tax returns a year. Our growth is real - we're a billion dollar business - and we’re not slowing down until we’ve achieved our mission - to be part of every transaction in the world.
  
  
We’re bright, innovative, and disruptive, like the orange we love to wear. It captures our quirky spirit and optimistic mindset. It shows off the culture we’ve designed, that empowers our people to win. We’ve been different from day one. Join us, and your career will be too.
  
  
**We’re An Equal Opportunity Employer**
Supporting diversity and inclusion is a cornerstone of our company — we don’t want people to fit into our culture, but to enrich it. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, age, gender, national orientation, disability, sexual orientation, US Veteran status, or any other factor protected by law. If you require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know.

title: Litigation Manager (4-5 years)
description:
**Position Overview**

Delhivery is looking for a law graduate with 4–5 years of relevant litigation experience to join its Litigation team in Gurugram. The role involves independently managing litigation filed by or against Delhivery across India — commercial, recovery, labour, consumer, civil and criminal matters — including reviewing notices received, drafting and vetting replies, notices, written statements and evidence, and formulating and recommending strategy on the way forward for current and existing matters. The candidate will monitor all pending litigation; coordinate with internal business and ground teams to gather evidence and inputs for replies, notices, written statements and other court/tribunal filings; and manage and coordinate with external counsel, including assigning new matters and overseeing how they are handled. The ideal candidate will have sharp legal acumen and the ability to strategise, and will be resourceful, organised and people-oriented, with strong follow-up skills and the ability to manage cases independently with minimal supervision.

**Key Responsibilities**

***1. Litigation Management & Drafting***

• Independently manage and respond to commercial, recovery, labour, consumer, civil and criminal matters across India; review notices received and draft, vet and finalize replies, notices, written statements, pleadings and evidence before filing.

• Take the call on assigning matters to external counsel, driving litigation strategy, filings and hearings, and proactively flag risks and escalations to management.

• Track litigation timelines, monitor court proceedings, maintain accurate, up-to-date trackers and ensure timely resolution of issues such as AR attendance, document filing and orders with external counsel.

***2. Evidence & Internal Coordination***

• Coordinate with internal departments (HR, Security, Finance, Revenue Assurance) and business/ground teams to obtain accurate data and factual inputs; manage, protect and collate evidence for use in replies and pleadings.

• Draft responses independently or route them to counsel, and review counsel's drafts for accuracy and alignment with the company's position before filing.

• Act as the primary liaison between the Litigation team, internal stakeholders and external counsel; drive timely documentation, appearances and compliance across functions.

***3. Counsel & Court Coordination***

• Coordinate with external counsel for hearings, filings, conferences and documentation, representing the Litigation team's interests throughout.

• Facilitate execution of affidavits, vakalatnamas and authorisations, and coordinate attendance of company representatives and witnesses before courts and authorities, ensuring adequate preparation.

***4. Strategy, Team & Operations***

• Strategise and advise business teams on legal escalations and potential litigation, recommending a course of action based on risk assessment; identify recurring issues and recommend process or policy changes.

• Own day-to-day litigation operations, calendars, document repositories, litigation reports, counsel invoices and court-fee approvals and drive improvements in tracking and document management.

**Qualifications & Experience**

• LL.B. from a recognised university or institution.

• 4–5 years of relevant litigation or litigation-management experience (in-house or law firm) across commercial, recovery, labour, consumer, civil or criminal matters.

• Demonstrated experience independently managing litigation end-to-end, with minimal supervision.

• Familiarity with court procedures, particularly in Delhi/NCR.

• Proven experience coordinating with external counsel and internal stakeholders on case strategy.

• Ability to independently navigate court and tribunal websites.

Bar Council enrolment preferred.

**Key Skills & Attributes**

• Sharp legal acumen with strong drafting and reviewing skills across notices, pleadings and evidence.

• Resourceful, proactive and solution-oriented, with the confidence to own matters and a small team independently.

• Strong analytical ability and sound judgment in assessing litigation risk and strategy.

• Excellent follow-up skills and the ability to drive closure of action items across stakeholders.

• Clear, confident communication skills, both written and verbal.

• High level of organization, attention to detail and ownership.

• Ability to manage multiple matters, a small team and competing priorities under pressure.

Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and litigation trackers; high integrity and professionalism.

title: Company Secretary
description:
You will serve as the Company Secretary for SATL and GTCI, ensuring strong corporate governance, regulatory compliance, board management, statutory filings, investor relations, and secretarial operations for a listed entity and group companies in India.
  
  
**Job Summary**
As the Company Secretary for Goodyear South Asia Tyres Private Limited and Goodyear Technology Centre India Private Limited, you will support the end-to-end corporate governance, regulatory compliance, and secretarial functions for a listed entity and two group companies in India. You will partner with leadership, legal, finance, and external stakeholders to ensure compliance with the Companies Act, 2013, SEBI regulations, stock exchange requirements, and best-in-class governance standards.
  
  

* Corporate Governance & Compliance
* You will ensure compliance with the Companies Act, 2013, SEBI (LODR) Regulations, and other applicable statutory requirements for a listed company and two group companies in India.
* You will support the implementation and monitoring of corporate governance frameworks, policies, and compliance practices.
* You will track regulatory changes and advise relevant stakeholders on compliance implications.
* You will demonstrate strong knowledge of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, Related Party Transactions, Dividend regulations, Insider Trading regulations, Takeover Code, Materiality requirements, and other applicable regulatory provisions.
* Board, Committee & General Meetings
* You will support the planning, coordination, and execution of Board Meetings, Committee Meetings, and Annual General Meetings.
* You will prepare and circulate agendas, board packs, notices, resolutions, and supporting documentation.
* You will draft, finalize, and maintain minutes and records in accordance with statutory and regulatory requirements.
* Statutory Filings & Regulatory Reporting
* You will ensure timely filings with the Registrar of Companies (RoC), SEBI, and Stock Exchanges.
* You will prepare and submit periodic disclosures, quarterly and annual filings, annual returns, and other regulatory reports within prescribed timelines.
* Secretarial Documentation & Records
* You will maintain statutory registers, records, and corporate documentation as required under the Companies Act and SEBI regulations.
* You will support the preparation of AGM Notices, newspaper publications, annual reports, and other statutory communications.
* Investor Relations & Shareholder Services
* You will manage shareholder communications and coordinate with the Registrar & Transfer Agent (RTA).
* You will respond to investor queries and shareholder grievances in a timely and effective manner.
* You will support dividend-related activities, including declaration processes, payments, and unpaid dividend management.
* Postal Ballot & IEPF Compliance
* You will manage the end-to-end postal ballot process and related secretarial compliances.
* You will ensure compliance with Investor Education and Protection Fund (IEPF) requirements, including transfer of shares, unclaimed dividends, and related filings.
* Insider Trading & Internal Compliance Systems
* You will manage and monitor internal compliance tools and Code of Conduct systems.
* You will ensure compliance with the SEBI (Prohibition of Insider Trading) Regulations and maintain all related records and disclosures.
* Cross-Functional Coordination
* You will work closely with legal, finance, and other internal teams to ensure alignment on compliance and governance matters.
* You will support the implementation of compliance calendars, governance processes, and internal control mechanisms

**Experience**

* You should be a qualified Company Secretary (CS) with 8+ years of post-qualification experience in corporate secretarial, governance, compliance, and regulatory affairs functions.
* You have hands-on experience working in a listed company environment, with strong exposure to the Companies Act, 2013, SEBI (LODR) Regulations, SEBI (Prohibition of Insider Trading) Regulations, Related Party Transactions, Takeover Code, and corporate governance requirements.

Goodyear is one of the world's largest tire companies. It employs about 63,000 people and manufactures its products in 48 facilities in 19 countries around the world. Its two Innovation Centers in Akron, Ohio, and Colmar-Berg, Luxembourg, strive to develop state-of-the-art products and services that set the technology and performance standard for the industry. For more information about Goodyear and its products, go to www.goodyear.com/corporate
  
  
Goodyear is an equal employment opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any characteristic protected by law.

title: Senior Family Office Service and Compliance
description:
**Gurnani Family Office (Marken Capital) | Gurugram | In-office**

Experience: 10+ years

**About the Family Office**

**Marken Capital**
is the single-family office of the C.P. Gurnani family and operates as a sub-entity within the family operating business,
**Assago Group.**

The family office manages capital across public markets, private companies and external managers,

alongside the family's wider financial and administrative affairs, including cross-border structures, group companies, real estate, trusts and succession planning.

**The Role**

This role
**anchors the service and compliance function of the family office**
—
**family-office operations, cross-border compliance, banking, tax, portfolio administration, entity governance and family engagement.**
This is not a conventional back-office role. It involves cross-border filings, entity administration, portfolio data integrity, and the working relationships with the banks, advisors and fund managers the office depends on.

The role requires someone
**who can take ownership without constant supervision, understand when to act independently and when to escalate, and bring structure to complex financial and administrative matters.**

The successful candidate will become a key operating partner to the family and will provide functional oversight and coordination across the family-office operations team.

Family-office experience is preferred but not essential. Strong candidates from private banking service and compliance, Big Four compliance or tax, or similar multi-entity financial operations roles will also be considered.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Banking, Onboarding and Asset Consolidation**

* Run KYC and re-KYC cycles across all entities and family members, in India and offshore.
* Manage digital onboarding onto new investment platforms and funds; map and consolidate assets across banking relationships.
* Handle fund drawdowns, capital calls and distributions — tracking notices, arranging payment and confirming credit.

**Portfolio Data & Reporting**

* Own the family office reporting platform — historical data migration, position tagging and valuation reconciliation across custodians.
* Collect and reconcile monthly statements across roughly a dozen institutions — private banks, wealth platforms, PMS managers and AIFs.
* Prepare consolidated cross-asset portfolio reviews and strategic insight summaries for family decision-making.

**Tax, Trust & Succession**

* Coordinate ITR filings and entity financials with the family CA.
* Manage advance tax, trust administration and reporting cycles with the offshore trustee and administrator.
* Support domestic and overseas trust and will formation for succession planning.
* Assemble cost-basis and transaction history across two decades of holdings.

**Stakeholder Management**

The role coordinates a wide external network — private bankers, custodians, wealth advisors, execution partners, Big Four advisors, the family CA, offshore corporate secretaries, fund managers and trustees. Keeping these parties aligned and to timetable is a
**substantial and continuous part of the work.**

**Cross-Border Transactions & Compliance**

* Manage reporting and compliance for the family's
  **offshore investments**
  , drawing on a working knowledge of overseas investment regulations.
* Administer the
  **Liberalised Remittance Scheme (LRS)**
  across family members — tracking utilisation against annual limits per individual, preparing Form A2 and supporting declarations, coordinating remittances with the authorised dealer bank, and maintaining the audit trail for overseas investments and offshore accounts.
* Manage
  **offshore entity compliance**
  for the group structures — annual returns and AGMs, IRAS tax filings, statutory records, and coordination with the corporate secretary and tax agents.
* Liaise with the
  **auditors**
  and external advisors to ensure compliance with all applicable statutory and regulatory requirements.
* Lead LLP formations and administration for new investment vehicles, including ROC filings and related secretarial work.

**Real Estate and Group Companies**

* Oversee property documentation, mutation processes and developer payment schedules.
* Support group company matters including share certificates, board records and transaction
* documentation.

**Family Engagement**

* Serve as a
  **trusted operational point of contact for family members**
  on financial, administrative and investment-related matters.
* Communicate clearly and proactively, particularly where multiple advisors or institutions are involved.
* Maintain at least one in-person meeting or interaction each month with senior family members.

**What We Are Looking For**

**Experience**

* 10+ years in a single or multi-family office, private banking service and operations, Big Four compliance or tax, or a similar multi-entity financial operations role.
* Familiarity with property documentation and mutation processes, and with company secretarial records. This is an additional requirement not mandatory.

**Core Attributes**

**Ownership**
: Takes responsibility from initiation through completion.

**Organisation:**
A high standard of personal organisation, and comfort bringing structure to complex, multi- party processes.

**Judgement:**
A clear sense of which decisions sit with the role, which belong to the family, and which require a professional's sign-off.

**Attention to detail:**
Comfortable working with financial records, regulatory filings, entity structures and historical transaction data where accuracy is critical.

**Composure**
: Steadiness under a calendar of statutory deadlines that do not move.

**Communication:**
Able to communicate comfortably with family members, senior advisors, bankers, lawyers, accountants and investment professionals.

**Discretion:**
Absolute confidentiality is non-negotiable. The role involves access to highly sensitive family, financial, investment and personal information.

**Apply at hr@assagogroup.com**

**Job Title:**
Specialist, Financial Operations

  
  

**Role:**
This role aligns with industry titles such as Contract Analyst, Contract specialist, or Contract reviewer analyst (legal)

  
  

Role Purpose

  
  

The Specialist, Contract Operations is an experienced individual contributor responsible for the accurate, timely and controlled processing of complex contractual information across global businesses. The role combines hands-on contract analysis and system expertise with quality assurance, issue resolution, stakeholder partnership, and technical guidance to colleagues. It supports consistent contract operations from agreement receipt and interpretation through data entry, approval, archival and downstream readiness.

  
  

**Role Value**

  
  

Protects contractual and financial data quality, strengthens operational controls, resolves complex processing issues, and enables reliable royalty and rights administration.

  
  

**Key Accountabilities**
**1.**
**Contract Analysis and Processing**

  

  
* Review, interpret and process executed agreements, amendments and supporting documentation, including complex commercial, rights and royalty terms.
  
  
* Validate contract and financial data before approval, ensuring that information entered by colleagues is complete, accurate and aligned with the underlying agreement.
  
  
* Apply sound judgement to identify ambiguous, conflicting or adverse clauses and route matters to the appropriate business, legal, portfolio or operational stakeholder for resolution.
  
  
* Ensure contract records and supporting documents are accurately indexed, archived and readily retrievable.
  

  

**2.**
**Quality Assurance, Controls and Service Delivery**

  

  
* Perform quality checks and approvals in line with documented procedures, delegated authority and segregation-of-duties requirements.
  
  
* Monitor assigned work against service levels, turnaround expectations and operational priorities, taking timely action where delivery or data quality is at risk.
  
  
* Comply with standard operating procedures, control requirements, data retention standards and privacy obligations.
  
  
* Identify control gaps, recurring errors and operational risks, document findings and recommend practical corrective or preventive actions.
  

  

**3.**
**Data Integrity and Systems Expertise**

  

  
* Maintain accurate, complete and dashboard-ready contract data across relevant operational regions and systems.
  
  
* Use contract and rights management platforms effectively, applying strong knowledge of system dependencies and downstream impacts.
  
  
* Support data remediation, reconciliations, system testing and process changes where contract expertise is required.
  
  
* Maintain auditable trackers and records that provide clear status, ownership and evidence of completion.
  

  

**4.**
**Complex Query Resolution**

  

  
* Own complex contract-processing queries through to resolution, completing appropriate investigation and maintaining a clear audit trail.
  
  
* Provide accurate and timely guidance to Contract Operations, Portfolio, Rights, Royalties, Finance, Technology and other relevant stakeholders.
  
  
* Escalate material contractual, control or delivery risks with clear facts, impact assessment, options and recommended next steps.
  

  

**5.**
**Technical Leadership and Continuous Improvement**

  

  
* Act as a subject-matter resource for contract interpretation, processing standards, controls and systems within the Contract Processing Hub.
  
  
* Coach and support colleagues through knowledge sharing, peer review and practical guidance, without direct people-management accountability.
  
  
* Contribute to the maintenance of procedures, training materials, checklists and control documentation.
  
  
* Use root-cause analysis and operational insight to simplify processes, reduce avoidable rework and improve quality, consistency and stakeholder experience.
  
  
* Support automation and transformation initiatives by translating contract requirements into clear business rules, test scenarios and acceptance criteria.
  

  

**6**
**. Stakeholder Partnership**

  

  
* Build effective working relationships across global and regional teams, communicating complex issues in a clear, concise and commercially aware manner.
  
  
* Influence outcomes within agreed authority, balancing contractual accuracy, control requirements, service delivery and business needs.
  
  
* Participate in operational reviews and cross-functional forums, providing evidence-based updates and following actions through to closure.
  

  

**Decision-Making and Scope**

  

  
* Works independently within established policies, procedures, controls and delegated authority.
  
  
* Handles varied and complex work where solutions require analysis, interpretation and the application of specialist knowledge.
  
  
* Makes recommendations on contract treatment, operational risk and process improvement, escalating matters that require legal, commercial or policy decisions.
  
  
* Operates across multiple global business areas and adapts priorities in response to changing volumes, deadlines and stakeholder requirements.
  

  

**Experience and Qualifications**

  

  
* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Legal Studies, Commerce or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
  
  
* Minimum 3 years of relevant experience in contract administration, rights and royalties, finance operations, legal operations or a comparable processing environment.
  
  
* Demonstrated experience reviewing complex agreements, maintaining high-quality data and working within structured service and control frameworks.

title: Company Secretary

SN Capital Management Pvt. (Official Page) is a financial consultancy and treasury solutions firm specializing in strategic financial instruments for a diverse client base. The company provides wealth management, investment banking, corporate finance and advisory, as well as brokerage and distribution services across equities, commodities, mutual funds, structured products, insurance, corporate deposits, bonds, and loans. Serving institutions, corporations, high-net-worth individuals, and families, SN Capital Management combines market expertise with robust risk management practices. With a strong in-house technical team and the trust of over 3,000 clients, the firm focuses on helping clients build wealth through equity, pre-IPO, and unlisted share opportunities. Candidates joining the organization can expect a performance-driven, client-focused environment with exposure to complex financial products and advisory work.

The Company Secretary will be responsible for ensuring compliance with corporate laws, securities regulations, and internal governance standards, while supporting the board and management in decision-making. Day-to-day tasks include preparing and maintaining statutory registers and records, drafting minutes of board and general meetings, and coordinating filings with regulatory authorities such as the Ministry of Corporate Affairs and relevant stock or securities bodies. The role also involves advising on corporate restructuring, monitoring changes in legal and regulatory frameworks, and implementing best practices in corporate governance. The Company Secretary will collaborate with finance, legal, and senior leadership to manage shareholder communication, support audits, and oversee documentation for corporate actions and investments. This is a full-time, on-site role based in Noida.

* Professional qualification as Company Secretary (CS) from the Institute of Company Secretaries of India (ICSI), with strong knowledge of Companies Act, SEBI regulations, and other applicable corporate laws.
* Experience in corporate governance, board secretarial work, and compliance management within financial services, investment banking, or wealth management environments.
* Proficiency in drafting and reviewing legal and corporate documents, including board minutes, resolutions, agreements, and statutory filings.
* Strong analytical and risk-awareness skills for interpreting regulations, assessing compliance implications, and supporting complex financial and corporate transactions.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to interact effectively with board members, regulators, auditors, and internal stakeholders.

* Prior experience in a NBFC, investment firm, or consulting/treasury solutions company is an advantage.

description:
Prasanna Law Chambers (PLC) is a law chambers based in Delhi/NCR that specializes in a wide variety of Criminal Cases. The firm and its associates handle matters across Delhi/NCR and focuses on Trial Court and High Court Practice. Please only apply if you are comfortable travelling to Noida Sector 127 and stay in office till 8:30 PM.

**PLEASE NOTE BEFORE APPLYING AND APPLY ONLY IF YOU CAN FULFIL AND COMFORTABLE WITH THE FOLLOWING:**

* **Apply only if you are committed to work in the hardcore Criminal Litigation- Trial Court and High Court. If you have basic understanding of criminal law and some experience in trial court work.**

* **The work includes visiting jails of Delhi, meeting clients there and visiting all the trial courts of Delhi.**

* **The office is in Sector 127 Noida and we are in office usually till 8:30 PM, so apply if you are comfortable with the timings and working at the said location. Preference would be given to someone living in Noida.**

* **Please do not apply if you are looking for short term work, since in litigation you need to spend substantial time to learn basic of trial, therefore, if you are willing to work for 2-3 years minimum, you are welcome to apply.**

* **If you are comfortable with challenging work of criminal trial including cases related to murder, NDPS, UAPA, MCOCA, POCSO, Cheating etc. - which involves drafting, research, cross examination and arguments in courts.**

**Role Description:**

This is a full-time on-site role for a Litigation Associate at Prasanna Law Chambers located in
**Noida, Sector 127 (near to HCL & Amity Law School).**
The Litigation Associate will be responsible for handling day-to-day tasks associated with litigation in various courts in Delhi/NCR, including:

* A to Z brief of the matter, preparation of list of dates, Drafting of Bail Applications, Misc. Applications, Revision Petitions, drafting of divorce and other matrimonial related matters. Detail research on matters including proper preparation of Criminal Trial Matters, finding case laws, preparing for cross examination, and representing clients in courts, including arguments. Research and preparation for Arguments in High Court.

* Filing of cases, obtaining vakalatnamans from Jails and other related misc. work of court.

* Good drafting skills and prior experience in drafting is mandatory.

* If you have the right skills, you get the liberty to handle the matter A to Z (including arguments and Cross Examination) with all the guidance from the seniors and other colleagues.

description:
Job Description At Boeing, we innovate and collaborate to make the world a better place. Were committed to fostering an environment for every teammate thats welcoming, respectful and inclusive, with great opportunity for professional growth. Find your future with us. Job Description - Experienced Avionics System Service Engineer Overview Boeing is the worlds largest aerospace company and a leading provider of commercial airplanes, defense, space, and security systems, and global services. Building on a legacy of over a century of innovation and leadership, Boeing continues to lead the way in technology and innovation, customer delivery, and investment in its people and future growth of aerospace. In India, Boeing has been a strong partner to the Indian aerospace and defense sectors for more than 80 years. People at Boeing have been supporting mission readiness and modernization of Indias defense forces, and enabling connected, safer, and smarter flying experiences, in the sky, in the seas, and in space. Technology for today and tomorrow The Boeing India Engineering Technology Center (BIETC) in India is leveraging a diverse talented pool of 5,500+ engineers, technologists, and innovators to drive growth and innovation in the global aerospace sector These engineers deliver cutting-edge RD, innovation, and high-quality engineering work in global markets in traditional and emerging areas, and leverage new-age technologies such as AI/ML, IIoT, Cloud, Model-Based Engineering, and Additive Manufacturing, to enhance quality, safety, and productivity for airline customers, shaping the future of aerospace in India for India, and the world. People-driven culture At Boeing, we believe creativity and innovation thrives when every employee is trusted, empowered, and has the flexibility to choose, grow, learn, and explore. We offer variable arrangements depending upon business and customer needs, and professional pursuits that offer greater flexibility in the way our people work. We also believe that collaboration, frequent team engagements, and face-to-face meetings bring diverse perspectives and thoughts enabling every voice to be heard and every perspective to be respected. No matter where or how our teammates work, we are committed to positively shaping peoples careers and being thoughtful about employee well-being. At Boeing, we are inclusive, diverse, and transformative. With us, you can create and contribute to what matters most in your career, community, country, and world. Join us in powering the progress of global aerospace. Position Responsibilities Boeing India Engineering has an immediate opening for Avionics Systems Customer Support Engineer (Communications, Navigation, Surveillance systems). The primary responsibility in this role will be addressing and resolving in-service issues related to airplane Network recording, cabin display systems, Auto-Flight, Flight Management Systems Air Data/Inertial Reference Systems, Communications, Navigation, Surveillance systems In this role, you will also be tasked with: working directly with airline customers to analyze Network recording, cabin display systems, Auto-Flight, Flight Management Systems Air Data/Inertial Reference Systems, Communications, Navigation, Surveillance systems, developing and performing tests to ensure system designs meet operational and functional requirements, and monitor supplier performance to ensure system integration and compliance with requirements. The position requires flexibility to address emergent issues and support important airline meetings off-hours. This position may also require an occasional off-shift work schedule to support the fleet operating 24/7/365. Willing to support a 24/7 on-call rotation schedule and the ability to work variable shifts, including weekends or overtime You will be an integral part of supporting all Boeing Commercial Airplane models in-service and under development, including programs such as 747, 767, 777, 787, 737NG, 737 MAX, 777X, and the next generation of commercial airplanes. This position will focus on providing 24/7 support to Boeing commercial airplane customers Develops and documents moderately complex electronic and electrical system requirements Designs hardware, software and interface specifications. Tests and validates to ensure system designs meet operational and functional requirements Assists in monitoring supplier performance to ensure system integration and compliance with requirements Solves problems concerning fielded hardware and software over the entire product lifecycle. Research specific technology advances for potential application to company business needs. Basic Qualifications (Required Skills/Experience) Bachelors degree in engineering with, 8-10 years or masters degree in engineering with 7-11 years and related work experience. Must be flexible, with a high tolerance for organizational complexity and ability to work with partners from within Boeing and outside, across different cultures and time-zones Candidate must be a self-starter with a positive attitude, high ethics, and a track record of working successfully under pressure in a time-constrained environment. Must be very fluent in spoken and written English and have excellent communication style. Ability to mentor and teach subordinates and partners to accomplish project and departmental goals and objectives. Preferred Qualifications (Desired Skills/Experience) Have experience working with Boeing 7XX series, EE Systems service engineering especially on Network recording, cabin display systems, Auto-Flight, Flight Management Systems Air Data/Inertial Reference Systems, Communications, Navigation, Surveillance systems Prefer candidate that is proficient in using ATA Specification aircraft maintenance documentation, including manuals, and service actions. title: Academic Counsellor
description:
Jaro Education | CDO Role Guide 
 jaro education 
 Job Description & Candidate Preparation Guide 
 Career Development Ocer (CDO) 
 1. About Jaro Education 
 Jaro Education is India's most trusted online higher education company and a pioneer in the executive 
 and online education industry. Founded in 2009 by Dr. Sanjay Salunkhe, the company has been self- 
 funded and protable since inception. Jaro Education has been honored with the EdTech Leadership 
 Award and recognized as a National Best Employer by the World HRD Congress. 
 Jaro Education bridges the gap between top-tier global academic institutions and ambitious 
 professionals. The organization nurtures entrepreneurs and working executives across entry-level to C- 
 Suite roles through strategic aliations with globally renowned universities and business schools, 
 including: 
 IIMs: IIM Ahmedabad, IIM Indore, IIM Kozhikode, IIM Mumbai, IIM Nagpur, IIM Tiruchirappalli, 
 IIM Visakhapatnam 
 IITs and IIT-linked institutions: IIT Bombay, IIT Delhi, IIT Jammu, IIT Palakkad, IIT Roorkee, 
 E&ICT Academy IIT Kanpur, E&ICT Academy IIT Guwahati, IITM Pravartak IIT Madras 
 Technology Innovation Hub 
 Other premier Indian institutions: IISc, XLRI, IMT Ghaziabad, Loyola Institute of Business 
 Administration (LIBA), IFEEL Institute for Future Education, Entrepreneurship and Leadership, 
 MIT Institute of Design / MIT IDSS, Niranjan Hiranandani School of Real Estate & HSNC University 
 Indian Universities and Higher Education Partners: Adani Institute of Digital Technology 
 Management, Amity University, Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham, Bharati Vidyapeeth / BVDU, 
 Chandigarh University, Dayananda Sagar University (Bengaluru), Dr. D. Y. Patil Vidyapeeth 
 Centre for Online Learning (DPU-COL, Pune), Dr. M.G.R. Educational and Research Institute, JAIN 
 Online, MAHE Manipal Academy of Higher Education, Manipal University, Manipal University 
 Jaipur, Parul University, Sikkim Manipal University, Symbiosis International (Deemed University) / 
 SSODL 
 Global Academic and Executive Education Partners: Deakin University (Australia) & KPMG 
 in India, Harvard Business Impact, Imperial College Business School Executive Education, Rotman 
 School of Management (University of Toronto) & IITM Pravartak, Wharton Interactive 
 Company Vision: To be globally recognized for providing a seamless learning platform for professionals 
 around the world. 
 Page 1 of 5 
 
 
 
 Jaro Education | CDO Role Guide 
 Company Mission: To make high-quality, outcome-oriented executive education accessible to every 
 student and professional at all stages of their career. 
 2. Role Overview & Snapshot 
 The Career Development Ocer (CDO) / Inside Sales Specialist plays a critical role in driving 
 business growth by engaging with working executives, assessing their career goals, and counseling them 
 on higher education options. This is an end-to-end sales and counseling role that combines lead 
 generation, relationship building, and consultative program matching. 
 Designation 
 Career Development Ocer (CDO) / Inside Sales Specialist 
 Admissions & Executive Education Sales 
 Department 
 Target Audience 
 Working Days 
 Working Professionals, Corporate Executives & Freshers 
 Monday to Saturday (Sunday Weekly-O) 
 10:00 AM to 7:00 PM (Note: Shift may stretch basis business 
 requirements) 
 Working Hours 
 Dress Code 
 Mon Fri: Business Formals | Saturday: Smart Casuals 
 Primary CRM Tool 
 LeadSquared 
 3. Key Responsibilities & Performance Expectations 
 High-Volume Lead Outreach & Prospecting 
 ¢ Connect daily with a minimum of 80 working professionals sourced from the LeadSquared CRM 
 database to build a healthy sales pipeline. 
 ¢ Initiate conversations using cold-calling and warm lead nurture strategies, establishing rapid rapport 
 with high-potential prospects. 
 Consultative Counseling & Needs Analysis 
 ¢ Analyze candidate professional backgrounds, current skills, domain expertise, and future career 
 aspirations. 
 ¢ Identify skill gaps and recommend optimal executive programs, degree courses, diplomas, or 
 certications from Jaros university partners. 
 ¢ Conduct structured telephonic, virtual, or in-person counseling sessions detailing curriculum 
 highlights, faculty credentials, learning methodologies, and career outcomes. 
 Page 2 of 5 
 
 
 
 Jaro Education | CDO Role Guide 
 End-to-End Sales Execution & Enrolment 
 ¢ Guide prospects through the complete sales funnelfrom cold calling to lead nurturing, objection 
 handling, fee negotiation, and nal enrolment closures. 
 ¢ Maintain consistent, personalized follow-up schedules with high-intent leads to maximize conversion 
 rates. 
 ¢ Meet or exceed assigned daily activity deliverables, weekly conversion targets, and monthly revenue 
 metrics. 
 Operations & Data Management 
 ¢ Maintain accurate, real-time records of lead statuses, meeting notes, follow-up dates, and payment 
 stages in LeadSquared. 
 ¢ Coordinate closely with internal Admissions, Student Support, and Operations teams to ensure a 
 seamless onboarding experience for enrolled learners. 
 ¢ Stay up-to-date with evolving EdTech trends, institutional accreditation updates, and competitor 
 oerings. 
 4. Candidate Prole & Prerequisites 
 ¢ Education & Experience: Bachelors degree in any discipline. Freshers with exceptional 
 communication skills or candidates with prior sales/EdTech outreach experience are preferred. 
 ¢ Communication Skills: Fluency in English with strong verbal, written, and persuasive articulation 
 capabilities. 
 ¢ Sales Mindset: High competitive drive, negotiation skills, objection-handling capability, and comfort 
 working in target-driven environments. 
 ¢ Interpersonal Skills: Empathy, active listening, and the ability to build immediate rapport with mid-to- 
 senior working professionals. 
 ¢ Technical Savvy: Basic familiarity with Microsoft Oce (Excel, Word) and CRM applications like 
 LeadSquared. 
 5. Career Growth Pathway 
 ¢ Structured Career Path: Opportunities to transition from CDO to Senior CDO, Team Leader, 
 Assistant Manager, and Business Manager based on performance and target achievements. 
 Page 3 of 5 
 
 
 
 Jaro Education | CDO Role Guide 
 Interview Preparation Kit 
 Please review the following instructions and preparation guidelines before attending your interview with 
 Jaro Education. 
 A. General Interview Hygiene & Rules 
 1. Professional Appearance: Dress in business formals (MonFri style) to demonstrate 
 professionalism. 
 2. Technical Setup: Ensure a stable high-speed internet connection, functional camera/microphone, 
 and a silent, distraction-free environment for virtual meetings. 
 3. Communication Delivery: Keep answers crisp, structured, and focused. Avoid lengthy anecdotes 
 or o-topic details. 
 4. Energy & Condence: Demonstrate high energy, enthusiasm, and articulate speech throughout 
 the conversation. 
 5. Past Employer Etiquette: Maintain a strictly positive, objective, and factual approach when 
 discussing previous employers. Do not speak negatively about former companies or colleagues. 
 B. Fundamental Concepts to Master 
 1. What is EdTech? 
 Denition: EdTech (Educational Technology) refers to the integration of technology, software, and 
 hardware tools into educational processes to enhance learning accessibility, engagement, and 
 eectiveness. 
 Industry Context: Explain why online higher executive education is essential todayallowing 
 working professionals to upskill without pausing their full-time careers. 
 2. What is Consultative Selling? 
 Denition: A sales approach focused on prioritizing the buyer's needs, challenges, and goals rather 
 than aggressively pushing a product. 
 Application at Jaro Education: As a CDO, you do not simply "sell a course." You rst identify a 
 professionals career bottlenecks, understand their skill gaps, and then recommend the specic 
 executive program that aligns with their career growth. 
 Page 4 of 5 
 
 
 
 Jaro Education | CDO Role Guide 
 C. Sample Interview Questions & Preparation Strategies 
 Important Note: Interview questions may change from person to person depending on individual 
 candidate proles and interviewer evaluation. The questions below are representative FAQ example 
 types to aid your preparation. 
 ¢ "Walk me through your resume and key achievements." 
 Tip: Focus on your outreach metrics, target achievements, past sales/counseling experience, and 
 everyday responsibilities. 
 ¢ "Why do you want to build a career in the EdTech industry?" 
 Tip: Highlight the rapid growth of the online education sector, your passion for career counseling, and 
 the impact of upskilling working professionals. 
 ¢ "How do you handle a candidate who says the program fee is too high?" 
 Tip: Demonstrate consultative sellingreframe the fee as a long-term career investment, highlight the 
 prestige of partner institutes (e.g., IIMs, IITs, Wharton Interactive, Harvard Business Impact), and 
 discuss nancial exibility (EMIs, loan support). 
 ¢ "What is your reason for leaving your current/previous role?" 
 Tip: Provide an honest, professional, and growth-oriented answer (e.g., seeking better exposure, 
 career progression, or entry into the EdTech industry). 
 ¢ "How do you explain gaps in your career (if applicable)?" 
 Tip: Be transparent, condent, and concise. Explain how you utilized the gap period productively 
 (certications, skill-building, personal responsibilities). 
 D. Quick Checklist Before Joining the Interview 
 Researched Jaro Educations company background, leadership (Dr. Sanjay Salunkhe), vision, and 
 mission. 
 
 Memorized key partner institutions across categories (e.g., IIMs, IITs, IISc, XLRI, Wharton Interactive, 
 Harvard Business Impact). 
 
 Prepared to explain past key performance indicators (KPIs), call targets, and sales achievements.

title: Sales Analyst
description:
Analyst, Sales Updated: August 4, 2026 
 Company Overview Motivated by unwavering values, and ingrained with a passion for innovation, Michelman is a global developer and manufacturer of specialized sustainable chemistry used in industrial and agricultural coatings, digital printing, consumer packaging, and advanced composites for automotive and aerospace. From helping grow food and keep it fresh, to making vehicles lighter and more fuel efficient, to shielding our homes from the elements, Michelmans environmentally conscious solutions protect and enhance the materials that shape our world. 
 General Summary Reporting to the Asia Sales Director, provide analytical, project and systems support to the Sales Directors, Sales Associates and Asia Region. Provide Sales Process oversight and compliance in order to effectively communicate results, identify risks and drive efficiency within the Sales Department. 
 Primary Responsibilities Sales Analysis: Analyze historical results, identify trends, recommend adjustments to projections and serve as the central partner to inform Sales Directors on important developments. Support analysis of SalesForce opportunities and business at risk. Provide quarterly analysis of the opportunities portfolio evolution at market segment level. Report Generation: Prepare scheduled and ad hoc reports. Preparation of Monthly Commercial reports, including projected figures for the full year and sales pipeline analysis. Financial Objectives: Participate in the development and implementation of annual operating plans with focus on Volume, Revenue and Price projections. The role includes tracking of the monthly reforecast and relevant deviations as well as rebate monitoring and calculation. Price Coordination: Work in close collaboration with the product management team to identify cost and profit variations and coordinate the implementation of price changes. Market Segmentation Management: Maintain high level of focus on customer intimacy through accurate customer segmentations, adherence to service level offerings and coordination with regional peers to ensure global consistency. Team Work: Assist with the reporting and communication of sales opportunities, strategies and progress. Help the sales team by identifying gaps and maintaining SalesForce opportunities and volume forecasts. Systems Expertise: Be an expert in critical Sales Process systems including but not limited to JD Edwards, Cognos, Power BI, SalesForce and any other pertinent systems. Work with IT to improve the use of technology tools including AI to improve timely sales metrics and reporting. Process Improvement : Assist Sales Directors in the design and maintenance of processes which improve sales effectiveness. Special Projects: Lead or represent the Sales Department in sales specific or cross-functional teams and perform special projects as needed. This includes Force Majeure coordination and weekly Sales orders follow up with a cross-functional team. Administrative Support: SalesForce support, follow-up on contracts, rebates, NDAs, cleaning of item codes, base prices, customer accounts, etc., in the system. Other: Perform related duties as assigned or as the situation dictates. 
 Critical Competencies, Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities Equipped with professional sales analytics capabilities. Capable of sales performance forecasting using historical data and statistical analysis. Able to build, maintain and optimize sales KPI reports and dashboards to track business performance and support data-driven sales strategies. Highly proficient in Salesforce, CRM systems and sales enablement tools. Expertly skilled in Microsoft Office, especially Excel as well as PowerPoint and Outlook for business delivery. Possess rigorous attention to detail, capable of managing and optimizing system utilization to support daily sales operations efficiently. Strong presentation and cross-functional communication skills. Effectively deliver analytical findings, align stakeholders and influence data-driven business decisions. Capable of independent work and multi-task management. Organize and deliver multiple concurrent projects accurately and efficiently from initiation to completion. Strong ownership, accountability and result orientation. Proactively collaborate and deliver reliable, high-quality outcomes fully aligned with organizational goals. Agile in adapting to evolving business needs. Proactively identify optimization opportunities and drive continuous process and performance improvement. 
 Education and Experience Bachelors degree in a Business Administration, Marketing, Finance, Statistics, or a related field. A minimum of 5 years of relevant experience, preferably in a multi-national company. Combining sales operations or data analysis for a large team across Asia. Advanced proficiency in IT system tools like JDE, SalesForce, Power BI, Microsoft Office Suite (specifically Excel for data analysis and PowerPoint for presentations) is essential. Familiarity with a formalized sales process, such as Miller-Heiman. Fluent English speaker. 
 Other Able to travel up to 10% of the time by car or plane to visit regional base of customers. Based in Mumbai, able to perform job duties at remote locations such as industrial sites, customer centers, and other locations.

The role will support recruitment across Manufacturing, Projects, Operations & Maintenance (O&M), Sales & Marketing etc. The incumbent will ensure accurate recruitment records, timely follow-ups with candidates and hiring managers, and effective utilization of recruitment platforms to improve hiring efficiency and reduce recruitment turnaround time. Key Responsibilities Recruitment & Candidate Sourcing: Support end-to-end recruitment activities, from receiving approved manpower requisitions to candidate onboarding. Source candidates through Naukri, LinkedIn, employee referrals, social media, recruitment databases, and other relevant channels. Screen resumes against job descriptions and shortlist suitable candidates based on qualifications, experience, skills, and salary expectations. Maintain a pipeline of suitable candidates for current and anticipated manpower requirements. Follow up with recruitment consultants and staffing agencies wherever required. Interview Coordination & Follow-up: Coordinate interview schedules with candidates, HR, and hiring managers. Share interview details, job descriptions, and other relevant information with candidates. Collect interview feedback and update recruitment trackers promptly. Follow up with shortlisted candidates regarding subsequent interview rounds, salary discussions, offers, and joining dates. Maintain regular communication with candidates to minimize dropouts and offer declines. Recruitment Administration & HRMS: Create and maintain job postings on Naukri and the company s HRMS. Ensure recruitment activities and candidate details are updated accurately in the HRMS and recruitment trackers. Maintain records of applications, shortlisted candidates, interviews, offers, selected candidates, and joining status. Prepare recruitment MIS reports and hiring status updates for management review. Maintain proper documentation of approved requisitions, candidate evaluations, and recruitment-related records. Offer Management & Onboarding Coordination: Coordinate with HR and concerns for offer approvals and salary discussions. Follow up with selected candidates for document submission and acceptance of offers. Track offer-to-joining status and maintain regular contact with candidates during the notice period. Coordinate pre-joining formalities and hand over relevant information to the onboarding team. Record reasons for candidate dropouts, offer declines, and non-joining cases. Recruitment MIS & Performance Tracking: Monitor recruitment turnaround time (TAT) and hiring status against approved requirements. Track the number of resumes sourced, candidates shortlisted, interviews conducted, offers released, and candidates joined. Monitor utilisation of Naukri and other approved recruitment channels. Identify delays in interview feedback, candidate selection, offer release, and joining. Assist in preparing weekly and monthly recruitment dashboards and reports. General HR Support: Support campus recruitment, walk-in interviews, and recruitment drive as required. Assist in maintaining candidate databases and recruitment documentation. Coordinate with internal stakeholders to clarify manpower requirements and hiring priorities. Perform other recruitment-related and HR administrative activities assigned by the reporting manager. description:

 Work Location: Sector 68, Faridabad, Haryana
 Employment Type: Full-time
 Preferred Candidates: Immediate joiners Job Summary We are looking for an experienced IT Support & Infrastructure Engineer with strong hands-on experience in IT operations, network administration, server setup, and end-user support. The candidate will be responsible for maintaining IT infrastructure, troubleshooting network and system issues, managing users and devices, and ensuring smooth day-to-day IT operations. Support end users with desktops, laptops, printers, Microsoft 365, email, VPN, and connectivity issues. Track and resolve incidents and service requests within agreed timelines. 2. Network Administration Configure, monitor, and troubleshoot LAN, WAN, Wi-Fi, VPN, routers, and switches. Troubleshoot TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, IP addressing, and network connectivity issues. Assist with firewall configuration, network security, and access control. Coordinate with internet service providers and external vendors to resolve network issues. 3. Server & Infrastructure Management Hands-on experience with server setup, installation, configuration, and maintenance. Support Windows Server environments, Active Directory, Group Policy, and user access management. Assist with server hardware, storage, backup, recovery, and patch management. Monitor infrastructure performance and troubleshoot server and system issues. Support endpoint security, antivirus, software updates, and IT security policies. Assist with infrastructure upgrades, system migrations, and disaster recovery activities, where required. 4. IT Operations & Vendor Coordination Maintain IT documentation, asset registers, network diagrams, and configuration records. Coordinate with external IT service providers, hardware vendors, and network service providers. Work with internal and international IT teams to resolve technical issues. Provide regular updates and communicate technical issues clearly to stakeholders. Required Skills & Qualifications Bachelors degree or diploma in Computer Science, Information Technology, Networking, or a related field. Minimum 4 years of relevant experience in IT support, network administration, server administration, or IT infrastructure management. Mandatory networking certification: CCNA or another recognized, relevant networking certification. Practical knowledge of LAN/WAN, TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, VPN, routers, switches, and basic firewall concepts. Hands-on experience with Windows operating systems, Microsoft 365, Active Directory, and user account administration. Practical server setup and troubleshooting experience. Strong problem-solving, communication, documentation, and coordination skills. Willingness to work from the office at Sector 68, Faridabad, Haryana . Preferred Certifications – Added Advantage ITIL 4 Foundation. Microsoft Azure Administrator or Microsoft 365 certifications. Microsoft Endpoint Administrator. CompTIA Network+ or Security+. Red Hat Certified System Administrator (RHCSA). Cisco CCNP or other advanced networking certifications. Do you have experience with Windows Server, Active Directory, Microsoft 365, backup, and endpoint management? Current CTC. Expected CTC. Notice period and earliest joining date. Are you willing to work from the office at Sector 68, Faridabad ? Yes/No. Interview Process The selection process will consist of three rounds: Round 1 – Initial Screening: Experience, certification, technical background, communication skills, and location suitability. Round 2 – Technical Assignment: Practical technical assessment. Round 3 – Management Round: Final discussion with management. How to Apply Interested candidates can send their updated CV along with the above details to: Email: nimmee@techsarthy.in Immediate joiners and candidates serving their notice period will be preferred. Please mention S enior IT Support & Infrastructure Engineer – Faridabad in the email subject line.

If you are passionate about building impactful technology and working alongside talented global teams, Rightsline offers the platform to grow, innovate, and make a meaningful difference. 
 What You Will Own: 
 Instance Configuration & Governance Own all shared configuration in our company-managed Jira Cloud instance: custom fields, screens and screen schemes, field configurations, workflows and workflow schemes, work types and hierarchy levels, priorities, resolutions, and permission and notification schemes. Apply and enforce the discipline company-managed Jira requires establish whether an object is shared before changing it, and when it is, copy it, scope the copy to the project, and change the copy. Most instance damage comes from skipping this step. Own and maintain all the Atlassian sister products like Confluence, Jira Service Desk, and Jira Product Discovery Maintain naming conventions that make configuration ownership obvious at a glance, and run a recurring audit that catches projects drifting back onto shared objects. Keep the custom-field estate from growing unchecked: reuse before creating, scope through field contexts rather than editing shared ones, and retire fields no longer in use. Own project creation and decommissioning, and grant permissions to project roles rather than named individuals so access survives staffing changes. 
 Workflow, Automation & App Administration Translate how teams actually work into workflow, status, and board configuration and propose the lighter alternative when a request is better solved by a convention than by new configuration. Publish workflow changes safely, including migrating in-flight work when statuses change, and keep board column mappings in step so nothing lands in an unmapped state. Build and maintain Jira Automation rules, scoped correctly so one team's rule does not surface in another team's menus. Administer our Marketplace apps including their own scoping settings, and evaluate new apps before they become permanent. 
 Confluence & Process Documentation Own Confluence spaces, permissions, templates, and page hierarchy. Partner with engineering leads to get our delivery process written down and kept current: status definitions with owners and exit criteria, work-type guidance, Definition of Ready and Definition of Done, and branch-naming requirements. Company-managed Jira cannot hold per-project helper text, so Confluence is where this lives. Write short, durable runbooks for recurring requests, and train team leads to self-serve the routine changes. 
 Reporting, Data & Integrations Protect the conventions our delivery metrics depend on — the estimation field, status names, issue-key format, and what counts as a defect. Breaking one of these produces wrong numbers rather than an error message, so you are the last line of defence. Own the data contract behind our delivery-analytics platform (Plandek): which fields and statuses it reads, and what a rename would cost. Write JQL that answers non-trivial questions, build filters and dashboards, and run bulk changes safely. Use the Jira Cloud REST API for work with no UI path — bulk version creation, field inventories, and pulling issue changelogs for time-in-status and flow metrics. Changelog data cannot be reached through CSV export, so this is a working requirement rather than a bonus. Maintain the Jira–Git integration that drives status transitions, along with the Zendesk, Salesforce, and Sentry connectors. 
 Access, Compliance & Support Produce access-review and change-management evidence for SOC 2: who holds admin rights, who holds elevated issue permissions, and what changed when. Own Atlassian onboarding and offboarding, licence allocation, and seat cost management. Be the first and last stop for “Jira is broken” — diagnosing with the tooling (permission helper, automation audit logs) rather than reasoning from first principles, since most reports resolve to a handful of known causes. Collaborating with cross-functional teams Ensure compliance with ISO 27001, SOC 1, SOC 2 frameworks 
 What You Bring: 5+ years administering Atlassian Cloud, including hands-on ownership of a company-managed (not only team-managed) Jira instance where multiple projects share configuration. This is our most important requirement: team-managed-only experience does not transfer, because the whole difficulty of this role is shared configuration. Atlassian Certified Professional (Jira Administration or Jira Service Management). ScriptRunner (Groovy), or comparable depth administering Marketplace apps. Jira Service Management, Atlassian Guard / Access, or Atlassian Analytics. Experience with a delivery-metrics platform (Plandek, LinearB, Jellyfish, Sleuth) and the Jira data hygiene it requires. Having led a team-managed to company-managed migration, or a Server / Data Center to Cloud migration. Familiarity with SOC 2 or comparable audit evidence collection. Exposure to AI-assisted development tooling and how its activity should be represented in Jira. Demonstrated ownership of workflows, screen and field configuration schemes, issue type schemes, and permission schemes — you have built them, published them, and migrated existing issues through a status change. Jira Automation at a competent level: multi-step rules, smart values, branching, and correct rule scoping. Confluence administration: spaces, permissions, and templates. Strong JQL, plus filters, dashboards, and safe bulk operations. Scripting against the Jira REST API in Python, JavaScript, or equivalent, including token authentication, pagination, and changelog extraction. Judgment about blast radius — before changing anything you check what else depends on it, and you can be trusted with an instance twenty teams rely on. Willingness to push back: declining the request that would add a field nobody fills in or a status nobody exits, and proposing the lighter alternative. Clear written communication, a habit of documenting as you go, and experience working effectively with colleagues across time zones.

Brief: The HR Generalist will be managing and executing full spectrum of HR from recruitment, payroll processing, learning and development, engagement etc, ensuring compliance with legal and company requirements. This HR Generalist will serve as a key member of the HR function, which is vital to the overall success of the organisation through effective recruitment strategies, efficient payroll processing and smooth sailing HR operations. 
 Key Responsibilities: Recruitment and Talent Acquisition: Manage the full recruitment cycle, from creating job descriptions to sourcing, screening, identifying effective job boards, conducting / coordinating interviews, making job offers, preparing offer letters and other documentations. Post job openings on selective job boards, social media platforms, community groups etc. Screen resumes and applications, conduct initial interviews, and assess candidate suitability that align with the culture, vision, mission and value of the company. Coordinate and schedule interviews between hiring managers and candidates. Assist in developing recruitment strategies to meet staffing needs and attract top talent. Negotiate and extend job offers, including salary and benefits packages. Maintain an updated database of candidates and recruitment activities. 
 Payroll Processing and Administration Prepare, process and verify the accuracy of bi-weekly/monthly payroll for all employees. Ensure that payroll is processed in compliance with company policies and local labour laws. Oversee payroll deductions, benefits and reimbursements. Ensure the employee attendance and leave application records are maintained and updated from time to time. Identify opportunities for streamlining payroll processes which align with Group HR (HQ) and implementing best practices. Stay updated on Indian labour laws, tax regulations, and government policies affecting payroll. Ensure accurate and timely filing of government remittances other statutory contributions. Assist in audits related to payroll compliance and reporting. Work closely with Group HR on every HR matter, manpower planning and comply with Group Policy as well as Labour Laws. Maintain accurate payroll records and documentation. Manage and update employee data in the payroll system, including new hire information, salary adjustments, and terminations. Ensure confidentiality and security of payroll information. Generate payroll reports for management review, including overtime, deductions, and other payroll-related analyses. Support financial reporting with relevant payroll data for month-end and year-end closing. Act as a point of contact for employee payroll inquiries and concerns. Provide guidance to employees on payroll-related policies and procedures. Assist with the resolution of payroll discrepancies and issues. Manage employee performance appraisal, performance issues and misconducts. 
 Others Handle staff welfare matters; conduct exit interview, analyze the data and define action plans for retention. Work closely with line managers; guiding them in understanding the policies and ensuring policies and procedures are conformed by all employees. Drive problem solving, continuous improvement projects and any other initiatives as assigned. Manage office administrations. Handle expatriate working permit process (end-to-end). Other ad-hoc tasks relating to HR and Administrations.

Key Skills: Relationship,HR policies,HR Ops,Exit,Policies,Coordination,Administrative operations,Administration
