title: Data Integration Engineer (Senior Associate)
description:
Job Summary Grant Thornton GTech s Data Analytics function is dedicated to designing and delivering robust global data platforms that enable business solutions and high-quality analytics. The Analytics Engineer is responsible for building curated, analytics-ready datasets and semantic models that bridge data engineering and analytics, enabling trusted reporting and self-service consumption within the organization s Data Lakehouse. This hands-on role focuses on transformation development (dbt), dimensional modeling, semantic-layer and BI delivery (Power BI), and data quality. Working closely with Business teams, Data Architects, Data Engineers, and Analysts, the Analytics Engineer turns business requirements into well-structured, governed, and performant data products that serve as a trusted foundation for analytics, reporting, and AI. Responsibilities Design, build, and maintain curated, analytics-ready (gold-layer) datasets and semantic models that enable trusted reporting and self-service consumption. Develop and maintain modular, well-documented data transformations using dbt, following established engineering standards and reusable patterns. Build and optimize dimensional models (star/snowflake schemas, data marts) aligned with the Medallion architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold layer separation). Develop semantic models, metric definitions, and certified datasets in Snowflake and Power BI to support consistent, governed analytics consumption. Translate business and reporting requirements into transformation logic and business rules in partnership with data analysts and stakeholders. Conduct data profiling, validation, and reconciliation using Snowflake SQL to ensure the accuracy, completeness, and integrity of analytics outputs. Perform data lineage and impact analysis across Snowflake, upstream sources, transformation layers, and reporting layers. Implement data quality checks, tests, and observability for analytics pipelines and datasets. Optimize Snowflake queries, models, and transformations for performance, reliability, and cost efficiency. Collaborate with data engineers, ETL/ELT developers, and QA, and support UAT to resolve data-related gaps through iterative testing and validation. Apply governance-by-design practices (access, classification/metadata, certified datasets), and mentor and guide more junior team members. Skills Proven experience with Machine Learning, predictive analytics, and natural language processing. Strong programming skills in SQL and Python for data validation, profiling, reconciliation, and analytics. Strong hands-on Snowflake experience is required, including, ability to construct optimize complex SQL queries, variant/JSON parsing, schema and stage understanding, performance analysis troubleshooting, dynamic tables/materialized views, dbt-on-Snowflake (Streams Tasks), and secure views/masking for certified datasets. Working experience in Medallion Architecture (Bronze, Silver, Gold data layers) including mapping data flows across layers. Strong hands-on experience with dbt for building and maintaining modular, tested data transformations (ELT/ETL development and maintenance). Hands-on experience building semantic models and reports in Power BI (metric definitions, certified datasets, and self-service enablement). Experience developing curated, analytics-ready (gold-layer) datasets and reusable transformation patterns.

title: Deputy General Manager - Smart Campus
description:
Job Description 
 Deputy General Manager (DGM) Smart Campus 
 Department Digital Technology Reports To Chief Digital Officer Location Ahmedabad, Gujarat Employment Type Full-Time 
 Role Summary
The DGM Smart Campus will lead the strategy, design, and execution of Smart Campus IT infrastructure across the organization's campus locations. This role owns the end-to-end lifecycle of smart campus technologies from strategic planning and vendor selection through deployment, integration, and operations spanning IoT device ecosystems, data center build-outs, network infrastructure, and campus-wide digital systems. The ideal candidate combines strong technical infrastructure expertise with proven program leadership and stakeholder management skills.
Key Responsibilities
Strategy & Planning
 Define and drive the long-term Smart Campus technology roadmap aligned with organizational goals (sustainability, safety, efficiency, user experience).
 Define & design architectures aligned with organizational goals covering the smart campus roadmap
 Evaluate emerging technologies (IoT, edge computing, AI-enabled building systems, 5G/Wi-Fi 6, smart energy management) and assess fit for campus deployment.
¢ Develop business cases, budgets, and ROI models for smart campus initiatives.
¢ Partner with leadership to align IT infrastructure investment with institutional/organizational growth plans.
IoT & Smart Infrastructure Execution
¢ Lead design, procurement, and deployment of IoT device ecosystems across campus smart lighting, HVAC, access control, occupancy sensors, environmental monitoring, surveillance, energy metering, parking, and asset tracking.
¢ Oversee IoT platform architecture including device management, connectivity (LoRaWAN, Zigbee, BLE, Wi-Fi, cellular), edge gateways, and cloud/on-prem integration.
¢ Ensure interoperability across multi-vendor IoT systems and integration with central building management systems (BMS/BAS) and campus management platforms.
¢ Establish standards for IoT security, device provisioning, firmware lifecycle management, and data governance.
Data Center Build & Infrastructure
¢ Lead planning, design, and execution of data center build-outs (greenfield and expansion) including site selection, power and cooling design, redundancy (N+1/2N), and physical security.
¢ Manage data center infrastructure lifecycle: server/storage/network hardware, virtualization, structured cabling, UPS, generators, and environmental monitoring systems.
¢ Ensure compliance with relevant standards (TIA-942, Uptime Institute Tier standards, ISO 27001) and local regulatory requirements.
¢ Drive capacity planning, disaster recovery, and business continuity strategy for campus data infrastructure.
Program & Vendor Management
¢ Manage full project lifecycle: scoping, RFPs, vendor evaluation, contract negotiation, implementation, and handover to operations.
¢ Own budgets, timelines, and delivery quality across concurrent smart campus and infrastructure projects.
¢ Build and manage relationships with OEMs, system integrators, telecom providers, and consultants.
¢ Establish SLAs and governance frameworks for ongoing operations and maintenance.
Team Leadership & Stakeholder Engagement
¢ Build, mentor, and lead a multidisciplinary team spanning network engineering, IoT/embedded systems, data center operations, and project management.
¢ Act as the key liaison between IT, facilities, security, academic/business units, and executive leadership.
¢ Present roadmaps, project status, and risk assessments to senior leadership and governance committees.
¢ Drive change management and user adoption for new smart campus systems.
Governance, Security & Compliance
¢ Ensure infrastructure design adheres to cybersecurity best practices, including network segmentation for OT/IoT environments.
¢ Own risk assessment, audit readiness, and compliance documentation for infrastructure projects.
¢ Establish monitoring, incident response, and maintenance protocols for critical infrastructure.
Required Qualifications
¢ Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Electronics, Electrical Engineering, or related field (Master's/MBA preferred).
¢ 1218+ years of progressive experience in IT infrastructure, with at least 5 years in a leadership role managing smart campus, smart building, or large-scale IoT deployments.
¢ Demonstrated experience leading data center build projects from design through commissioning.
¢ Strong understanding of IoT architectures, protocols, and platforms (AWS IoT, Azure IoT Hub, or equivalent).
¢ Experience with structured cabling, LAN/WAN design, wireless infrastructure, and data center facilities (power, cooling, redundancy).
¢ Proven track record managing multi-crore/multi-million-dollar infrastructure budgets and large vendor ecosystems.
¢ Familiarity with BMS/BAS integration, physical security systems, and energy management platforms.
¢ Strong project management skills (PMP/PRINCE2 certification preferred).
Preferred Qualifications
¢ Certifications such as CDCP/CDCS (Data Center), CCNP/CCIE, or IoT-specific certifications.
¢ Experience in campus environments (corporate, educational institution, or industrial park).
¢ Exposure to sustainability/green building initiatives (LEED, IGBC) and smart energy systems.
¢ Working knowledge of cybersecurity frameworks for OT/IoT (NIST, ISO 27001).
Key Competencies
¢ Strategic thinking with hands-on execution capability
¢ Strong stakeholder management and executive communication
¢ Vendor negotiation and contract management
¢ Cross-functional team leadership
¢ Problem-solving under complex, multi-vendor technical environments
¢ Budget ownership and financial acumen

About the Role
We are seeking a Cloud Foundations Engineer to design, build, and maintain the core cloud infrastructure and shared services that enable our development and business teams to operate securely, reliably, and efficiently in the cloud. This role focuses on establishing the landing zones, automation, governance, and operational guardrails that form the foundation for all cloud workloads.
As a Cloud Foundations Engineer, you will work across multiple teams to ensure that our cloud environments follow best practices for security, scalability, automation, and cost optimization, while enabling self-service adoption by application teams.
 
Key Responsibilities
 Cloud Platform Engineering Design, implement, and maintain enterprise landing zones and shared cloud services. Manage account/subscription structures across Azure and AWS. Build and enforce secure-by-default infrastructure patterns.

Hands-on knowledge of networking concepts (VPC, DNS, firewalls, load balancing, hybrid connectivity). Experience with CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, etc.). AI/LLM Software Engineer 
 Location: STPI Building, Taramani, Chennai
 Experience: 2 to 6 Years
 Employment Type: Full-Time

 Build the Future of AI-Powered Enterprise Software 
NilaApps is an AI-native product engineering company building intelligent SaaS platforms, enterprise applications, mobile solutions, and AI-powered automation products used by organizations around the world.
We're looking for exceptional Product Engineers who enjoy solving difficult problems, building products from first principles, and using modern AI technologies to redefine how software is designed, developed, and delivered.
This is an opportunity to join a fast-growing engineering organization where your ideas influence products, architecture, and customer outcomes--not just the code you write.
 About NilaApps 
NilaApps develops cloud-native enterprise software for customers across multiple industries, combining modern software engineering, artificial intelligence, automation, and mobile technologies to build scalable products that solve real-world business challenges.
Our engineering teams embrace modern development practices including:
 AI-assisted software development Cloud-native architecture Continuous delivery Product ownership Automation-first engineering Customer-driven innovation We believe exceptional software is created by curious engineers who continuously learn, challenge assumptions, and take ownership.

 The Opportunity 
As a Product Engineer, you'll participate in every stage of the product lifecycle from understanding customer problems and designing scalable architectures to building, deploying, and continuously improving production systems.
You'll collaborate directly with founders, product managers, designers, customers, and fellow engineers to deliver software that creates measurable business value.
Rather than working within narrowly defined responsibilities, you'll have the opportunity to contribute across architecture, cloud infrastructure, AI integration, application development, product innovation, and engineering excellence.
 What You'll Build 
Depending on your interests and experience, you'll contribute to products including:
 AI-powered Enterprise SaaS Platforms Intelligent Learning & Workforce Solutions AI Agents and Agentic Workflows Enterprise Automation Platforms Mobile Applications Intelligent Analytics Dashboards Compliance & Governance Solutions Large-scale Cloud-native Applications Enterprise API Platforms Intelligent Business Process Automation 
 Your Responsibilities 
You will:
 Design, develop, and maintain scalable enterprise software platforms. Build cloud-native backend services using Java, Spring Boot, and Microservices. Develop responsive web and mobile applications using Angular, React, Ionic, Swift, and iOS technologies. Design secure, scalable APIs and enterprise integrations. Build AI-enabled features using Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI Agents, and modern AI services where appropriate. Develop scalable applications on AWS using serverless and cloud-native architectures. Write clean, maintainable, well-tested software following modern engineering practices. Design automated testing strategies and contribute to CI/CD pipelines. Participate in architecture reviews and technical design discussions. Continuously improve engineering processes through automation and AI-assisted development. Work directly with customers to understand business challenges and deliver meaningful solutions. Mentor team members and contribute to a culture of technical excellence. 
 AI is Part of Our Engineering Culture 
Artificial Intelligence isn't a separate team--it's part of how we engineer software.
Our engineers actively leverage AI to improve productivity, software quality, and product innovation.
You'll have opportunities to work with technologies including:
 Generative AI Large Language Models (LLMs) AI Agents Agentic Workflows Model Context Protocol (MCP) Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) Prompt Engineering AI-assisted Software Development Intelligent Workflow Automation OpenAI APIs and AI Platforms Previous experience is valuable but not mandatory. Curiosity, experimentation, and continuous learning are essential.

 Technologies You'll Work With 
 Backend 
 Java Spring Boot Spring Cloud REST APIs Microservices Distributed Systems Frontend & Mobile 
 Angular React TypeScript Ionic Swift iOS Xcode Cloud & Infrastructure 
 AWS Serverless Computing Lambda EC2 Docker CloudFormation CI/CD Infrastructure Automation Databases 
 PostgreSQL MySQL SQLite Relational Database Design AI & Intelligent Applications 
 Generative AI Large Language Models (LLMs) AI Agents Prompt Engineering RAG MCP AI Automation 
 Our Engineering Principles 
We believe great engineers:
 Build products--not just features. Own solutions from concept to production. Continuously learn and embrace new technologies. Use AI to amplify engineering capability. Communicate clearly and collaborate effectively. Automate repetitive work. Prioritize quality, maintainability, and simplicity. Think like product owners. Focus on customer outcomes. Continuously improve themselves and the products they build. 
 We're Looking For Engineers Who 
 Love solving complex technical problems. Enjoy building products from the ground up. Take ownership and initiative. Learn quickly and adapt to new technologies. Communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders. Enjoy collaborating across disciplines. Have built side projects, contributed to open source, experimented with AI, or demonstrated technical curiosity beyond day-to-day work. Want to grow into Technical Lead, Solution Architect, or Engineering Leadership roles. 
 Qualifications 
 Required 
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline. 2 to 6 years of professional software development experience. Strong Java and Spring Boot development skills. Experience with modern frontend technologies such as Angular or React. Experience building RESTful APIs. Strong understanding of object-oriented design and software engineering principles. Experience with relational databases. Experience using Git. Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills. Preferred 
Experience with one or more of the following:
 AWS Docker Kubernetes Microservices AI or LLM integrations Mobile application development Swift / iOS DevOps and CI/CD Product Engineering Startup environments 
 Career Growth 
As our products and engineering organization continue to grow, you'll have opportunities to advance into roles such as:
 Senior Product Engineer Technical Lead Solution Architect AI Platform Engineer Engineering Manager Product Engineering Leader We invest in engineers who continuously learn, take initiative, and contribute beyond their immediate responsibilities.

 Why Join NilaApps? 
 Build products used by customers around the world. Work with modern AI and cloud-native technologies. Collaborate directly with founders and product leaders. Contribute to architecture and technical strategy. Gain experience across AI, cloud, mobile, and enterprise software. Work in an environment that values ownership, innovation, and continuous learning. Accelerate your technical and professional growth. 
 Who Will Thrive Here 
This role is ideal for engineers who are intellectually curious, enjoy tackling complex challenges, and are motivated by building products that make a meaningful impact.
If you're looking for an environment where you can learn rapidly, take ownership, collaborate with talented colleagues, and help shape the next generation of AI-powered enterprise software, we'd be delighted to hear from you.

title: Power Platform Technical Lead (Dynamics 365 CE / Dataverse)
description:
Role: Power Platform Technical Lead Location: Remote Shift Hours: 1400 to 2300 hours IST  Job Type: Full-time Experience: 8+ years 


 Role Purpose The Power Platform Technical Lead is the senior technical authority for Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement (CE), Dataverse and the wider Power Platform. The role combines hands-on engineering with technical leadership, defining standards, reviewing code, owning the ALM model and ensuring that everything we build on the platform is scalable, secure and production-ready. The Lead works closely with the Platform Engineer, DevOps Engineer, Solution Architects and the IT Applications Developer team. 
 Key Responsibilities Technical Leadership in D365 & Power Platform Act as technical authority for Dynamics 365 CE and Power Platform solutions, owning architecture decisions, design patterns and non-functional requirements. Mentor IT Applications Developers and citizen makers; raise the technical bar through coaching, design reviews and pairing. Translate business requirements into well-architected Dataverse data models, app designs and integration patterns. Solution Management with Native Git Own the Dataverse Git integration strategy: branch model, solution segmentation, folder structure, commit hygiene and developer onboarding. Maintain repository standards in Azure DevOps Repos (branch policies, PR templates, required reviewers, build validation). Enforce solution layering, managed-properties discipline and unmanaged-customisation block policies. 
 Solution Deployment & Versioning Design and operate deployments through native Power Platform Pipelines (in PPAC) and complementary Azure DevOps (ADO) pipelines for code-first artefacts. Define environment strategy (Dev / Build / Test / UAT / Pre-Prod / Prod) and the promotion path for each solution stream. Govern release versioning, release notes (incl. Copilot-assisted generation), approval gates and hotfix workflows. 
 Flow & Agent Management Provide design and run-time governance for Cloud Flows, Desktop Flows and Copilot/agent flows: connection references, environment variables, error handling, performance, throttling. Define standards for service-principal-owned flows, sharing models and DLP-compliant connector usage. 
 Infrastructure as Code Terraform Maintain Terraform modules for the Azure resources that support Power Platform (resource groups, service principals, Key Vaults, Logic Apps, Function Apps, Storage, App Insights). Review and approve Terraform pull requests; enforce state-management and module-versioning standards. Dynamics CRM Plugins & Extensibility Design, review and maintain Dataverse plugins, custom APIs, custom workflow activities and PCF components in C#/.NET. Set standards for plugin performance (transactions, depth, ILogger, tracing service) and review for security risk. 
 Code Review Standards Be the named code reviewer for high-impact Power Platform, Dataverse and Azure-adjacent changes. Author and continuously improve coding standards covering C#, TypeScript/JavaScript, Power Fx, Dataverse plugins and Logic Apps. Champion the use of solution checker, Power Platform CLI, ESLint/Prettier and SonarCloud. D365 Security Management & Configuration Design Dataverse security roles, business units, teams, field-level security and hierarchy security. Govern security-role version control through solutions and ensure audit-grade traceability of permission changes. Azure Foundations Resource Groups: define naming, tagging and access conventions; review RG-level RBAC. Service Principals: govern lifecycle (creation, secret/cert rotation, expiry monitoring) and least-privilege assignments. Key Vault: manage secret storage standards, access policies / RBAC, integration with Logic Apps, Functions, ADO and Power Platform connection references. 
 Pipeline Deployment for Logic Apps Azure Functions Own the CI/CD pipelines for Logic Apps (Standard and Consumption) and Azure Functions used as Dataverse extensions or integration glue. Define artefact, slot-swap and parameterisation strategy across environments. Integration Tooling Use Postman and SoapUI to design, document and regression-test REST/SOAP integrations to/from Dataverse, 
 F&O and third-party systems. Maintain shared collections and environments for the developer team. Programming Languages C# (.NET 8+) plugins, custom APIs, Azure Functions. TypeScript / JavaScript client-side scripts, PCF components, Logic Apps inline code. Power Fx formula standards across canvas apps and Power Automate. 
 Use of AI Use GitHub Copilot, Copilot in Power Apps / Power Automate / Power Pages and Copilot Studio to accelerate delivery and standardise patterns. Govern responsible AI use data handling, prompt patterns, model selection and review of AI-generated code before merge. Identify opportunities to deploy Copilot Studio agents for internal user support and internal IT operations. 
 Essential Skills & Experience 6+ years in the Microsoft Dynamics CRM / Dataverse ecosystem, with at least 2 years in a lead or senior engineering role. Deep, hands-on experience with Dataverse data modelling, security and extensibility. Production experience with native Power Platform Pipelines and Dataverse Git integration. Strong C# / .NET, TypeScript and Power Fx; comfortable in both pro-code and low-code stacks. Demonstrable Azure experience: Resource Groups, RBAC, Service Principals, Key Vault, Logic Apps, Azure Functions, App Insights. 
 Hands-on Terraform for the supporting Azure footprint. Experience leading code reviews and authoring engineering standards. Proficient with Postman and SoapUI for integration testing. 
 Desirable Microsoft Certified: Power Platform Solution Architect Expert (PL-600). Microsoft Certified: Azure Developer Associate (AZ-204) or DevOps Engineer Expert (AZ-400). Experience with Dual Write between F&O and Dataverse. Exposure to Copilot Studio and Microsoft AI Builder. Experience in a regulated, multi-country enterprise.

Key Skills: Azure Devops,Application,Dynamics,Azure Logic Apps,C#,Plugins,Microsoft Azure,Azure Functions

title: AWS Full Stack Engineer
description:
Job Summary 
We are looking for an experienced Full Stack Engineer with strong AWS expertise and hands-on experience building and deploying Agentic AI use cases. The ideal candidate will have a solid background in frontend and backend development, AWS cloud services, and Generative AI application development using Amazon Bedrock.
The candidate should be capable of delivering end-to-end AI-powered applications, including AI agents, workflow automation, API integrations, and data visualization solutions. Experience with AWS Kiro, Amazon Bedrock, and Amazon QuickSight is highly desirable for developing and deploying intelligent enterprise applications.
 Key Responsibilities 
- Design, develop, and maintain scalable full stack applications using modern frontend and backend technologies.
- Build and deploy Agentic AI solutions using Amazon Bedrock, including AI agents, tool calling, multi-step reasoning workflows, and enterprise automation.
- Develop Generative AI applications using foundation models, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and prompt engineering.
- Use AWS Kiro to accelerate AI-assisted software development, prototyping, coding, and application delivery.
- Integrate Amazon Bedrock with AWS services, databases, APIs, and enterprise systems.
- Develop interactive dashboards and data visualization solutions using Amazon QuickSight.
- Build secure, scalable backend services, REST APIs, and microservices.
- Deploy, monitor, and optimize applications on AWS using appropriate cloud-native services.
- Implement authentication, authorization, logging, error handling, and security best practices.
- Collaborate with product managers, architects, and cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into production-ready solutions.
- Troubleshoot performance issues and ensure the reliability, scalability, and maintainability of deployed applications.
 Mandatory Skills 
1. Full Stack Development: 5+ years of hands-on experience developing frontend and backend applications.
2. AWS Cloud: Strong practical experience with AWS services and application deployment.
3. AWS Certification: Must hold a valid AWS certification; candidates should specify the certification name.
4. Amazon Bedrock: Hands-on experience building Generative AI applications using Amazon Bedrock.
5. Agentic AI: Proven experience implementing and delivering Agentic AI use cases, preferably in production environments.
6. AWS Kiro: Practical familiarity with Kiro and AI-assisted development workflows.
7. Amazon QuickSight: Experience creating dashboards, reports, and data visualizations. Technical Skills 
- Frontend: React.js, Angular, JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3.
- Backend: Node.js, Python, Java, or equivalent backend technologies.
- AWS Services: Amazon Bedrock, AWS Lambda, Amazon API Gateway, Amazon S3, IAM, CloudWatch, and other relevant AWS services.

title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
description:
Role & responsibilities : Design, build, and ship agentic workflows for Weave: orchestration, tool selection, retries, failure handling, and the handoffs between LLM reasoning and deterministic code. Build and extend the tool layer, including our MCP server, designing tool interfaces and schemas that models use correctly under real conditions. Engineer against hallucination: structure pipelines so the agent retrieves and reasons but never invents a number, with verification and traceability built in. Build evaluation harnesses and golden datasets, and hold new work to them. Regression testing is a first-class part of the job here, not an afterthought. Work with LLMs across the stack, including prompt and context engineering, retrieval, structured outputs, and fine-tuning where it is genuinely the right tool. Build and maintain the data pipelines, databases, and APIs that Weave and our other platforms depend on. Optimise for the constraints that actually bite: latency, token cost, and reliability across long multi-step runs. Support deployment, testing, monitoring, and observability of AI systems in production, and diagnose failures when they happen. Work directly with our analysts and product team to understand what a correct model or answer looks like, and encode that judgement into the system. Prototype and evaluate new AI tools, frameworks, and techniques, and document what you find clearly enough that the team can act on it. 

 Preferred candidate profile [2+ years] of professional experience in software engineering, AI/ML, or data engineering, with strong Python and backend engineering fundamentals, including asynchronous processing and streaming workflows. You write production code, not only notebooks. Demonstrated hands-on experience delivering real Agentic AI projects, meaning agents that plan, make decisions, invoke tools, manage context, and complete multi-step workflows end to end. You have seen these systems fail in production and understand why. Practical fluency in prompt and context engineering: structuring context, decomposing tasks, and knowing when a prompt is the wrong solution. Practical experience with agent orchestration patterns such as routing, delegation between agents, memory, structured outputs, and human-in-the-loop workflows. Solid grounding in machine learning and AI fundamentals, and comfort with libraries such as NumPy, Pandas, and PyTorch or TensorFlow. Experience integrating agents with production APIs, databases, enterprise applications, and external services. An empirical instinct: you reach for an evaluation before an opinion, and you are willing to say a system is not ready. Experience implementing guardrails, permissions, and secure tool execution, plus failure handling, observability, and agent evaluations. Clear written and verbal communication, including with people who are not engineers. Familiarity with Agentic AI technologies such as MCP, Gemini, the OpenAI Agents SDK, LangGraph, Anthropic's tooling, or comparable frameworks. Ability to walk us through your personal contributions to at least one substantial or production Agentic AI implementation, covering its architecture, tools, safeguards, challenges, evaluation approach, and measurable results. Note on scope: basic chatbots, prompt engineering alone, simple RAG pipelines, tutorials, certifications, and thin wrapper applications are not considered sufficient Agentic AI experience. GOOD TO HAVE Contributions to open-source agent tooling, MCP servers, or model-facing tool interfaces used by others. Experience with financial data, spreadsheets, Excel automation (openpyxl, Office.js), or document-analysis workflows. Background in finance, fintech, or financial data, so you know what consensus, guidance, and a segment KPI are, and why close enough is worthless in this domain. Depth in LLM tracing and evaluation infrastructure, building the harnesses and golden datasets rather than just reading the dashboards. 
 Applied ML or research background: forecasting, time-series modelling, or information extraction from filings and unstructured documents. Cloud deployment and CI/CD experience.

description:
Job Description Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondel z International Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Make It Possible. You will develop the 0-24-month IBP forecast by brand and at the stock keeping unit (SKU) level. You will coordinate, challenge and influence building block with input from sales, marketing and other partners. In addition, you will review the disaggregated short-term demand plan, which includes SKU/location mix and weekly pacing. Finally, you will provide the finalized detailed demand plan by SKU to supply planners and adjust it based on feedback from supply planners or commercial teams. How you will contribute You will: Contribute to the demand management cycle of the integrated business planning (IBP) process for your categories and to strategy and structure discussions Liaise with the commercial and operational teams and develop ways to continuously improve communication between the functions to support the delivery of the business KPIs for their families Manage forecast compilation process, which includes owning the short-term weekly plan and the long-term forecast (three or more months) Interact with modelling team to generate statistical forecasting Participate in the integrated business planning process and manage the demand planning tool Perform root-cause analysis for continuous plan improvement for key service issues, forecast error and bias, and share output with appropriate leadership What you will bring A desire to drive your future and accelerate your career and the following experience and knowledge: Experience in a fast-moving consumer goods or consumer packaged goods environment, preferably in food or other fast moving, dynamic industry where shelf life is a constraint Experience within an IBP/S&OP environment Able to influence cross-functional teams, working on priorities and improving the plan Excellent problem-solving skills, analytical skills - and able to understand and interpret data Strong verbal and written communication skills Team player who can work with many other functions on a daily basis More about this role What you need to know about this position: You will be an integral part of the implementation and go-live of the new planning solution (o9) within the AMEA region, with a primary focus on executing Integration Testing (I Test), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), data validation, and end-user training. You will work closely with the BU Champion and regional SME leads to ensure the solution is thoroughly tested, validated, and ready for business adoption. Meanwhile, as an early foundation of demand analysis role, this role would require business insights to deep dive into forecast error reasons and improve the AIML/Operation fcst KPI with BU team. 
 What extra ingredients you will bring: Solid understanding of Demand Planning processes (statistical forecasting, consensus planning, demand sensing) 4-8 years of relevant experience in Supply Chain Planning or a related operational role Familiarity with planning tools/systems; exposure to advanced planning solutions (o9, Kinaxis, OMP, SAP IBP) is a necessity. Strong attention to detail - ability to execute test scripts methodically and identify data discrepancies Comfortable working with testing tools (qTest, Jira) and documenting test results and defects Good communication skills - ability to train and support peers in a clear, structured manner Collaborative mindset with ability to work in cross-functional, multi-market teams under tight timelines Growth mindset, quick learner, and comfortable navigating ambiguity in a fast-paced transformation environment Proficiency in English; additional regional language skills are a plus 
 Education / Certifications: Bachelors Degree or postgraduate. With relevant Demand planning experience.

test user access, roles, and permissions ahead of each testing phase Log, track, and follow up on defects in qTest/Jira, ensuring timely resolution within SLA and supporting retesting of failed test cases Execute E2E (End-to-End) scenario testing including cross-stream scenarios with Data Science, Supply Planning, and IBP Support pre-test preparation including batch job readiness, test script pre-requisites documentation, and environment checks Participate in daily testing war rooms, morning kick-offs, and end-of-day recaps to report progress, blockers, and pass rates Training & Change Adoption Support the delivery of Pre-UAT and UAT training sessions for BU end users, including o9 system basics, Day-in-the-Life (DILO) walkthroughs, and advanced DP system training Conduct shadow testing sessions - walk end users through test scripts and o9 navigation to build familiarity and confidence Act as a go-to resource for end users during testing phases, providing real-time guidance on o9 processes and ways of working Support the BU Champion in driving change management activities, user communications, and adoption governance Contribute to training material review and localization for BU-specific contexts Go-Live & Sustainment Support Parallel Run execution -  We have an exciting opportunity at our company Tata Business Hub for a Lead IT Infra Role, and based on your experience and skill set, we believe this role could be a great fit for you. 
 Company Details : Tata Business Hub is a digital first B2B organization setup by TATA Group to holistically address the needs of Emerging Businesses. We value the pivotal role of emerging businesses in our Nations economic growth and prosperity, and believe in empowering them to be deeply aware, widely connected and digitally integrated.  At Tata Business Hub, our ambition is vast- We want to become the pre-eminent company that works for MSMEs in India 
 Grow their business Solve their challenges Optimize their processes 
 Role Summary Responsible for managing enterprise IT infrastructure, Microsoft 365, AWS cloud platforms, network security and IT operations, while ensuring effective IT procurement, vendor coordination and billing management. Key Responsibilities 1. Microsoft 365 & SharePoint Manage Microsoft 365, SharePoint Online, SSO, Active Directory and Azure integrations. Develop and maintain SharePoint customizations, SPFx/React JS applications and Power Platform solutions. Manage Microsoft 365 security policies using Defender and Intune. Troubleshoot Office 365, email, network, firewall and cloud service issues. 2. Infrastructure & Cloud Manage DNS, email routing, Azure services, web applications, APIs and storage. Deploy and manage AWS services, instances, AMIs and SaaS infrastructure. Configure and optimize AWS, Azure and internal cloud environments. Implement automation, patching, backup and disaster recovery solutions. Monitor cloud usage, capacity, performance and costs. 3. Network & Security Manage enterprise network and security infrastructure, including firewalls, IPS, proxy, web/email filtering and next-generation security solutions. Configure firewall policies, authentication services, load balancers and SD-WAN. Maintain knowledge of MPLS, BGP, OSPF, TACACS and related network technologies. Identify, investigate and resolve major incidents and security vulnerabilities. 4. Identity, Endpoint & IT Support Manage Active Directory, Azure AD/Entra ID, Azure AD Connect, ADFS and Hybrid Exchange. Implement SSO, MFA, access controls and endpoint security. Manage BYOD, ActiveSync and mobile device support. Provide technical support, problem management and infrastructure troubleshooting. Drive ITSM, SLA adherence and service improvement. 5. IT Procurement & Vendor Management Coordinate IT procurement for hardware, software, cloud services, licenses and infrastructure. Raise and track purchase requisitions, POs, quotations and delivery schedules. Coordinate with vendors, Procurement, Finance and internal teams for timely delivery. Maintain records of contracts, licenses, warranties, renewals and IT assets. Support vendor evaluations, commercial negotiations and cost optimization. 6. IT Billing & Cost Control Validate vendor invoices against POs, contracts, SOWs and agreed rates. Verify quantities, taxes, rental charges, licenses, cloud consumption and discounts. Track recurring IT bills, AMC, connectivity, cloud and managed services. Resolve billing discrepancies and coordinate corrections, credit notes and adjustments. Maintain billing trackers and support monthly cost reconciliation and budget reporting. 7. Documentation & Compliance Maintain infrastructure documentation, configuration records and asset details. Follow IT security, change management, audit and compliance requirements. Ensure timely closure of vulnerabilities, audit observations and operational issues. 
 Qualifications & Skills Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT or related field. 8-12 years of experience in M365, cloud infrastructure, network security and IT operations. Strong knowledge of AWS, Azure, GCP, Active Directory, Exchange, networking and security technologies. Proficiency in PowerShell and infrastructure automation. Experience in IT procurement, vendor management and invoice validation. If you're a motivated individual with a keen eye for quality and a desire to drive excellence in every project, we invite you to apply and join our team. 
 Looking forward to hearing from you.

title: Salesforce Health Cloud Developer
description:
About Position: 
 We are seeking an experienced Salesforce Health Cloud Developer to design, develop, and customize Salesforce Health Cloud solutions that enable patient-centric and member-centric healthcare experiences. The ideal candidate will possess strong expertise in Salesforce platform development, Health Cloud data models, Experience Cloud, integrations, and healthcare domain workflows. In this role, you will build scalable applications, integrations, and automation solutions using Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Aura, SOQL, and Salesforce APIs while supporting complex healthcare and life sciences business processes. You will collaborate with architects, business analysts, UX teams, and stakeholders to deliver secure, high-performing, and compliant Salesforce solutions. 
 Role: Salesforce Health Cloud Developer Location: All Persistent Locations Experience: Between 8 to 12 Years Job Type: Full Time Employment 
 What You'll Do: 
 Design, develop, and customize Salesforce Health Cloud solutions based on business requirements. Map healthcare, clinical, and life sciences data into the Salesforce Health Cloud standard data model using Person Accounts. Design and implement scalable Health Cloud solutions supporting patient and member-centric workflows. Build and customize Salesforce Experience Cloud portals using LWC, Aura Components, and standard Salesforce capabilities. Develop responsive and user-friendly interfaces aligned with enterprise branding standards. Create and enhance Apex classes, triggers, Lightning components, and SOQL-based solutions. Design and implement integrations using Salesforce APIs, REST APIs, SOAP services, and middleware platforms. Support multi-system and cross-org data synchronization and integration requirements. Configure and optimize Salesforce Flows, declarative automation, and business processes. Implement API-based integrations with healthcare platforms, third-party applications, and enterprise systems. Ensure compliance with Salesforce security best practices, healthcare regulations, and data protection standards. Optimize platform performance and proactively troubleshoot production issues. Participate in code reviews, technical design discussions, and release activities. Work closely with Business Analysts, Architects, Product Owners, and UX teams to deliver scalable solutions. Mentor junior developers and contribute to Salesforce development best practices. Strong understanding of Person Accounts and their usage within Health Cloud. Expertise in Health Cloud Data Model and healthcare-specific architecture patterns. Understanding of Care Plans and Care Teams and their role in patient care management. Experience with Patient Timeline configuration and patient journey visibility. Knowledge of Salesforce Shield and healthcare data security requirements. Understanding of Consent Management and patient privacy frameworks. Familiarity with Patient Data Duplication handling and master patient record management. Strong understanding of Patient 360 implementations and patient-centric engagement models. Knowledge of clinical data models and REMS (Risk Evaluation and Mitigation Strategy) processes. Experience supporting healthcare workflows and life sciences business processes. 
 Expertise You'll Bring: 
 8 to 12 years of experience in Salesforce development. Minimum 2+ years of hands-on experience in Salesforce Health Cloud. Experience delivering enterprise Salesforce implementations in Healthcare or Life Sciences domains. Proven experience developing scalable and secure Salesforce applications. Strong expertise in Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Aura Components, SOQL, Salesforce APIs. Hands-on experience with Salesforce Experience Cloud. Experience building custom UI components and healthcare-specific workflows. Strong understanding of Salesforce platform architecture and security model. Experience with integration technologies including REST and SOAP web services. Knowledge of Salesforce Flows, Process Automation, and Declarative Development. Experience with cross-org integrations and complex data migration projects. Strong understanding of Health Cloud data architecture and patient data management. 
 Benefits: 
 Competitive salary and benefits package Culture focused on talent development with quarterly growth opportunities and company-sponsored higher education and certifications Opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies Employee engagement initiatives such as project parties, flexible work hours, and Long Service awards Annual health check-ups Insurance coverage: group term life, personal accident, and Mediclaim hospitalization for self, spouse, two children, and parents 
 Values-Driven, People-Centric & Inclusive Work Environment: 
 Persistent is dedicated to fostering diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We invite applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities, and regardless of gender or gender preference. We welcome diverse candidates from all backgrounds. 
 We support hybrid work and flexible hours to fit diverse lifestyles. Our office is accessibility-friendly, with ergonomic setups and assistive technologies to support employees with physical disabilities. If you are a person with disabilities and have specific requirements, please inform us during the application process or at any time during your employment.

title: Salesforce Data Engineer
description:
About Position: 
 We are seeking a skilled Salesforce Data Engineer to drive enterprise data migration, integration, and Customer 360 initiatives across Salesforce Data Cloud, Service Cloud, and Data360 platforms. The ideal candidate will be responsible for building scalable data pipelines, data migration frameworks, reconciliation processes, and governance controls that enable trusted and unified customer, dealer, vehicle, and case data. This role will play a critical part in supporting Customer360, Dealer360, Vehicle360, and Case360 foundations while collaborating with Salesforce, integration, reporting, analytics, and AI teams to deliver high-quality, secure, and business-ready data solutions. 
 Role: Salesforce Data Engineer Location: All Persistent Locations Experience: 4 to 8 Years Job Type: Full Time Employment 
 What You'll Do: 
 Implement and manage Salesforce Data Cloud and Customer Data Platform (CDP) solutions. Design, develop, and maintain data migration frameworks for Salesforce and enterprise applications. Build data pipelines supporting Customer360, Dealer360, Vehicle360, and Case360 initiatives. Perform data extraction, transformation, migration, reconciliation, and validation activities. Define source-to-target mapping rules and migration strategies. Develop data quality controls, validation frameworks, and reconciliation processes. Create migration runbooks and deployment procedures for large-scale migration initiatives. Implement data ingestion and synchronization processes between Salesforce and external systems. Support customer data unification and master data management initiatives. Collaborate with Salesforce architects, integration teams, reporting teams, and AI teams. Develop custom Salesforce solutions using Apex and Lightning Web Components (LWC). Configure and support Service Cloud capabilities related to customer service operations. Monitor and troubleshoot data integration, synchronization, and migration issues. Implement governance standards, security controls, and compliance requirements. Support Agentforce, reporting, analytics, and future self-service initiatives through trusted data foundations. Drive continuous improvement of data management and migration processes. 
 Expertise You'll Bring: 
 4 to 8 years of experience in Salesforce Development, Data Engineering, Data Migration, or Salesforce Data Cloud implementations. title: Enterprise Architecture - Senior Manager Architecture
description:
Position Title: Enterprise Architecture - Senior Manager Architecture - GR - 40551-75745-1 - Job Family: IFT > IT Architecture Shift: 2nd Shift (India) Job Title Senior Manager Architecture Requirement Type Full-Time Employee Job Location Bangalore / Hyderabad / Gurugram Job Level Senior Manager Hiring Manager Senior Director Technology Primary Skill Enterprise Architecture, Pharmacy Platforms, AI Spec-Driven Development Business iRx IDW Data Mgmt Individual Contributor / People Manager People Manager ABOUT ELEVANCE HEALTH Elevance Health is a leading health company in America dedicated to improving lives and communities and making healthcare simpler. It is the largest managed health care company in the Blue Cross Blue Shield (BCBS) Association serving more than 112 million individuals across 14 states. A regular in Fortune 500 list, Elevance Health ranked 18 in 2026. Gail Boudreaux , President and CEO of Elevance Health has been a consistent name in the Fortune list of most powerful women and currently holds 81st rank on this list. ABOUT CARELON GLOBAL SOLUTIONS Carelon Global Solutions (CGS) is a healthcare solutions company simplifying complex operational processes to improve the health of the healthcare system. Previously known as Legato Health Technologies, Carelon Global Solutions (hereinafter, CGS) underwent a name change and joined the Carelon family of brands in January 2023, as a fully owned subsidiary of Elevance Health (Previously Anthem Inc.). CGS brings together a global team of like-minded innovators who manage and optimize operational processes for health plans as well as providers. Our brightest minds housed across our global headquarters in Indianapolis as well as Bengaluru, Hyderabad and Gurugram in India, Manila in the Philippines, and San Juan in Puerto Rico bring with them innovative capabilities and an unmatched depth of experience. This global team uniquely positions CGS to enable scalable, next-generation platforms and specialized digital tools that make healthcare operations more practical, effective, and efficient. OUR MISSION & VALUES Our Mission: Improving Lives and Communities. Simplifying Healthcare. Expecting More.
 Our Values: Leadership | Community | Integrity | Agility | Diversity JOB PURPOSE Carelon Global Solutions India is seeking a Senior Manager Architecture to lead architecture and end-to-end implementation of enterprise pharmacy management capabilities for CarelonRx. The role owns technical vision, solution architecture, engineering execution, implementation readiness, and platform outcomes across complex, multi-system pharmacy transformation programs. The position is intentionally weighted toward architecture, engineering, AI-enabled Spec-Driven Development, and large-scale implementation leadership. Delivery administration is a supporting responsibility, not the primary mandate. The leader will combine strong software engineering depth with practical pharmacy and PBM domain knowledge to translate business capabilities into secure, scalable, resilient, and operable platforms. JOB RESPONSIBILITY Enterprise Pharmacy Architecture Define and govern target-state solution architecture for end-to-end pharmacy management systems, aligned with enterprise architecture, security, data, privacy, resiliency, and regulatory guardrails. Create capability maps, domain boundaries, reference architectures, reusable patterns, integration standards, and modernization roadmaps across the pharmacy ecosystem. Lead architecture decisions for microservices, APIs, event streaming, workflow orchestration, data platforms, cloud-native services, observability, and interoperability with legacy platforms. Own architecture reviews, trade-off decisions, non-functional requirements, technical debt strategy, and design assurance from concept through production adoption. End-To-End Pharmacy Platform Implementation Lead implementation across relevant pharmacy and PBM capabilities such as benefit configuration, formulary, eligibility, claims adjudication, pricing, prior authorization, pharmacy networks, specialty pharmacy, clinical programs, rebates, member and provider experiences, and operational reporting. Translate business journeys and pharmacy operating models into domain-aligned services, data contracts, interfaces, implementation increments, migration plans, and measurable acceptance criteria. Own the technical implementation lifecycle covering discovery, architecture, engineering, integration, data conversion, testing strategy, cutover, production readiness, stabilization, and benefits realization. Manage cross-platform dependencies and ensure that application, data, infrastructure, security, operations, and vendor workstreams converge into one implementable solution. Drive phased rollout, coexistence, migration, and decommissioning strategies that protect member, client, pharmacy, and operational continuity. AI-Enabled Spec-Driven Development (SDD) Establish an AI-first Spec-Driven Development approach in which approved business, architecture, interface, security, testing, and operational specifications become the governed source for implementation. Enable engineering agents and copilots to accelerate design elaboration, code generation, test creation, documentation, code review, traceability, and impact analysis, with human review and approval at critical control points. Define reusable SDD templates, prompt and context standards, repository conventions, quality gates, evaluation criteria, and responsible AI controls for enterprise adoption. Measure SDD outcomes using baselines and agreed targets for engineering cycle time, specification-to-code traceability, automated test coverage, escaped defects, rework, deployment frequency, and productivity improvement. Ensure AI-generated artifacts meet enterprise standards for security, privacy, intellectual property, explainability, maintainability, and auditability. Engineering Excellence And Hands-On Technical Leadership Provide credible, hands-on technical leadership through design reviews, code and API reviews, proof-of-concept direction, critical problem solving, performance analysis, and production diagnostics. Guide teams on software design principles, domain-driven design, secure coding, automated testing, DevSecOps, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, reliability engineering, and cloud cost optimization. Define engineering scorecards and quality gates covering code health, architecture compliance, security vulnerabilities, reliability, performance, recoverability, maintainability, and operational readiness. Champion platform engineering, reusable services, developer experience, automated environments, and self-service capabilities that reduce implementation friction at scale. Large-Scale Implementation Leadership Lead multiple engineering teams and technical workstreams across product, architecture, software engineering, data, quality engineering, cloud, security, operations, and partner organizations. Create an integrated technical implementation plan that connects architecture runway, dependency sequencing, environment readiness, test strategy, migration, cutover, and operational acceptance. Act as the senior technical decision-maker for complex implementation risks, cross-team conflicts, architecture exceptions, integration failures, and production-readiness gaps. Provide transparent executive-level reporting on architecture health, implementation progress, critical dependencies, risk exposure, quality, readiness, and realized business outcomes. Build governance that is lightweight but effective, emphasizing decision velocity, measurable technical outcomes, and removal of systemic blockers rather than delivery administration. Pharmacy Domain And Stakeholder Partnership Apply working knowledge of the prescription lifecycle, PBM operations, payer and pharmacy interactions, clinical and utilization management, drug data, pricing, formulary, claims, and applicable industry transactions and regulations. Partner with pharmacy business leaders, product managers, enterprise architects, security, operations, compliance, and client teams to shape solutions that are technically sound and operationally adoptable. Convert domain policies, rules, and exceptions into explicit specifications, testable requirements, decision services, and traceable implementation controls. Challenge assumptions using outside-in engineering and pharmacy-platform practices while tailoring recommendations to CarelonRx business priorities and enterprise constraints. People And Capability Leadership Build, lead, and mentor engineering managers, solution architects, principal engineers, technical leads, developers, quality engineers, and platform specialists across distributed teams. Establish clear technical accountabilities, architecture ownership, engineering career paths, succession plans, and communities of practice for pharmacy engineering and AI SDD. Create a culture of engineering rigor, transparent decision-making, experimentation, learning, inclusion, and accountability for outcomes. Assess capability gaps and execute hiring, upskilling, partner augmentation, and workforce plans required for large-scale implementation. Delivery Governance As A Supporting Responsibility Partner with product and program leadership on planning, investment sequencing, release readiness, dependency management, and risk escalation. Use delivery metrics only as supporting indicators. Primary accountability remains architecture quality, end-to-end implementation integrity, engineering excellence, and business capability outcomes. Ensure commitments are realistic, technically grounded, and supported by clear specifications, measurable acceptance criteria, and production-readiness evidence. QUALIFICATION Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline; postgraduate qualification is preferred. Strong foundation in software engineering, enterprise solution architecture, systems integration, cloud engineering, data architecture, cybersecurity, and operational resilience. Demonstrated ability to communicate architecture and implementation choices to business executives, product leaders, engineers, risk partners, and external vendors. Ability to lead through ambiguity, make evidence-based trade-offs, and connect pharmacy business outcomes to technical architecture and implementation decisions. Working knowledge of Agile, product operating models, DevSecOps, secure SDLC, and modern engineering governance. EXPERIENCE 15+ years of progressive experience in software engineering, solution architecture, enterprise platforms, and technology implementation, including 5+ years leading engineering managers, architects, or large technical teams. Proven leadership of large-scale, multi-year enterprise implementations involving multiple applications, complex integrations, data migration, cloud platforms, distributed teams, and production cutover. Relevant healthcare, pharmacy, or PBM experience, with demonstrable understanding of end-to-end pharmacy capabilities and their technology implications. Demonstrated experience defining target architecture and taking complex platforms from architecture through implementation, production readiness, stabilization, and measurable adoption. Experience applying AI-assisted engineering, Spec-Driven Development, agentic workflows, or comparable automation across the SDLC with appropriate human oversight and governance. Experience managing strategic vendors and globally distributed teams while retaining internal ownership of architecture, engineering quality, and implementation outcomes. Experience modernizing legacy systems using APIs, microservices, event-driven patterns, cloud-native platforms, automated testing, DevSecOps, observability, and reliability practices. SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES Core Technical Competencies Enterprise and solution architecture; domain-driven design; capability modeling; microservices; API-first and event-driven architecture; integration and interoperability patterns. Java and/or .NET engineering ecosystems; REST and GraphQL APIs; event-streaming platforms; containers and Kubernetes; Azure and/or AWS; CI/CD; infrastructure as code; observability and SRE practices. Data architecture, master and reference data, transactional and analytical data patterns, data quality, lineage, privacy, and secure information exchange. Architecture fitness functions, performance engineering, resilience, disaster recovery, security-by-design, threat modeling, and production operability. Pharmacy And Healthcare Domain Competencies Prescription and pharmacy claims lifecycle; benefit configuration; formulary and utilization management; eligibility; pricing; pharmacy networks; specialty and mail pharmacy; clinical programs; rebates; member and provider journeys. Awareness of healthcare and pharmacy interoperability, transaction standards, regulatory obligations, data privacy, and audit requirements relevant to the assigned platform scope. AI and SDD Competencies Spec-Driven Development, AI-assisted software engineering, agent orchestration, retrieval and context patterns, prompt and evaluation practices, automated testing, traceability, and responsible AI governance. Ability to establish engineering baselines, controlled pilots, adoption guardrails, and measurable value realization for AI-enabled development. Leadership Competencies Strategic thinking, systems thinking, executive communication, architecture decision-making, technical talent development, vendor leadership, influencing without authority, and crisis leadership. Bias for simplification, measurable outcomes, engineering quality, operational accountability, and continuous improvement. Preferred Certifications Cloud architecture certification in Azure or AWS. AI, machine learning, responsible AI, or generative AI certification. Healthcare or pharmacy domain certification, where applicable. SAFe Agilist or equivalent product and Agile leadership certification. Indicative Success Measures Architecture: target-state adoption, design conformance, reuse, technical debt reduction, resilience, security, and platform scalability. Implementation: capability readiness, integration completeness, migration quality, cutover readiness, production stability, adoption, and business outcome realization. Engineering: cycle-time improvement, automation coverage, defect escape reduction, reliability, developer experience, and maintainability. AI SDD: specification coverage and traceability, governed AI adoption, reusable agent workflows, quality of generated artifacts, and validated productivity benefits. Organization: critical-skill coverage, leadership bench strength, team health, succession readiness, and growth of architecture and engineering capability. Delivery: predictable release support and governance compliance, intentionally weighted below architecture, implementation, engineering, and business outcomes. title: QA QC Engineer
description:
ROLE SUMMARY: 
 
We are looking for a Quality Control Engineer to own inspection and product conformance for our products including and not limited to sensors, avionics and actuation systems, from incoming material through to final acceptance and customer delivery. You will plan and run inspections and tests, catch and resolve non-conformances, and keep the quality records that customer acceptance and military airworthiness certification depend on. You will work closely with design, production and suppliers, and you will be the main point of contact for customer and regulatory inspectors (HAL, BEL, DGAQA, CEMILAC/RCMA) during stage inspections, qualification tests and acceptance tests. The role reports to the Quality Head and is based in our AS9100D environment, where you will help mature our quality system as we grow from development to series production.
 
 RESPONSIBILITIES: 
 Prepare inspection plans, checklists, stage-inspection points and acceptance criteria from drawings, specifications and customer requirements. Carry out and approve incoming, in-process and final inspection of mechanical parts, electronic assemblies, wiring harnesses and finished products. Perform and document First Article Inspection (FAI) to AS9102 for new and changed parts and assemblies. Do dimensional inspection with GD&T, using precision instruments such as CMM, height gauge, micrometres, bore gauges, profile projector and surface roughness tester. Witness and record functional and electrical tests, including Acceptance Test Procedures (ATP), insulation resistance, dielectric withstand (HV), continuity and performance checks. Check that special processes (plating, anodising, heat treatment, welding, potting, conformal coating) and material certificates meet specification. Use material verification such as XRF where needed. Inspect soldering, crimping and assembly workmanship against IPC-A-610, J-STD-001 and IPC/WHMA-A-620. Raise, investigate and close Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs). Run Material Review Board (MRB) disposition. Drive Root Cause Analysis and CAPA using 8D, Why-Why, Fishbone and similar methods. Manage the calibration programme for inspection, measuring and test equipment, with traceability to NABL-accredited labs. Keep FOD prevention and ESD control (ANSI/ESD S20.20) in place on the shop floor and in assembly areas. Support environmental and EMI/EMC qualification testing (MIL-STD-810, JSS 55555, MIL-STD-461, RTCA DO-160). Check test setups, sequences and records. Coordinate with CEMILAC/RCMA, DGAQA and customer QA representatives for stage inspections, Qualification Test Procedure (QTP) and ATP witnessing, and acceptance. Prepare and maintain quality records: inspection reports, route cards/travellers, test data sheets, Certificates of Conformance and end-item data packs. Carry out supplier and source inspections. Evaluate supplier quality performance and support supplier development. Apply counterfeit-parts prevention and configuration-control practices. Analyse customer complaints, field failures and returned units, and take corrective action. Take part in internal audits, customer audits and AS9100D surveillance audits. Contribute to updating procedures and work instructions. Use quality tools such as PFMEA to improve processes and reduce defects. 

 KEY COMPETENCIES 
 Strong attention to detail and a firm commitment to quality in products and processes. Hands-on skill in dimensional metrology and GD&T (ASME Y14.5 / IS 8000), and the ability to read and interpret engineering drawings. Good knowledge of material processing, surface finish, special processes and assembly practices. Working knowledge of electrical and electronic test methods and instruments (DMM, insulation tester, HV tester, oscilloscope, power supplies). Familiarity with IPC workmanship standards (IPC-A-610, J-STD-001, IPC/WHMA-A-620). Practical experience with quality tools: FAI (AS9102), NCR/MRB, RCA, 8D, CAPA, PFMEA, SPC and MSA. Good grounding in MIL-STDs, MIL-PRFs, MIL-SPECs, MOPS, GOST and other defence and aerospace standards (e.g. MIL-STD-810, JSS 55555, MIL-STD-461, RTCA DO-160, GOST protocols). Knowledge of IMTAR 21 V2.0 and IMAP 2023 is required. Prior experience on projects requiring certification by CEMILAC/RCMA/DGAQA/CRI/DGCA, or working with HAL/BEL as a customer, or working at HAL/BEL/DRDO. Prior experience working in an AS9100D environment, including internal and external audits. Disciplined, audit-ready documentation habits and the integrity to hold acceptance criteria under schedule pressure. A problem-solving attitude, curiosity and willingness to learn. Clear written and spoken English, and the confidence to deal with customer inspectors and suppliers. 
 HOW TO APPLY 
Send your CVs to hiring@kokasa.in
