It is the largest managed health care company in the Blue Cross Blue Shield (BCBS) Association serving more than 112 million individuals across 14 states. A regular in Fortune 500 list, Elevance Health ranked 18 in 2026. Gail Boudreaux , President and CEO of Elevance Health has been a consistent name in the Fortune list of most powerful women and currently holds 81st rank on this list. ABOUT CARELON GLOBAL SOLUTIONS Carelon Global Solutions (CGS) is a healthcare solutions company simplifying complex operational processes to improve the health of the healthcare system. Previously known as Legato Health Technologies, Carelon Global Solutions (hereinafter, CGS) underwent a name change and joined the Carelon family of brands in January 2023, as a fully owned subsidiary of Elevance Health (Previously Anthem Inc.). CGS brings together a global team of like-minded innovators who manage and optimize operational processes for health plans as well as providers. Our brightest minds housed across our global headquarters in Indianapolis as well as Bengaluru, Hyderabad and Gurugram in India, Manila in the Philippines, and San Juan in Puerto Rico bring with them innovative capabilities and an unmatched depth of experience. This global team uniquely positions CGS to enable scalable, next-generation platforms and specialized digital tools that make healthcare operations more practical, effective, and efficient. OUR MISSION & VALUES Our Mission: Improving Lives and Communities. Simplifying Healthcare. Expecting More.
 Our Values: Leadership | Community | Integrity | Agility | Diversity JOB PURPOSE Carelon Global Solutions India is seeking a Senior Manager Architecture to lead architecture and end-to-end implementation of enterprise pharmacy management capabilities for CarelonRx. The role owns technical vision, solution architecture, engineering execution, implementation readiness, and platform outcomes across complex, multi-system pharmacy transformation programs. The position is intentionally weighted toward architecture, engineering, AI-enabled Spec-Driven Development, and large-scale implementation leadership. Delivery administration is a supporting responsibility, not the primary mandate. The leader will combine strong software engineering depth with practical pharmacy and PBM domain knowledge to translate business capabilities into secure, scalable, resilient, and operable platforms. JOB RESPONSIBILITY Enterprise Pharmacy Architecture Define and govern target-state solution architecture for end-to-end pharmacy management systems, aligned with enterprise architecture, security, data, privacy, resiliency, and regulatory guardrails. Create capability maps, domain boundaries, reference architectures, reusable patterns, integration standards, and modernization roadmaps across the pharmacy ecosystem. Lead architecture decisions for microservices, APIs, event streaming, workflow orchestration, data platforms, cloud-native services, observability, and interoperability with legacy platforms. Own architecture reviews, trade-off decisions, non-functional requirements, technical debt strategy, and design assurance from concept through production adoption. End-To-End Pharmacy Platform Implementation Lead implementation across relevant pharmacy and PBM capabilities such as benefit configuration, formulary, eligibility, claims adjudication, pricing, prior authorization, pharmacy networks, specialty pharmacy, clinical programs, rebates, member and provider experiences, and operational reporting. Translate business journeys and pharmacy operating models into domain-aligned services, data contracts, interfaces, implementation increments, migration plans, and measurable acceptance criteria. Own the technical implementation lifecycle covering discovery, architecture, engineering, integration, data conversion, testing strategy, cutover, production readiness, stabilization, and benefits realization. Manage cross-platform dependencies and ensure that application, data, infrastructure, security, operations, and vendor workstreams converge into one implementable solution. Drive phased rollout, coexistence, migration, and decommissioning strategies that protect member, client, pharmacy, and operational continuity. AI-Enabled Spec-Driven Development (SDD) Establish an AI-first Spec-Driven Development approach in which approved business, architecture, interface, security, testing, and operational specifications become the governed source for implementation. Enable engineering agents and copilots to accelerate design elaboration, code generation, test creation, documentation, code review, traceability, and impact analysis, with human review and approval at critical control points. Define reusable SDD templates, prompt and context standards, repository conventions, quality gates, evaluation criteria, and responsible AI controls for enterprise adoption. Measure SDD outcomes using baselines and agreed targets for engineering cycle time, specification-to-code traceability, automated test coverage, escaped defects, rework, deployment frequency, and productivity improvement. Ensure AI-generated artifacts meet enterprise standards for security, privacy, intellectual property, explainability, maintainability, and auditability. Engineering Excellence And Hands-On Technical Leadership Provide credible, hands-on technical leadership through design reviews, code and API reviews, proof-of-concept direction, critical problem solving, performance analysis, and production diagnostics. Guide teams on software design principles, domain-driven design, secure coding, automated testing, DevSecOps, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, reliability engineering, and cloud cost optimization. Define engineering scorecards and quality gates covering code health, architecture compliance, security vulnerabilities, reliability, performance, recoverability, maintainability, and operational readiness. Champion platform engineering, reusable services, developer experience, automated environments, and self-service capabilities that reduce implementation friction at scale. Large-Scale Implementation Leadership Lead multiple engineering teams and technical workstreams across product, architecture, software engineering, data, quality engineering, cloud, security, operations, and partner organizations. Create an integrated technical implementation plan that connects architecture runway, dependency sequencing, environment readiness, test strategy, migration, cutover, and operational acceptance. Act as the senior technical decision-maker for complex implementation risks, cross-team conflicts, architecture exceptions, integration failures, and production-readiness gaps. Provide transparent executive-level reporting on architecture health, implementation progress, critical dependencies, risk exposure, quality, readiness, and realized business outcomes. Build governance that is lightweight but effective, emphasizing decision velocity, measurable technical outcomes, and removal of systemic blockers rather than delivery administration. Pharmacy Domain And Stakeholder Partnership Apply working knowledge of the prescription lifecycle, PBM operations, payer and pharmacy interactions, clinical and utilization management, drug data, pricing, formulary, claims, and applicable industry transactions and regulations. Partner with pharmacy business leaders, product managers, enterprise architects, security, operations, compliance, and client teams to shape solutions that are technically sound and operationally adoptable. Convert domain policies, rules, and exceptions into explicit specifications, testable requirements, decision services, and traceable implementation controls. Challenge assumptions using outside-in engineering and pharmacy-platform practices while tailoring recommendations to CarelonRx business priorities and enterprise constraints. People And Capability Leadership Build, lead, and mentor engineering managers, solution architects, principal engineers, technical leads, developers, quality engineers, and platform specialists across distributed teams. Establish clear technical accountabilities, architecture ownership, engineering career paths, succession plans, and communities of practice for pharmacy engineering and AI SDD. Create a culture of engineering rigor, transparent decision-making, experimentation, learning, inclusion, and accountability for outcomes. Assess capability gaps and execute hiring, upskilling, partner augmentation, and workforce plans required for large-scale implementation. Delivery Governance As A Supporting Responsibility Partner with product and program leadership on planning, investment sequencing, release readiness, dependency management, and risk escalation. Use delivery metrics only as supporting indicators. Primary accountability remains architecture quality, end-to-end implementation integrity, engineering excellence, and business capability outcomes. Ensure commitments are realistic, technically grounded, and supported by clear specifications, measurable acceptance criteria, and production-readiness evidence. QUALIFICATION Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline; postgraduate qualification is preferred. Strong foundation in software engineering, enterprise solution architecture, systems integration, cloud engineering, data architecture, cybersecurity, and operational resilience. Demonstrated ability to communicate architecture and implementation choices to business executives, product leaders, engineers, risk partners, and external vendors. Ability to lead through ambiguity, make evidence-based trade-offs, and connect pharmacy business outcomes to technical architecture and implementation decisions. Working knowledge of Agile, product operating models, DevSecOps, secure SDLC, and modern engineering governance. EXPERIENCE 15+ years of progressive experience in software engineering, solution architecture, enterprise platforms, and technology implementation, including 5+ years leading engineering managers, architects, or large technical teams. Proven leadership of large-scale, multi-year enterprise implementations involving multiple applications, complex integrations, data migration, cloud platforms, distributed teams, and production cutover. Relevant healthcare, pharmacy, or PBM experience, with demonstrable understanding of end-to-end pharmacy capabilities and their technology implications. Demonstrated experience defining target architecture and taking complex platforms from architecture through implementation, production readiness, stabilization, and measurable adoption. Experience applying AI-assisted engineering, Spec-Driven Development, agentic workflows, or comparable automation across the SDLC with appropriate human oversight and governance. Experience managing strategic vendors and globally distributed teams while retaining internal ownership of architecture, engineering quality, and implementation outcomes. Experience modernizing legacy systems using APIs, microservices, event-driven patterns, cloud-native platforms, automated testing, DevSecOps, observability, and reliability practices. SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES Core Technical Competencies Enterprise and solution architecture; domain-driven design; capability modeling; microservices; API-first and event-driven architecture; integration and interoperability patterns. Java and/or .NET engineering ecosystems; REST and GraphQL APIs; event-streaming platforms; containers and Kubernetes; Azure and/or AWS; CI/CD; infrastructure as code; observability and SRE practices. Data architecture, master and reference data, transactional and analytical data patterns, data quality, lineage, privacy, and secure information exchange. Architecture fitness functions, performance engineering, resilience, disaster recovery, security-by-design, threat modeling, and production operability. Pharmacy And Healthcare Domain Competencies Prescription and pharmacy claims lifecycle; benefit configuration; formulary and utilization management; eligibility; pricing; pharmacy networks; specialty and mail pharmacy; clinical programs; rebates; member and provider journeys. Awareness of healthcare and pharmacy interoperability, transaction standards, regulatory obligations, data privacy, and audit requirements relevant to the assigned platform scope. AI and SDD Competencies Spec-Driven Development, AI-assisted software engineering, agent orchestration, retrieval and context patterns, prompt and evaluation practices, automated testing, traceability, and responsible AI governance. Ability to establish engineering baselines, controlled pilots, adoption guardrails, and measurable value realization for AI-enabled development. Leadership Competencies Strategic thinking, systems thinking, executive communication, architecture decision-making, technical talent development, vendor leadership, influencing without authority, and crisis leadership. Bias for simplification, measurable outcomes, engineering quality, operational accountability, and continuous improvement. Preferred Certifications Cloud architecture certification in Azure or AWS. AI, machine learning, responsible AI, or generative AI certification. Healthcare or pharmacy domain certification, where applicable. SAFe Agilist or equivalent product and Agile leadership certification. title: Demand Planning SME - o9 IBP & SOE
description:
Job Description Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondel z International Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Make It Possible. You will develop the 0-24-month IBP forecast by brand and at the stock keeping unit (SKU) level. You will coordinate, challenge and influence building block with input from sales, marketing and other partners. In addition, you will review the disaggregated short-term demand plan, which includes SKU/location mix and weekly pacing. Finally, you will provide the finalized detailed demand plan by SKU to supply planners and adjust it based on feedback from supply planners or commercial teams. How you will contribute You will: Contribute to the demand management cycle of the integrated business planning (IBP) process for your categories and to strategy and structure discussions Liaise with the commercial and operational teams and develop ways to continuously improve communication between the functions to support the delivery of the business KPIs for their families Manage forecast compilation process, which includes owning the short-term weekly plan and the long-term forecast (three or more months) Interact with modelling team to generate statistical forecasting Participate in the integrated business planning process and manage the demand planning tool Perform root-cause analysis for continuous plan improvement for key service issues, forecast error and bias, and share output with appropriate leadership What you will bring A desire to drive your future and accelerate your career and the following experience and knowledge: Experience in a fast-moving consumer goods or consumer packaged goods environment, preferably in food or other fast moving, dynamic industry where shelf life is a constraint Experience within an IBP/S&OP environment Able to influence cross-functional teams, working on priorities and improving the plan Excellent problem-solving skills, analytical skills - and able to understand and interpret data Strong verbal and written communication skills Team player who can work with many other functions on a daily basis More about this role What you need to know about this position: You will be an integral part of the implementation and go-live of the new planning solution (o9) within the AMEA region, with a primary focus on executing Integration Testing (I Test), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), data validation, and end-user training. You will work closely with the BU Champion and regional SME leads to ensure the solution is thoroughly tested, validated, and ready for business adoption. Meanwhile, as an early foundation of demand analysis role, this role would require business insights to deep dive into forecast error reasons and improve the AIML/Operation fcst KPI with BU team. 
 What extra ingredients you will bring: Solid understanding of Demand Planning processes (statistical forecasting, consensus planning, demand sensing) 4-8 years of relevant experience in Supply Chain Planning or a related operational role Familiarity with planning tools/systems; exposure to advanced planning solutions (o9, Kinaxis, OMP, SAP IBP) is a necessity. Strong attention to detail - ability to execute test scripts methodically and identify data discrepancies Comfortable working with testing tools (qTest, Jira) and documenting test results and defects Good communication skills - ability to train and support peers in a clear, structured manner Collaborative mindset with ability to work in cross-functional, multi-market teams under tight timelines Growth mindset, quick learner, and comfortable navigating ambiguity in a fast-paced transformation environment Proficiency in English; additional regional language skills are a plus 
 Education / Certifications: Bachelors Degree or postgraduate. With relevant Demand planning experience. 
 Job specific requirements: The Demand Planning SME will serve as the BUs dedicated testing and adoption resource for the o9 Demand Planning module. Reporting into the region DP transformation lead, this role is responsible for executing test scripts, validating data integrity, supporting training delivery, and ensuring seamless transition from testing to go-live. The SME will act as the first line of support for end users, bridging the gap between the technical implementation team and the business, and championing user confidence and adoption of the new platform. 
 Testing & Validation Execute Integration Test (iTest) and UAT test scripts end-to-end for Demand Planning processes, ensuring 100% script coverage as per the test strategy Validate pre-load and post-load data accuracy during User Cutover Testing (UCUT), flagging discrepancies and coordinating resolution with the data and cutover teams Perform security role validation - test user access, roles, and permissions ahead of each testing phase Log, track, and follow up on defects in qTest/Jira, ensuring timely resolution within SLA and supporting retesting of failed test cases Execute E2E (End-to-End) scenario testing including cross-stream scenarios with Data Science, Supply Planning, and IBP Support pre-test preparation including batch job readiness, test script pre-requisites documentation, and environment checks Participate in daily testing war rooms, morning kick-offs, and end-of-day recaps to report progress, blockers, and pass rates Training & Change Adoption Support the delivery of Pre-UAT and UAT training sessions for BU end users, including o9 system basics, Day-in-the-Life (DILO) walkthroughs, and advanced DP system training Conduct shadow testing sessions - walk end users through test scripts and o9 navigation to build familiarity and confidence Act as a go-to resource for end users during testing phases, providing real-time guidance on o9 processes and ways of working Support the BU Champion in driving change management activities, user communications, and adoption governance Contribute to training material review and localization for BU-specific contexts Go-Live & Sustainment Support Parallel Run execution - assist end users in running DILO/MILO cycles using real business cases to validate outcomes Participate in BU Readiness Checkpoints and contribute to UAT sign-off documentation Provide hypercare support post go-live, acting as the first point of contact for end-user queries and issues Document lessons learned, process gaps, and improvement opportunities from testing phases to feed into sustainment planning Support the institutionalization of new ways of working and standard operating procedures in the o9 platform Demand Analysis Support High data quality management before modelling run - co-work with market planner and stakeholder to set foundation of master data, transaction and driver data. Closely working with data scientists to maintain the highest degree of forecast at item and planning accounts level based on industry trends and demand patterns. Conduct forecast review and analysis to assess demand trends, measure forecast accuracy, recommend data-driven adjustments. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support product lifecycle milestones, ensuring accurate demand planning for new items. Propose and implement forecasting improvements to enhance demand accuracy and efficiency. Partner with market planners to review KPIs, gather market insights, and translating market insights into actionable forecast adjustments. Monitor and ensure KPI metrics consistently meet business goals. Provide weekly performance recaps, including ASE performance reviews, root cause analysis, and action plans aligned with business operations. No Relocation support available Business Unit Summary Headquartered in Singapore, Mondel z International s Asia, Middle East and Africa (AMEA) region is comprised of six business units, has more than 21,000 employees and operates in more than 27 countries including Australia, China, Indonesia, Ghana, India, Japan, Malaysia, New Zealand, Nigeria, Philippines, Saudi Arabia, South Africa, Thailand, United Arab Emirates and Vietnam. Seventy-six nationalities work across a network of more than 35 manufacturing plants, three global research and development technical centers and in offices stretching from Auckland, New Zealand to Casablanca, Morocco. Mondel z International in the AMEA region is the proud maker of global and local iconic brands such as Oreo and belVita biscuits, Kinh Do mooncakes, Cadbury, Cadbury Dairy Milk and Milka chocolate, Halls candy, Stride gum, Tang powdered beverage and Philadelphia cheese. We are also proud to be named a Top Employer in many of our markets. Mondel z International is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation or preference, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. title: Associate Payroll Manager
description:
Job Description 
 Position: Associate Manager-Payroll 
 Department: Human Resources
 Location: Pune
 Reporting To: Head of C&B & HR Operations 
 Experience: 5 to 10 years (depending on role level)
 
The role is responsible for managing end-to-end payroll operations through ZingHR, statutory compliance, and payroll accounting, ensuring accurate and timely salary processing, adherence to applicable labour laws and statutory regulations, and proper accounting and reconciliation of payroll-related costs and liabilities.
 
The incumbent will coordinate with HR, Finance, Accounts, Taxation, Internal Audit, and external payroll vendors to ensure payroll accuracy, financial integrity, regulatory compliance, and adherence to established processes and controls.
 
The role requires a strong focus on payroll accuracy, statutory compliance, accounting reconciliations, audit readiness, and payroll cost reporting, ensuring efficient execution of payroll operations and timely closure of payroll-related activities.
 
 Required Qualifications, Experience & Competencies 
 Graduate/Postgraduate in Finance, Commerce, HR, or a related discipline; relevant professional qualifications or payroll certifications preferred. 5 to 10 years of experience in payroll operations, statutory compliance, and payroll accounting, preferably in a large or multi-location organization. Strong knowledge of Indian payroll legislation, labour laws, statutory deductions, and employee taxation. Hands-on experience in payroll journal entries, GL and balance sheet reconciliations, provisions, and month-end financial closing. Experience managing large employee populations, multiple legal entities, complex salary structures, and payroll vendors. Working knowledge of HRMS/payroll systems, preferably ZingHR or equivalent. Advanced MS Excel skills, including data analysis, complex calculations, MIS reporting, dashboard preparation, and reconciliation. Strong numerical aptitude, analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret payroll data accurately. Excellent stakeholder management and coordination skills, with high standards of accuracy, confidentiality, integrity, and attention to detail. Ability to manage strict timelines, multiple priorities, internal controls, compliance risks, vendor coordination, and continuous process improvement. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 1. End-to-End Payroll Management & MIS Reporting 
 Execute accurate and timely monthly payroll processing, including attendance, leave, fixed/variable pay, incentives, arrears, reimbursements, deductions, and full and final settlements. Validate employee master data, salary structures, CTC revisions, increments, promotions, transfers, exits, and payroll inputs. Coordinate with HR, Regional HR, Operations, and Finance for timely payroll inputs and approvals. Prepare monthly payroll MIS covering headcount, payroll costs, net salary, statutory costs, deductions, and other employee expenses; support budgeting, forecasting, accruals, and management reporting. Track statutory liabilities, payroll provisions, unreconciled balances, and outstanding payments; drive payroll automation and process improvements. Ensure timely Full and Final (F&F) settlement and closure for exiting employees. Respond to and resolve queries raised by internal stakeholders promptly. 
 2. Statutory Compliance & Taxation 
 Ensure timely compliance with PF, ESIC, PT, LWF, TDS, gratuity, and other applicable statutory requirements. Monitor changes in labour laws, wage definitions, statutory limits, contribution rates, and tax regulations, assessing their impact on payroll and employee costs. Coordinate statutory calculations, reconciliations, payments, returns, and filings within prescribed timelines. Manage employee tax declarations, investment proofs, tax calculations, TDS deductions, and annual payroll tax activities. Maintain a statutory compliance calendar and ensure timely compliance across locations and legal entities. 
 3. Payroll Accounting & Financial Reconciliation 
 Prepare and post payroll journal entries, ensuring accurate accounting of salaries, benefits, deductions, statutory liabilities, and payroll provisions in the General Ledger (GL). Reconcile payroll registers, payroll summaries, bank payments, GL balances, and statutory liabilities, investigating and resolving discrepancies. Ensure accurate accounting of advances, loans, reimbursements, incentives, bonuses, arrears, recoveries, and full and final settlements. Review payroll provisions, including variable pay, bonus, gratuity, and leave encashment, in coordination with Finance. Ensure accurate cost allocation across cost centres, business units, locations, and legal entities. Support monthly, quarterly, and annual financial closing, including accruals, reversals, reclassifications, balance sheet schedules, and timely closure of outstanding accounting items. 
 4. Audit, Controls & Governance 
 Ensure adherence to internal policies, financial controls, approval workflows, and delegation of authority. Maintain complete audit trails and documentation for payroll inputs, changes, approvals, payments, statutory filings, and accounting entries. Coordinate internal, statutory, financial, and payroll compliance audits, providing required records and supporting timely closure of audit observations.

title: Data Integration Engineer (Senior Associate)
description:
Job Summary Grant Thornton GTech s Data Analytics function is dedicated to designing and delivering robust global data platforms that enable business solutions and high-quality analytics. The Analytics Engineer is responsible for building curated, analytics-ready datasets and semantic models that bridge data engineering and analytics, enabling trusted reporting and self-service consumption within the organization s Data Lakehouse. This hands-on role focuses on transformation development (dbt), dimensional modeling, semantic-layer and BI delivery (Power BI), and data quality. Working closely with Business teams, Data Architects, Data Engineers, and Analysts, the Analytics Engineer turns business requirements into well-structured, governed, and performant data products that serve as a trusted foundation for analytics, reporting, and AI. Responsibilities Design, build, and maintain curated, analytics-ready (gold-layer) datasets and semantic models that enable trusted reporting and self-service consumption. Develop and maintain modular, well-documented data transformations using dbt, following established engineering standards and reusable patterns. Build and optimize dimensional models (star/snowflake schemas, data marts) aligned with the Medallion architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold layer separation). Develop semantic models, metric definitions, and certified datasets in Snowflake and Power BI to support consistent, governed analytics consumption. Translate business and reporting requirements into transformation logic and business rules in partnership with data analysts and stakeholders. Conduct data profiling, validation, and reconciliation using Snowflake SQL to ensure the accuracy, completeness, and integrity of analytics outputs. Perform data lineage and impact analysis across Snowflake, upstream sources, transformation layers, and reporting layers. Implement data quality checks, tests, and observability for analytics pipelines and datasets. Optimize Snowflake queries, models, and transformations for performance, reliability, and cost efficiency. Collaborate with data engineers, ETL/ELT developers, and QA, and support UAT to resolve data-related gaps through iterative testing and validation. Apply governance-by-design practices (access, classification/metadata, certified datasets), and mentor and guide more junior team members. Skills Proven experience with Machine Learning, predictive analytics, and natural language processing. Strong programming skills in SQL and Python for data validation, profiling, reconciliation, and analytics. Strong hands-on Snowflake experience is required, including, ability to construct optimize complex SQL queries, variant/JSON parsing, schema and stage understanding, performance analysis troubleshooting, dynamic tables/materialized views, dbt-on-Snowflake (Streams Tasks), and secure views/masking for certified datasets. Working experience in Medallion Architecture (Bronze, Silver, Gold data layers) including mapping data flows across layers. Strong hands-on experience with dbt for building and maintaining modular, tested data transformations (ELT/ETL development and maintenance). Hands-on experience building semantic models and reports in Power BI (metric definitions, certified datasets, and self-service enablement). Experience developing curated, analytics-ready (gold-layer) datasets and reusable transformation patterns.

title: Senior Data Engineer (Platform & Streaming)
description:
Level: Senior / SDE-III equivalent 
 Experience: 58 years Location: India (Hybrid) — or Pune / Remote-India Type: Full-time 
 Reports to: Engineering Manager, Data Platform About the Role We're hiring a Senior Data Engineer to own the design and delivery of production data pipelines that power analytics, reconciliation, and AI workloads. 
 This is a hands-on build role — you'll write Spark and Python daily, make architecture calls on ingestion and storage design, and take responsibility for pipelines that run under real reliability and compliance pressure. You'll work across batch and streaming, structured and unstructured data, and increasingly on the data layer that feeds retrieval and LLM applications. What You'll Do Design and ship end-to-end data pipelines — ingestion, transformation, storage, and serving — for both batch and near-real-time workloads. Build distributed processing jobs in Spark (PySpark/Scala) and optimize them for cost and latency: partitioning strategy, shuffle reduction, file sizing, broadcast joins. Model and maintain a layered data lake (raw processed curated) on S3 or GCS, with clear contracts between zones. Build streaming ingestion on Kafka / Kinesis / MSK for event-driven data, including schema evolution and replay handling. Own orchestration in Airflow (or Dagster) — idempotent DAGs, sensible retries, backfill support, and alerting that fires on the right things. Implement data quality and validation frameworks so bad data fails loudly upstream rather than silently downstream. Write and maintain Terraform for the infrastructure your pipelines depend on, and ship through CI/CD rather than manual deploys. Apply access controls, PII masking, and encryption appropriate to regulated data (HIPAA, PCI, or equivalent). Build ingestion and processing paths for unstructured data — documents, logs, semi-structured JSON — including chunking, embedding generation, and vector store integration. Review designs and code from other engineers, and mentor mid-level engineers on distributed systems fundamentals. Required Qualifications 5+ years building production data pipelines, with at least 2 years at a senior or lead level of ownership. Strong Python — modular, tested, production-grade code, not just scripts. Deep Spark experience (PySpark and/or Scala), including performance tuning of real jobs at scale. Advanced SQL: query optimization, indexing, partitioning, and data modeling for analytical workloads. Production experience with a workflow orchestrator (Airflow, Dagster, or similar). Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud (AWS or GCP) — including storage, compute, networking basics (VPC, subnets, routing), and IAM. Docker in production, and working familiarity with Kubernetes deployments. Infrastructure as Code with Terraform, and CI/CD for data systems. Experience with streaming ingestion using Kafka or a managed equivalent. A track record of delivering under compliance or governance constraints in a regulated domain. Nice to Have Scala for Spark, or Go for data services and tooling. dbt for transformation and testing in the warehouse layer. Databricks, BigQuery, or Snowflake at production scale. Vector databases (pgvector, Pinecone, or similar) and embedding pipelines for RAG systems. Migration experience — legacy batch to Spark, or cross-language platform rewrites. Exposure to fintech, healthcare, or another domain with strict data handling requirements. title: Data Analytics Analyst
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION 
 Data Analytics 
 About the Role 
Corporate Chanakya Services Pvt. Ltd. is looking for a skilled and analytical Data Analyst with 1 and 2 years of relevant experience in Python-based data analytics, data processing, and reporting. The ideal candidate must have practical knowledge of Python libraries used for data analysis and the ability to transform raw datasets into meaningful business insights.
The candidate will be responsible for collecting, cleaning, processing, analysing, and visualising data, developing reports and dashboards, identifying trends, and supporting data-driven business decisions. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Collect, consolidate, clean, validate, and process data from multiple sources. Use Python to perform data analysis, data manipulation, exploratory data analysis (EDA), and statistical analysis. Work with Python libraries such as Pandas and NumPy to process and analyse structured datasets. Identify trends, patterns, correlations, anomalies, and inconsistencies in datasets. Create meaningful charts and visualisations using Matplotlib, Seaborn, or similar libraries. Write SQL queries to extract, filter, join, and analyse data from databases. Use Microsoft Excel for data validation, calculations, data reconciliation, and reporting. Develop and maintain dashboards and reports using Power BI or Tableau. Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly analytical reports, MIS reports, and performance summaries. Automate repetitive data processing and reporting tasks using Python wherever feasible. Validate data accuracy, investigate discrepancies, and maintain data quality. Translate business requirements into analytical tasks and provide actionable insights to management. Maintain proper documentation of datasets, analysis methods, KPIs, and reporting processes. Handle company and client data responsibly and maintain strict confidentiality. 
 Required Technical Skills 
 Python for Data Analytics (Mandatory) : Python, Pandas, NumPy, exploratory data analysis (EDA), data cleaning, data manipulation, and visualisation using Matplotlib or Seaborn. SQL : SELECT, WHERE, JOINs, GROUP BY, ORDER BY, aggregate functions, subqueries, and data extraction. Microsoft Excel : Advanced formulas, PivotTables, PivotCharts, XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, IF functions, conditional formatting, data validation, and Power Query. Power BI or Tableau : Dashboard development, KPI reporting, data visualisation, and basic data modelling. Statistics and Data Analysis : Descriptive statistics, averages, percentages, variance, trend analysis, correlation, and interpretation of results. 
 Preferred Skills 
 Experience automating analytical workflows and recurring reports using Python. Familiarity with Jupyter Notebook or similar Python development environments. Knowledge of connecting Python to SQL databases or APIs. Experience combining data from multiple sources, including Excel, CSV files, and databases. Basic understanding of predictive analytics, regression, and statistical modelling. Familiarity with Git or version-control tools is an advantage. 
 Educational Qualifications 
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Commerce, Engineering, or a related discipline. Candidates with relevant certifications or practical projects in Python-based data analytics will be preferred. 
 Experience Requirements 
 1 and 2 years of relevant professional experience in Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, MIS Reporting, or a related role. Practical experience using Python for data analytics is mandatory. Candidates should demonstrate the ability to clean, analyse, and interpret real-world datasets. Experience creating analytical reports, dashboards, or automated data workflows will be an advantage. 
 Key Competencies 
 Strong analytical and logical thinking. Excellent problem-solving and critical-thinking abilities. Attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy. Ability to interpret complex datasets and communicate findings clearly. Good written and verbal communication skills. Ability to manage multiple assignments and meet deadlines. Willingness to learn new tools and improve analytical processes. 
 Application Process 
Interested candidates who meet the above requirements may share their updated resumes with the HR team.

title: Senior Data Scientist - AdTech / MarTech
description:
Job Description We are looking for a Senior Data Scientist to join our outcome data pod. You will evaluate third-party consumer, business, panel and outcome data, and turn validated data into features for a household-level intelligence layer that powers audience and measurement use cases. This is an analysis-led role. You will test what a data provider s data actually delivers, using real samples, rather than relying on the provider s reported numbers. You need a solid grasp of how the consumer and business data ecosystem works, including identity resolution, data licensing and audience data. You will work closely with Data Engineering and report findings that are sourced, reproducible and clear to non-technical stakeholders.
 
 Key Responsibilities: Evaluate third-party outcome, panel and video data against real data samples. Measure match rate, label precision, geographic distribution, deduplication and bot quality, and viewership precision. Design and run match-rate testing to independently validate provider-reported figures, using both deterministic and probabilistic matching approaches. Map provider-specific schemas and data dictionaries into a shared feature taxonomy. Build feature definitions and data-quality checks for a feature store supporting a household embedding model of roughly 100 features. Document data-quality findings in a standard scorecard format, with a clear evidence trail that others can reproduce. Identify privacy and consent gaps in third-party data, such as unclear consent for ML training, and escalate them for legal review. Partner with Data Engineering to define the validated schema each data pipeline should deliver. Present findings and recommendations to business and technical stakeholders. Qualifications Must Have Skills 6+ years of experience in data science or advanced analytics, ideally in adtech, martech, data brokerage or programmatic/real-time platforms. Statistical analysis of sample and panel data: match-rate testing, deduplication and bot detection, and geographic (DMA-level) distribution analysis. Strong Python (pandas, scikit-learn or equivalent) and SQL. Working knowledge of identity resolution: hashed PII, deterministic vs. probabilistic matching, and MAID, HEM and household-ID concepts. Experience matching and joining disparate datasets, including third-party consumer and business data. Experience evaluating third-party or panel data quality: data dictionary review, sample audits, provenance and overlap checks. Feature engineering for downstream ML and embedding use. Clear written communication of quantitative findings to non-technical stakeholders. Good to Have Experience with feature stores or embedding-based customer or household representations. Exposure to marketing and media measurement, telecom or advertising audience data. Familiarity with data clean-room platforms (Snowflake Data Clean Rooms, LiveRamp, Habu, InfoSum). Experience with Snowflake or Databricks. Working familiarity with CCPA and consent frameworks, enough to recognize gaps rather than adjudicate them.

title: Group Procurement & Cost Control Manager Australian Hospitality
company: KVMN Group Australian Hospitality & Business Group
description:
Procurement & Cost Control Manager Australian Hospitality Group Company: KVMN Group
 Location: Gota, Ahmedabad, Gujarat
 Experience: Minimum 3 Years (Mandatory)
 Employment: Full-Time | Work From Office About the Opportunity KVMN Group, a growing Australian hospitality business group operating multiple pubs, bars, restaurants and breweries across Perth, Western Australia, is seeking a highly intelligent, analytical and commercially focused Procurement & Cost Control Manager for our Ahmedabad office. We are not looking for someone who simply raises purchase orders or places orders with suppliers. We need a sharp negotiator, analytical thinker and commercially minded professional who knows how to challenge supplier pricing, identify unnecessary spending, track product costs and deliver measurable savings. Your primary responsibility will be simple: Reduce our cost of goods without compromising product quality, consistency or operational efficiency. Key Responsibilities 1. Supplier Negotiation & Cost Reduction Negotiate aggressively and professionally with suppliers to secure competitive pricing, rebates, discounts and favourable trading terms. Continuously compare supplier prices and identify cost-saving opportunities. Source alternative suppliers and equivalent products without compromising quality. Challenge unnecessary price increases and negotiate better commercial agreements. Build strong supplier relationships while protecting company profitability. 2. Product Price Tracking & Analytics Develop and maintain a centralised purchasing price database for all products across our hospitality venues. Track individual SKU prices, historical purchase costs, supplier changes and price fluctuations. Identify products with unusual price increases and investigate discrepancies. Compare identical products purchased across different venues to ensure competitive and consistent pricing. Analyse purchasing trends, supplier performance and category-wise expenditure. Build advanced Excel dashboards and management reports to highlight savings opportunities. 3. Hospitality Cost of Goods Management Monitor and analyse food, beverage, liquor and other hospitality purchasing costs. Work with venue managers, chefs and operations teams to identify opportunities to reduce COGS. Analyse high-volume and high-value purchasing categories to prioritise savings. Identify purchasing inefficiencies, unnecessary expenditure, product duplication and avoidable wastage. Recommend product substitutions, bulk purchasing opportunities and supplier consolidation where commercially beneficial. Support improvements in gross profit margins across all hospitality venues. 4. Purchasing Controls & Supplier Management Review supplier invoices, purchase prices and agreed contract rates. Identify incorrect charges, pricing discrepancies and missed discounts. Maintain supplier price lists, purchasing agreements and negotiation records. Establish purchasing approval processes and cost-control procedures. Monitor supplier reliability, delivery performance and product quality. Ensure purchasing decisions are supported by accurate commercial analysis. 5. Reporting & Business Intelligence Prepare weekly and monthly purchasing analysis reports for senior management. Report achieved cost savings against previous purchasing prices. Develop supplier comparison sheets, price movement reports and spending dashboards. Use Excel, Power BI or similar analytical tools to identify cost reduction opportunities. Present clear recommendations backed by numbers, calculations and commercial reasoning. Candidate Requirements Minimum 3 years of relevant procurement, purchasing, supply chain or cost-control experience is mandatory. We are looking for candidates with: Exceptional negotiation and supplier bargaining skills. Strong analytical and numerical ability. Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including Pivot Tables, XLOOKUP and data analysis. Proven experience in reducing purchasing costs and improving margins. Strong commercial awareness and problem-solving ability. Excellent written and verbal English communication skills. Confidence to challenge supplier quotations and negotiate independently. Experience managing supplier pricing, contracts and purchasing data. High attention to detail and ability to identify even small pricing discrepancies. Ability to work independently and take ownership of measurable cost savings. Preferred Experience: Procurement experience in hotels, restaurants, pubs, bars, catering or food and beverage businesses. Food and liquor purchasing experience. Experience working with Australian or international suppliers. Power BI, inventory systems or ERP software experience. Multi-location or multi-branch purchasing experience. What We Offer Opportunity to manage procurement cost analysis for multiple Australian hospitality venues. Direct interaction with Australian business owners and senior management. High level of independence and decision-making responsibility. International business exposure. Competitive salary based on experience and capability. Long-term career development opportunities. Opportunity to demonstrate your value through measurable financial savings. Important – Who Should Apply? We want candidates who can think commercially, negotiate confidently, analyse data accurately and consistently find ways to save money. If you simply process purchase orders without questioning prices, this role is not suitable for you. If you enjoy finding better deals, analysing supplier costs, negotiating prices and improving profitability, we want to hear from you. Minimum 3 years of relevant experience is mandatory. Freshers will not be considered. Office Location: Gota, Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India. Apply with your updated CV and examples of purchasing cost savings achieved in your previous roles.

Drive coordination between departments rather than allowing issues to remain unresolved between teams. Maintain a solution-oriented approach to project challenges. 11. Strong communication and negotiation skills. Good written and verbal English communication. Ability to work with senior management, clients, consultants and project teams. description:
Job Summary Grant Thornton GTech s Data Analytics function is dedicated to designing and delivering robust global data platforms that enable business solutions and high-quality analytics. The Analytics Engineer is responsible for building curated, analytics-ready datasets and semantic models that bridge data engineering and analytics, enabling trusted reporting and self-service consumption within the organization s Data Lakehouse. This hands-on role focuses on transformation development (dbt), dimensional modeling, semantic-layer and BI delivery (Power BI), and data quality. Working closely with Business teams, Data Architects, Data Engineers, and Analysts, the Analytics Engineer turns business requirements into well-structured, governed, and performant data products that serve as a trusted foundation for analytics, reporting, and AI. Responsibilities Design, build, and maintain curated, analytics-ready (gold-layer) datasets and semantic models that enable trusted reporting and self-service consumption. Develop and maintain modular, well-documented data transformations using dbt, following established engineering standards and reusable patterns. Build and optimize dimensional models (star/snowflake schemas, data marts) aligned with the Medallion architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold layer separation). Develop semantic models, metric definitions, and certified datasets in Snowflake and Power BI to support consistent, governed analytics consumption. Translate business and reporting requirements into transformation logic and business rules in partnership with data analysts and stakeholders. Conduct data profiling, validation, and reconciliation using Snowflake SQL to ensure the accuracy, completeness, and integrity of analytics outputs. Perform data lineage and impact analysis across Snowflake, upstream sources, transformation layers, and reporting layers. Implement data quality checks, tests, and observability for analytics pipelines and datasets. Optimize Snowflake queries, models, and transformations for performance, reliability, and cost efficiency. Collaborate with data engineers, ETL/ELT developers, and QA, and support UAT to resolve data-related gaps through iterative testing and validation. Apply governance-by-design practices (access, classification/metadata, certified datasets), and mentor and guide more junior team members. Skills Proven experience with Machine Learning, predictive analytics, and natural language processing. Strong programming skills in SQL and Python for data validation, profiling, reconciliation, and analytics. Strong hands-on Snowflake experience is required, including, ability to construct optimize complex SQL queries, variant/JSON parsing, schema and stage understanding, performance analysis troubleshooting, dynamic tables/materialized views, dbt-on-Snowflake (Streams Tasks), and secure views/masking for certified datasets. Working experience in Medallion Architecture (Bronze, Silver, Gold data layers) including mapping data flows across layers. Strong hands-on experience with dbt for building and maintaining modular, tested data transformations (ELT/ETL development and maintenance). Hands-on experience building semantic models and reports in Power BI (metric definitions, certified datasets, and self-service enablement). Experience developing curated, analytics-ready (gold-layer) datasets and reusable transformation patterns.

walk end users through test scripts and o9 navigation to build familiarity and confidence Act as a go-to resource for end users during testing phases, providing real-time guidance on o9 processes and ways of working Support the BU Champion in driving change management activities, user communications, and adoption governance Contribute to training material review and localization for BU-specific contexts Go-Live & Sustainment Support Parallel Run execution - assist end users in running DILO/MILO cycles using real business cases to validate outcomes Participate in BU Readiness Checkpoints and contribute to UAT sign-off documentation Provide hypercare support post go-live, acting as the first point of contact for end-user queries and issues Document lessons learned, process gaps, and improvement opportunities from testing phases to feed into sustainment planning Support the institutionalization of new ways of working and standard operating procedures in the o9 platform Demand Analysis Support High data quality management before modelling run - title: Data Integration Engineer (Senior Associate)
description:
Job Summary Grant Thornton GTech s Data Analytics function is dedicated to designing and delivering robust global data platforms that enable business solutions and high-quality analytics. The Analytics Engineer is responsible for building curated, analytics-ready datasets and semantic models that bridge data engineering and analytics, enabling trusted reporting and self-service consumption within the organization s Data Lakehouse. This hands-on role focuses on transformation development (dbt), dimensional modeling, semantic-layer and BI delivery (Power BI), and data quality. Working closely with Business teams, Data Architects, Data Engineers, and Analysts, the Analytics Engineer turns business requirements into well-structured, governed, and performant data products that serve as a trusted foundation for analytics, reporting, and AI. Responsibilities Design, build, and maintain curated, analytics-ready (gold-layer) datasets and semantic models that enable trusted reporting and self-service consumption. Develop and maintain modular, well-documented data transformations using dbt, following established engineering standards and reusable patterns. Build and optimize dimensional models (star/snowflake schemas, data marts) aligned with the Medallion architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold layer separation). Develop semantic models, metric definitions, and certified datasets in Snowflake and Power BI to support consistent, governed analytics consumption. Translate business and reporting requirements into transformation logic and business rules in partnership with data analysts and stakeholders. Conduct data profiling, validation, and reconciliation using Snowflake SQL to ensure the accuracy, completeness, and integrity of analytics outputs. Perform data lineage and impact analysis across Snowflake, upstream sources, transformation layers, and reporting layers. Implement data quality checks, tests, and observability for analytics pipelines and datasets. Collaborate with data engineers, ETL/ELT developers, and QA, and support UAT to resolve data-related gaps through iterative testing and validation. Skills Proven experience with Machine Learning, predictive analytics, and natural language processing. Strong programming skills in SQL and Python for data validation, profiling, reconciliation, and analytics. Strong hands-on Snowflake experience is required, including, ability to construct optimize complex SQL queries, variant/JSON parsing, schema and stage understanding, performance analysis troubleshooting, dynamic tables/materialized views, dbt-on-Snowflake (Streams Tasks), and secure views/masking for certified datasets. Working experience in Medallion Architecture (Bronze, Silver, Gold data layers) including mapping data flows across layers. Strong hands-on experience with dbt for building and maintaining modular, tested data transformations (ELT/ETL development and maintenance). Hands-on experience building semantic models and reports in Power BI (metric definitions, certified datasets, and self-service enablement). Experience developing curated, analytics-ready (gold-layer) datasets and reusable transformation patterns.

title: Enterprise Architecture - Senior Manager Architecture
description:
Position Title: Enterprise Architecture - Senior Manager Architecture - GR - 40551-75745-1 - Job Family: IFT > IT Architecture Shift: 2nd Shift (India) Job Title Senior Manager Architecture Requirement Type Full-Time Employee Job Location Bangalore / Hyderabad / Gurugram Job Level Senior Manager Hiring Manager Senior Director Technology Primary Skill Enterprise Architecture, Pharmacy Platforms, AI Spec-Driven Development Business iRx IDW Data Mgmt Individual Contributor / People Manager People Manager ABOUT ELEVANCE HEALTH Elevance Health is a leading health company in America dedicated to improving lives and communities and making healthcare simpler. It is the largest managed health care company in the Blue Cross Blue Shield (BCBS) Association serving more than 112 million individuals across 14 states. A regular in Fortune 500 list, Elevance Health ranked 18 in 2026. Gail Boudreaux , President and CEO of Elevance Health has been a consistent name in the Fortune list of most powerful women and currently holds 81st rank on this list. ABOUT CARELON GLOBAL SOLUTIONS Carelon Global Solutions (CGS) is a healthcare solutions company simplifying complex operational processes to improve the health of the healthcare system. Previously known as Legato Health Technologies, Carelon Global Solutions (hereinafter, CGS) underwent a name change and joined the Carelon family of brands in January 2023, as a fully owned subsidiary of Elevance Health (Previously Anthem Inc.). CGS brings together a global team of like-minded innovators who manage and optimize operational processes for health plans as well as providers. Our brightest minds housed across our global headquarters in Indianapolis as well as Bengaluru, Hyderabad and Gurugram in India, Manila in the Philippines, and San Juan in Puerto Rico bring with them innovative capabilities and an unmatched depth of experience. This global team uniquely positions CGS to enable scalable, next-generation platforms and specialized digital tools that make healthcare operations more practical, effective, and efficient. OUR MISSION & VALUES Our Mission: Improving Lives and Communities. Simplifying Healthcare. Expecting More.
 Our Values: Leadership | Community | Integrity | Agility | Diversity JOB PURPOSE Carelon Global Solutions India is seeking a Senior Manager Architecture to lead architecture and end-to-end implementation of enterprise pharmacy management capabilities for CarelonRx. The role owns technical vision, solution architecture, engineering execution, implementation readiness, and platform outcomes across complex, multi-system pharmacy transformation programs. The position is intentionally weighted toward architecture, engineering, AI-enabled Spec-Driven Development, and large-scale implementation leadership. Delivery administration is a supporting responsibility, not the primary mandate. The leader will combine strong software engineering depth with practical pharmacy and PBM domain knowledge to translate business capabilities into secure, scalable, resilient, and operable platforms. JOB RESPONSIBILITY Enterprise Pharmacy Architecture Define and govern target-state solution architecture for end-to-end pharmacy management systems, aligned with enterprise architecture, security, data, privacy, resiliency, and regulatory guardrails. Create capability maps, domain boundaries, reference architectures, reusable patterns, integration standards, and modernization roadmaps across the pharmacy ecosystem. Lead architecture decisions for microservices, APIs, event streaming, workflow orchestration, data platforms, cloud-native services, observability, and interoperability with legacy platforms. Own architecture reviews, trade-off decisions, non-functional requirements, technical debt strategy, and design assurance from concept through production adoption. End-To-End Pharmacy Platform Implementation Lead implementation across relevant pharmacy and PBM capabilities such as benefit configuration, formulary, eligibility, claims adjudication, pricing, prior authorization, pharmacy networks, specialty pharmacy, clinical programs, rebates, member and provider experiences, and operational reporting. Translate business journeys and pharmacy operating models into domain-aligned services, data contracts, interfaces, implementation increments, migration plans, and measurable acceptance criteria. Own the technical implementation lifecycle covering discovery, architecture, engineering, integration, data conversion, testing strategy, cutover, production readiness, stabilization, and benefits realization. Manage cross-platform dependencies and ensure that application, data, infrastructure, security, operations, and vendor workstreams converge into one implementable solution. Drive phased rollout, coexistence, migration, and decommissioning strategies that protect member, client, pharmacy, and operational continuity. AI-Enabled Spec-Driven Development (SDD) Establish an AI-first Spec-Driven Development approach in which approved business, architecture, interface, security, testing, and operational specifications become the governed source for implementation. Enable engineering agents and copilots to accelerate design elaboration, code generation, test creation, documentation, code review, traceability, and impact analysis, with human review and approval at critical control points. Define reusable SDD templates, prompt and context standards, repository conventions, quality gates, evaluation criteria, and responsible AI controls for enterprise adoption. Measure SDD outcomes using baselines and agreed targets for engineering cycle time, specification-to-code traceability, automated test coverage, escaped defects, rework, deployment frequency, and productivity improvement. Ensure AI-generated artifacts meet enterprise standards for security, privacy, intellectual property, explainability, maintainability, and auditability. Engineering Excellence And Hands-On Technical Leadership Provide credible, hands-on technical leadership through design reviews, code and API reviews, proof-of-concept direction, critical problem solving, performance analysis, and production diagnostics. Guide teams on software design principles, domain-driven design, secure coding, automated testing, DevSecOps, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, reliability engineering, and cloud cost optimization. Define engineering scorecards and quality gates covering code health, architecture compliance, security vulnerabilities, reliability, performance, recoverability, maintainability, and operational readiness. Champion platform engineering, reusable services, developer experience, automated environments, and self-service capabilities that reduce implementation friction at scale. Large-Scale Implementation Leadership Lead multiple engineering teams and technical workstreams across product, architecture, software engineering, data, quality engineering, cloud, security, operations, and partner organizations. Create an integrated technical implementation plan that connects architecture runway, dependency sequencing, environment readiness, test strategy, migration, cutover, and operational acceptance. Act as the senior technical decision-maker for complex implementation risks, cross-team conflicts, architecture exceptions, integration failures, and production-readiness gaps. Provide transparent executive-level reporting on architecture health, implementation progress, critical dependencies, risk exposure, quality, readiness, and realized business outcomes. Build governance that is lightweight but effective, emphasizing decision velocity, measurable technical outcomes, and removal of systemic blockers rather than delivery administration. Pharmacy Domain And Stakeholder Partnership Apply working knowledge of the prescription lifecycle, PBM operations, payer and pharmacy interactions, clinical and utilization management, drug data, pricing, formulary, claims, and applicable industry transactions and regulations. Partner with pharmacy business leaders, product managers, enterprise architects, security, operations, compliance, and client teams to shape solutions that are technically sound and operationally adoptable. Convert domain policies, rules, and exceptions into explicit specifications, testable requirements, decision services, and traceable implementation controls. Challenge assumptions using outside-in engineering and pharmacy-platform practices while tailoring recommendations to CarelonRx business priorities and enterprise constraints. People And Capability Leadership Build, lead, and mentor engineering managers, solution architects, principal engineers, technical leads, developers, quality engineers, and platform specialists across distributed teams. Establish clear technical accountabilities, architecture ownership, engineering career paths, succession plans, and communities of practice for pharmacy engineering and AI SDD. Create a culture of engineering rigor, transparent decision-making, experimentation, learning, inclusion, and accountability for outcomes. Assess capability gaps and execute hiring, upskilling, partner augmentation, and workforce plans required for large-scale implementation. Delivery Governance As A Supporting Responsibility Partner with product and program leadership on planning, investment sequencing, release readiness, dependency management, and risk escalation. Use delivery metrics only as supporting indicators. Primary accountability remains architecture quality, end-to-end implementation integrity, engineering excellence, and business capability outcomes. Ensure commitments are realistic, technically grounded, and supported by clear specifications, measurable acceptance criteria, and production-readiness evidence. QUALIFICATION Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline; postgraduate qualification is preferred. Strong foundation in software engineering, enterprise solution architecture, systems integration, cloud engineering, data architecture, cybersecurity, and operational resilience. Demonstrated ability to communicate architecture and implementation choices to business executives, product leaders, engineers, risk partners, and external vendors. Ability to lead through ambiguity, make evidence-based trade-offs, and connect pharmacy business outcomes to technical architecture and implementation decisions. Working knowledge of Agile, product operating models, DevSecOps, secure SDLC, and modern engineering governance. EXPERIENCE 15+ years of progressive experience in software engineering, solution architecture, enterprise platforms, and technology implementation, including 5+ years leading engineering managers, architects, or large technical teams. Proven leadership of large-scale, multi-year enterprise implementations involving multiple applications, complex integrations, data migration, cloud platforms, distributed teams, and production cutover. Relevant healthcare, pharmacy, or PBM experience, with demonstrable understanding of end-to-end pharmacy capabilities and their technology implications. Demonstrated experience defining target architecture and taking complex platforms from architecture through implementation, production readiness, stabilization, and measurable adoption. Experience applying AI-assisted engineering, Spec-Driven Development, agentic workflows, or comparable automation across the SDLC with appropriate human oversight and governance. Experience managing strategic vendors and globally distributed teams while retaining internal ownership of architecture, engineering quality, and implementation outcomes. Experience modernizing legacy systems using APIs, microservices, event-driven patterns, cloud-native platforms, automated testing, DevSecOps, observability, and reliability practices. SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES Core Technical Competencies Enterprise and solution architecture; domain-driven design; capability modeling; microservices; API-first and event-driven architecture; integration and interoperability patterns. Java and/or .NET engineering ecosystems; REST and GraphQL APIs; event-streaming platforms; containers and Kubernetes; Azure and/or AWS; CI/CD; infrastructure as code; observability and SRE practices. Data architecture, master and reference data, transactional and analytical data patterns, data quality, lineage, privacy, and secure information exchange. Architecture fitness functions, performance engineering, resilience, disaster recovery, security-by-design, threat modeling, and production operability. Pharmacy And Healthcare Domain Competencies Prescription and pharmacy claims lifecycle; benefit configuration; formulary and utilization management; eligibility; pricing; pharmacy networks; specialty and mail pharmacy; clinical programs; rebates; member and provider journeys. Awareness of healthcare and pharmacy interoperability, transaction standards, regulatory obligations, data privacy, and audit requirements relevant to the assigned platform scope. AI and SDD Competencies Spec-Driven Development, AI-assisted software engineering, agent orchestration, retrieval and context patterns, prompt and evaluation practices, automated testing, traceability, and responsible AI governance. Ability to establish engineering baselines, controlled pilots, adoption guardrails, and measurable value realization for AI-enabled development. Leadership Competencies Strategic thinking, systems thinking, executive communication, architecture decision-making, technical talent development, vendor leadership, influencing without authority, and crisis leadership. Bias for simplification, measurable outcomes, engineering quality, operational accountability, and continuous improvement. Preferred Certifications Cloud architecture certification in Azure or AWS. AI, machine learning, responsible AI, or generative AI certification. Healthcare or pharmacy domain certification, where applicable. SAFe Agilist or equivalent product and Agile leadership certification. Indicative Success Measures Architecture: target-state adoption, design conformance, reuse, technical debt reduction, resilience, security, and platform scalability. Implementation: capability readiness, integration completeness, migration quality, cutover readiness, production stability, adoption, and business outcome realization. Engineering: cycle-time improvement, automation coverage, defect escape reduction, reliability, developer experience, and maintainability. AI SDD: specification coverage and traceability, governed AI adoption, reusable agent workflows, quality of generated artifacts, and validated productivity benefits. Organization: critical-skill coverage, leadership bench strength, team health, succession readiness, and growth of architecture and engineering capability. Delivery: predictable release support and governance compliance, intentionally weighted below architecture, implementation, engineering, and business outcomes. THE CARELON PROMISE Aligning with our brand belief of limitless minds are our biggest asset , we offer a world of limitless opportunities to our associates. It is our strong belief that one is committed to a role when it is not just what the role entails, but also what lies in its periphery that completes the value circle for an associate. This world of limitless opportunities thrives in an environment that fosters growth and well-being, and gives you purpose and the feeling of belonging. LIFE @ CARELON Extensive focus on learning and development An inspiring culture built on innovation, creativity, and freedom. Holistic well-being Our culture and initiatives are underpinned by diversity, equity and inclusion Varied opportunities for rewards and recognitions Competitive health and medical insurance coverage Best-in-class amenities and workspaces Policies designed with associates at the center. description:
About us 
 We are the leading provider of professional services to the middle market globally, our purpose is to instill confidence in a world of change, empowering our clients and people to realize their full potential. Our exceptional people are the key to our unrivaled, inclusive culture and talent experience and our ability to be compelling to our clients. You'll find an environment that inspires and empowers you to thrive both personally and professionally. There's no one like you and that's why there's nowhere like RSM. Position Summary 
 We are seeking a technically strong and analytically minded AI Risk Engineer to join our Technology Risk Consulting team. This role is designed for professionals with a solid academic foundation in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Data Science, Computer Science, or related technical disciplines, combined with hands-on experience supporting AI-enabled products, platforms, or enterprise AI initiatives. The ideal candidate will have demonstrable experience working with global technology organizations or multinational enterprises and will be comfortable collaborating across cross-functional, geographically distributed teams. The role combines technical AI knowledge with risk and advisory thinking to help organizations adopt AI responsibly while managing governance, security, privacy, model performance, compliance, and responsible AI risks. 

 

 Key Responsibilities 
 Perform AI risk, AI governance, responsible AI, and AI assurance assessments across enterprise environments. Evaluate generative AI solutions, machine learning systems, AI agents, AI platforms, and third-party AI services for operational, security, privacy, regulatory, and ethical risks. Assess AI lifecycle processes, including data sourcing, model development, testing, validation, deployment, monitoring, change management, and retirement. Review controls related to bias, fairness, explainability, transparency, accountability, human oversight, model performance, security, and privacy. Analyze AI architectures, workflows, and technical implementations to identify risk exposures and practical mitigation strategies. Support enterprise AI inventory, use-case classification, risk assessment, approval, monitoring, and governance initiatives. Partner with Engineering, Product, Cybersecurity, Legal, Privacy, Compliance, Data, Risk, and business teams to evaluate AI risks and controls. Participate in client workshops and stakeholder interviews, translating technical AI concepts into clear business and risk implications. Prepare client-facing reports, risk assessments, executive summaries, and practical advisory recommendations. Contribute to AI risk methodologies, assessment accelerators, thought leadership, and global engagements delivered through onshore/offshore operating models. 

 

 Required Qualifications 
 Bachelor's or master's degree in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Data Science, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Computational Statistics, Data Analytics, or a closely related technical discipline. 4+ years of experience across AI, machine learning, data science, AI engineering, MLOps, AI platform engineering, Trust & Safety, product risk, technology risk, cybersecurity, model risk management, data governance, or related technology disciplines. Demonstrable experience developing, supporting, evaluating, monitoring, governing, or assessing AI-enabled products, machine learning solutions, or generative AI use cases in production environments. Strong understanding of generative AI, large language models, AI agents, retrieval-augmented generation, model evaluation, AI lifecycle management, and responsible AI principles. Working knowledge of AI risks including bias, fairness, explainability, privacy, security, robustness, model drift, human oversight, and third-party dependencies. Experience working with global firms in cross-functional and geographically distributed teams, including onshore/offshore delivery models. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to technical, business, and executive stakeholders. Demonstrated analytical, problem-solving, consultative, documentation, and stakeholder management skills. 

 

 Preferred Qualifications 
 Experience working for global technology companies, digital-first organizations, cloud providers, hyperscalers, AI product organizations, or large multinational enterprises. Experience supporting AI solutions at scale within production environments. Exposure to Microsoft Copilot, Azure AI, OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Vertex AI, AWS Bedrock, Databricks AI, Hugging Face, or similar enterprise AI technologies. Familiarity with NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, responsible AI frameworks, AI Trust & Safety, AI governance, or AI assurance practices. Experience supporting AI governance programs, AI assurance reviews, AI safety assessments, model evaluations, third-party AI risk reviews, or model risk initiatives. AI or machine learning certification such as AIIA, AIGP, ISO/IEC 42001 Lead Implementer or Auditor, Microsoft Azure AI Engineer Associate, AWS Machine Learning, Google Professional Machine Learning Engineer, or equivalent. Working knowledge of AWS, Azure, or GCP and cloud-native AI services; exposure to cloud governance, IAM, cloud security, DevSecOps, Infrastructure as Code, or cloud resilience is an advantage. Prior experience within a Big 4, leading consulting organization, global technology company, or product engineering environment. 

 

 Success Profile 
 Strong AI and machine learning fundamentals supported by formal education and practical experience. Comfort navigating ambiguity in a rapidly evolving AI and regulatory environment. Ability to apply risk-based judgment and develop practical, business-focused solutions. Confidence working with engineering teams, business stakeholders, and executive audiences.
