description:
Position Title: Enterprise Architecture - Senior Manager Architecture - GR - 40551-75745-1 - Job Family: IFT > IT Architecture Shift: 2nd Shift (India) Job Title Senior Manager Architecture Requirement Type Full-Time Employee Job Location Bangalore / Hyderabad / Gurugram Job Level Senior Manager Hiring Manager Senior Director Technology Primary Skill Enterprise Architecture, Pharmacy Platforms, AI Spec-Driven Development Business iRx IDW Data Mgmt Individual Contributor / People Manager People Manager ABOUT ELEVANCE HEALTH Elevance Health is a leading health company in America dedicated to improving lives and communities and making healthcare simpler. It is the largest managed health care company in the Blue Cross Blue Shield (BCBS) Association serving more than 112 million individuals across 14 states. A regular in Fortune 500 list, Elevance Health ranked 18 in 2026. Gail Boudreaux , President and CEO of Elevance Health has been a consistent name in the Fortune list of most powerful women and currently holds 81st rank on this list. ABOUT CARELON GLOBAL SOLUTIONS Carelon Global Solutions (CGS) is a healthcare solutions company simplifying complex operational processes to improve the health of the healthcare system. Previously known as Legato Health Technologies, Carelon Global Solutions (hereinafter, CGS) underwent a name change and joined the Carelon family of brands in January 2023, as a fully owned subsidiary of Elevance Health (Previously Anthem Inc.). CGS brings together a global team of like-minded innovators who manage and optimize operational processes for health plans as well as providers. Our brightest minds housed across our global headquarters in Indianapolis as well as Bengaluru, Hyderabad and Gurugram in India, Manila in the Philippines, and San Juan in Puerto Rico bring with them innovative capabilities and an unmatched depth of experience. This global team uniquely positions CGS to enable scalable, next-generation platforms and specialized digital tools that make healthcare operations more practical, effective, and efficient. OUR MISSION & VALUES Our Mission: Improving Lives and Communities. Simplifying Healthcare. Expecting More.
 Our Values: Leadership | Community | Integrity | Agility | Diversity JOB PURPOSE Carelon Global Solutions India is seeking a Senior Manager Architecture to lead architecture and end-to-end implementation of enterprise pharmacy management capabilities for CarelonRx. The role owns technical vision, solution architecture, engineering execution, implementation readiness, and platform outcomes across complex, multi-system pharmacy transformation programs. The position is intentionally weighted toward architecture, engineering, AI-enabled Spec-Driven Development, and large-scale implementation leadership. Delivery administration is a supporting responsibility, not the primary mandate. The leader will combine strong software engineering depth with practical pharmacy and PBM domain knowledge to translate business capabilities into secure, scalable, resilient, and operable platforms. JOB RESPONSIBILITY Enterprise Pharmacy Architecture Define and govern target-state solution architecture for end-to-end pharmacy management systems, aligned with enterprise architecture, security, data, privacy, resiliency, and regulatory guardrails. Create capability maps, domain boundaries, reference architectures, reusable patterns, integration standards, and modernization roadmaps across the pharmacy ecosystem. Lead architecture decisions for microservices, APIs, event streaming, workflow orchestration, data platforms, cloud-native services, observability, and interoperability with legacy platforms. Own architecture reviews, trade-off decisions, non-functional requirements, technical debt strategy, and design assurance from concept through production adoption. End-To-End Pharmacy Platform Implementation Lead implementation across relevant pharmacy and PBM capabilities such as benefit configuration, formulary, eligibility, claims adjudication, pricing, prior authorization, pharmacy networks, specialty pharmacy, clinical programs, rebates, member and provider experiences, and operational reporting. Translate business journeys and pharmacy operating models into domain-aligned services, data contracts, interfaces, implementation increments, migration plans, and measurable acceptance criteria. Own the technical implementation lifecycle covering discovery, architecture, engineering, integration, data conversion, testing strategy, cutover, production readiness, stabilization, and benefits realization. Manage cross-platform dependencies and ensure that application, data, infrastructure, security, operations, and vendor workstreams converge into one implementable solution. Drive phased rollout, coexistence, migration, and decommissioning strategies that protect member, client, pharmacy, and operational continuity. AI-Enabled Spec-Driven Development (SDD) Establish an AI-first Spec-Driven Development approach in which approved business, architecture, interface, security, testing, and operational specifications become the governed source for implementation. Enable engineering agents and copilots to accelerate design elaboration, code generation, test creation, documentation, code review, traceability, and impact analysis, with human review and approval at critical control points. Define reusable SDD templates, prompt and context standards, repository conventions, quality gates, evaluation criteria, and responsible AI controls for enterprise adoption. Measure SDD outcomes using baselines and agreed targets for engineering cycle time, specification-to-code traceability, automated test coverage, escaped defects, rework, deployment frequency, and productivity improvement. Ensure AI-generated artifacts meet enterprise standards for security, privacy, intellectual property, explainability, maintainability, and auditability. Engineering Excellence And Hands-On Technical Leadership Provide credible, hands-on technical leadership through design reviews, code and API reviews, proof-of-concept direction, critical problem solving, performance analysis, and production diagnostics. Guide teams on software design principles, domain-driven design, secure coding, automated testing, DevSecOps, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, reliability engineering, and cloud cost optimization. Define engineering scorecards and quality gates covering code health, architecture compliance, security vulnerabilities, reliability, performance, recoverability, maintainability, and operational readiness. Champion platform engineering, reusable services, developer experience, automated environments, and self-service capabilities that reduce implementation friction at scale. Large-Scale Implementation Leadership Lead multiple engineering teams and technical workstreams across product, architecture, software engineering, data, quality engineering, cloud, security, operations, and partner organizations. Create an integrated technical implementation plan that connects architecture runway, dependency sequencing, environment readiness, test strategy, migration, cutover, and operational acceptance. Act as the senior technical decision-maker for complex implementation risks, cross-team conflicts, architecture exceptions, integration failures, and production-readiness gaps. Provide transparent executive-level reporting on architecture health, implementation progress, critical dependencies, risk exposure, quality, readiness, and realized business outcomes. Build governance that is lightweight but effective, emphasizing decision velocity, measurable technical outcomes, and removal of systemic blockers rather than delivery administration. Pharmacy Domain And Stakeholder Partnership Apply working knowledge of the prescription lifecycle, PBM operations, payer and pharmacy interactions, clinical and utilization management, drug data, pricing, formulary, claims, and applicable industry transactions and regulations. Partner with pharmacy business leaders, product managers, enterprise architects, security, operations, compliance, and client teams to shape solutions that are technically sound and operationally adoptable. Convert domain policies, rules, and exceptions into explicit specifications, testable requirements, decision services, and traceable implementation controls. Challenge assumptions using outside-in engineering and pharmacy-platform practices while tailoring recommendations to CarelonRx business priorities and enterprise constraints. People And Capability Leadership Build, lead, and mentor engineering managers, solution architects, principal engineers, technical leads, developers, quality engineers, and platform specialists across distributed teams. Establish clear technical accountabilities, architecture ownership, engineering career paths, succession plans, and communities of practice for pharmacy engineering and AI SDD. Create a culture of engineering rigor, transparent decision-making, experimentation, learning, inclusion, and accountability for outcomes. Assess capability gaps and execute hiring, upskilling, partner augmentation, and workforce plans required for large-scale implementation. Delivery Governance As A Supporting Responsibility Partner with product and program leadership on planning, investment sequencing, release readiness, dependency management, and risk escalation. Use delivery metrics only as supporting indicators. Primary accountability remains architecture quality, end-to-end implementation integrity, engineering excellence, and business capability outcomes. Ensure commitments are realistic, technically grounded, and supported by clear specifications, measurable acceptance criteria, and production-readiness evidence. QUALIFICATION Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline; postgraduate qualification is preferred. Strong foundation in software engineering, enterprise solution architecture, systems integration, cloud engineering, data architecture, cybersecurity, and operational resilience. Demonstrated ability to communicate architecture and implementation choices to business executives, product leaders, engineers, risk partners, and external vendors. Ability to lead through ambiguity, make evidence-based trade-offs, and connect pharmacy business outcomes to technical architecture and implementation decisions. Working knowledge of Agile, product operating models, DevSecOps, secure SDLC, and modern engineering governance. EXPERIENCE 15+ years of progressive experience in software engineering, solution architecture, enterprise platforms, and technology implementation, including 5+ years leading engineering managers, architects, or large technical teams. Proven leadership of large-scale, multi-year enterprise implementations involving multiple applications, complex integrations, data migration, cloud platforms, distributed teams, and production cutover. Relevant healthcare, pharmacy, or PBM experience, with demonstrable understanding of end-to-end pharmacy capabilities and their technology implications. Demonstrated experience defining target architecture and taking complex platforms from architecture through implementation, production readiness, stabilization, and measurable adoption. Experience applying AI-assisted engineering, Spec-Driven Development, agentic workflows, or comparable automation across the SDLC with appropriate human oversight and governance. Experience managing strategic vendors and globally distributed teams while retaining internal ownership of architecture, engineering quality, and implementation outcomes. Experience modernizing legacy systems using APIs, microservices, event-driven patterns, cloud-native platforms, automated testing, DevSecOps, observability, and reliability practices. SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES Core Technical Competencies Enterprise and solution architecture; domain-driven design; capability modeling; microservices; API-first and event-driven architecture; integration and interoperability patterns. Java and/or .NET engineering ecosystems; REST and GraphQL APIs; event-streaming platforms; containers and Kubernetes; Azure and/or AWS; CI/CD; infrastructure as code; observability and SRE practices. Data architecture, master and reference data, transactional and analytical data patterns, data quality, lineage, privacy, and secure information exchange. Architecture fitness functions, performance engineering, resilience, disaster recovery, security-by-design, threat modeling, and production operability. Pharmacy And Healthcare Domain Competencies Prescription and pharmacy claims lifecycle; benefit configuration; formulary and utilization management; eligibility; pricing; pharmacy networks; specialty and mail pharmacy; clinical programs; rebates; member and provider journeys. Awareness of healthcare and pharmacy interoperability, transaction standards, regulatory obligations, data privacy, and audit requirements relevant to the assigned platform scope. AI and SDD Competencies Spec-Driven Development, AI-assisted software engineering, agent orchestration, retrieval and context patterns, prompt and evaluation practices, automated testing, traceability, and responsible AI governance. Ability to establish engineering baselines, controlled pilots, adoption guardrails, and measurable value realization for AI-enabled development. Leadership Competencies Strategic thinking, systems thinking, executive communication, architecture decision-making, technical talent development, vendor leadership, influencing without authority, and crisis leadership. Bias for simplification, measurable outcomes, engineering quality, operational accountability, and continuous improvement. Preferred Certifications Cloud architecture certification in Azure or AWS. AI, machine learning, responsible AI, or generative AI certification. Healthcare or pharmacy domain certification, where applicable. SAFe Agilist or equivalent product and Agile leadership certification. Indicative Success Measures Architecture: target-state adoption, design conformance, reuse, technical debt reduction, resilience, security, and platform scalability. Implementation: capability readiness, integration completeness, migration quality, cutover readiness, production stability, adoption, and business outcome realization. Engineering: cycle-time improvement, automation coverage, defect escape reduction, reliability, developer experience, and maintainability. AI SDD: specification coverage and traceability, governed AI adoption, reusable agent workflows, quality of generated artifacts, and validated productivity benefits. Organization: critical-skill coverage, leadership bench strength, team health, succession readiness, and growth of architecture and engineering capability. Delivery: predictable release support and governance compliance, intentionally weighted below architecture, implementation, engineering, and business outcomes. THE CARELON PROMISE Aligning with our brand belief of limitless minds are our biggest asset , we offer a world of limitless opportunities to our associates. It is our strong belief that one is committed to a role when it is not just what the role entails, but also what lies in its periphery that completes the value circle for an associate. title: Data Integration Engineer (Senior Associate)
description:
Job Summary Grant Thornton GTech s Data Analytics function is dedicated to designing and delivering robust global data platforms that enable business solutions and high-quality analytics. The Analytics Engineer is responsible for building curated, analytics-ready datasets and semantic models that bridge data engineering and analytics, enabling trusted reporting and self-service consumption within the organization s Data Lakehouse. This hands-on role focuses on transformation development (dbt), dimensional modeling, semantic-layer and BI delivery (Power BI), and data quality. Working closely with Business teams, Data Architects, Data Engineers, and Analysts, the Analytics Engineer turns business requirements into well-structured, governed, and performant data products that serve as a trusted foundation for analytics, reporting, and AI. Responsibilities Design, build, and maintain curated, analytics-ready (gold-layer) datasets and semantic models that enable trusted reporting and self-service consumption. Develop and maintain modular, well-documented data transformations using dbt, following established engineering standards and reusable patterns. Build and optimize dimensional models (star/snowflake schemas, data marts) aligned with the Medallion architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold layer separation). Develop semantic models, metric definitions, and certified datasets in Snowflake and Power BI to support consistent, governed analytics consumption. Translate business and reporting requirements into transformation logic and business rules in partnership with data analysts and stakeholders. Conduct data profiling, validation, and reconciliation using Snowflake SQL to ensure the accuracy, completeness, and integrity of analytics outputs. Perform data lineage and impact analysis across Snowflake, upstream sources, transformation layers, and reporting layers. Implement data quality checks, tests, and observability for analytics pipelines and datasets. Optimize Snowflake queries, models, and transformations for performance, reliability, and cost efficiency. Collaborate with data engineers, ETL/ELT developers, and QA, and support UAT to resolve data-related gaps through iterative testing and validation. Apply governance-by-design practices (access, classification/metadata, certified datasets), and mentor and guide more junior team members. Skills Proven experience with Machine Learning, predictive analytics, and natural language processing. Strong programming skills in SQL and Python for data validation, profiling, reconciliation, and analytics. Strong hands-on Snowflake experience is required, including, ability to construct optimize complex SQL queries, variant/JSON parsing, schema and stage understanding, performance analysis troubleshooting, dynamic tables/materialized views, dbt-on-Snowflake (Streams Tasks), and secure views/masking for certified datasets. Working experience in Medallion Architecture (Bronze, Silver, Gold data layers) including mapping data flows across layers. Strong hands-on experience with dbt for building and maintaining modular, tested data transformations (ELT/ETL development and maintenance). Hands-on experience building semantic models and reports in Power BI (metric definitions, certified datasets, and self-service enablement). Experience developing curated, analytics-ready (gold-layer) datasets and reusable transformation patterns.

 or o-topic details.

 working professionals to upskill without pausing their full-time careers.

 than aggressively pushing a product.

 professionals career bottlenecks, understand their skill gaps, and then recommend the specic 
 executive program that aligns with their career growth.

Application & Team Support: Assist application teams with CICS deployments and collaborate with z/OS, DB2, MQ, Storage, Network, and Security teams. Operations & Compliance: Manage change controls, documentation, disaster recovery testing, audit compliance, on-call rotations, and task automation.

Operational Processes: Practical experience with change, incident, and problem management frameworks in high-availability systems.

Expertise in monitoring, tuning, and troubleshooting CICS performance using tools like IBM OMEGAMON, CICS PA, MainView, or Sysview. description:
Job Summary 
 We are looking for a detail-oriented Telecom Billing Specialist / Telecom Billing Operations Engineer to ensure the reliable execution of our end-to-end telecom billing and payment operations. You will play a critical role in ensuring billing accuracy, timely payment processing, operational stability, and continuous improvement of billing processes. This role requires close collaboration with Engineering, Product, Customer Operations, Finance, and external partners to deliver an excellent customer billing experience. 
 
 Responsibilities 
 
 Billing Operations 
 Execute and monitor trial and production billing cycles, ensuring accurate bill generation with minimal billing errors. Manage monthly bill generation, bill distribution, and daily payment collection activities. Process payment reminders and other customer billing notifications. Handle billing adjustments including waivers, refunds, credits, and other account corrections. Investigate customer billing disputes and manage chargeback investigations. Coordinate with debt collection agencies and monitor debtor recovery status. 
 
 Operational Excellence 
 Ensure all billing operations are completed within defined SLAs across the entire billing lifecycle. Investigate production billing issues, perform impact analysis, identify root causes, and coordinate end-to-end resolution. Execute operational scripts, procedures, and runbooks to maintain billing and payment accuracy. Create, monitor, and complete operational work requests related to billing and payment processing. Coordinate with cross-functional teams to ensure successful execution of billing cycle activities. 
 
 Testing Release Support 
 Plan, execute, and validate billing and payment test scenarios for application releases, patches, and production changes. Participate in production deployments, maintenance activities, and post-deployment verification. Support continuous improvements to operational processes, automation, and monitoring. 
 
 Reporting Continuous Improvement 
 Analyze customer feedback, NPS trends, and customer service tickets to identify recurring billing issues and improvement opportunities. Review payment default trends and collaborate with stakeholders to improve collection performance. Prepare and publish weekly and monthly operational KPIs, dashboards, and management reports. Provide regular updates on operational status, risks, incidents, and improvement initiatives. Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance billing accuracy, operational efficiency, and customer experience. 
 
 Support

 Requirements

Good understanding of telecom billing processes and/or Oracle Communications BRM (Billing and Revenue Management). Knowledge of billing, payment, and financial systems. title: Senior Atlassian Admin
description:
About Rightsline: 
 At Rightsline, we are redefining how the global media and entertainment industry manages and monetizes intellectual property. Since 2012, Rightsline has been trusted by some of the worlds most influential studios, broadcasters, and content owners to simplify the complex world of rights and royalties through powerful, intelligent technology. 
 Our cloud-based, fully integrated platform provides a single source of truth for managing rights, royalties, contracts, and financial workflows across markets, territories, and distribution channels. By bringing together data, automation, and collaboration in one configurable ecosystem, we enable organizations to unlock the full value of their content portfolios while operating with greater transparency, efficiency, and control. 
 At Rightsline, we combine deep industry expertise with cutting-edge technology to solve complex challenges at scale. Our teams work at the intersection of technology, media, and innovation—building solutions that power the business of content worldwide. 
 Joining Rightsline means becoming part of a collaborative, forward-thinking environment where your ideas, expertise, and contributions directly shape the future of rights and royalties management. If you are passionate about building impactful technology and working alongside talented global teams, Rightsline offers the platform to grow, innovate, and make a meaningful difference. 
 What You Will Own: 
 Instance Configuration & Governance Own all shared configuration in our company-managed Jira Cloud instance: custom fields, screens and screen schemes, field configurations, workflows and workflow schemes, work types and hierarchy levels, priorities, resolutions, and permission and notification schemes. Apply and enforce the discipline company-managed Jira requires establish whether an object is shared before changing it, and when it is, copy it, scope the copy to the project, and change the copy. Most instance damage comes from skipping this step. Own and maintain all the Atlassian sister products like Confluence, Jira Service Desk, and Jira Product Discovery Maintain naming conventions that make configuration ownership obvious at a glance, and run a recurring audit that catches projects drifting back onto shared objects. Keep the custom-field estate from growing unchecked: reuse before creating, scope through field contexts rather than editing shared ones, and retire fields no longer in use. Own project creation and decommissioning, and grant permissions to project roles rather than named individuals so access survives staffing changes. 
 Workflow, Automation & App Administration Translate how teams actually work into workflow, status, and board configuration and propose the lighter alternative when a request is better solved by a convention than by new configuration. Publish workflow changes safely, including migrating in-flight work when statuses change, and keep board column mappings in step so nothing lands in an unmapped state. Build and maintain Jira Automation rules, scoped correctly so one team's rule does not surface in another team's menus. Administer our Marketplace apps including their own scoping settings, and evaluate new apps before they become permanent. 
 Confluence & Process Documentation Own Confluence spaces, permissions, templates, and page hierarchy. Partner with engineering leads to get our delivery process written down and kept current: status definitions with owners and exit criteria, work-type guidance, Definition of Ready and Definition of Done, and branch-naming requirements. Company-managed Jira cannot hold per-project helper text, so Confluence is where this lives. Write short, durable runbooks for recurring requests, and train team leads to self-serve the routine changes. 
 Reporting, Data & Integrations Protect the conventions our delivery metrics depend on — the estimation field, status names, issue-key format, and what counts as a defect. Breaking one of these produces wrong numbers rather than an error message, so you are the last line of defence. Own the data contract behind our delivery-analytics platform (Plandek): which fields and statuses it reads, and what a rename would cost. Write JQL that answers non-trivial questions, build filters and dashboards, and run bulk changes safely. Use the Jira Cloud REST API for work with no UI path — bulk version creation, field inventories, and pulling issue changelogs for time-in-status and flow metrics. Changelog data cannot be reached through CSV export, so this is a working requirement rather than a bonus. Maintain the Jira–Git integration that drives status transitions, along with the Zendesk, Salesforce, and Sentry connectors. 
 Access, Compliance & Support Produce access-review and change-management evidence for SOC 2: who holds admin rights, who holds elevated issue permissions, and what changed when. Own Atlassian onboarding and offboarding, licence allocation, and seat cost management. Be the first and last stop for “Jira is broken” — diagnosing with the tooling (permission helper, automation audit logs) rather than reasoning from first principles, since most reports resolve to a handful of known causes. Collaborating with cross-functional teams Ensure compliance with ISO 27001, SOC 1, SOC 2 frameworks 
 What You Bring: 5+ years administering Atlassian Cloud, including hands-on ownership of a company-managed (not only team-managed) Jira instance where multiple projects share configuration. This is our most important requirement: team-managed-only experience does not transfer, because the whole difficulty of this role is shared configuration. Atlassian Certified Professional (Jira Administration or Jira Service Management). ScriptRunner (Groovy), or comparable depth administering Marketplace apps. Jira Service Management, Atlassian Guard / Access, or Atlassian Analytics. Experience with a delivery-metrics platform (Plandek, LinearB, Jellyfish, Sleuth) and the Jira data hygiene it requires. Having led a team-managed to company-managed migration, or a Server / Data Center to Cloud migration. Familiarity with SOC 2 or comparable audit evidence collection. Exposure to AI-assisted development tooling and how its activity should be represented in Jira. Demonstrated ownership of workflows, screen and field configuration schemes, issue type schemes, and permission schemes — you have built them, published them, and migrated existing issues through a status change. Jira Automation at a competent level: multi-step rules, smart values, branching, and correct rule scoping. Confluence administration: spaces, permissions, and templates. Strong JQL, plus filters, dashboards, and safe bulk operations. Scripting against the Jira REST API in Python, JavaScript, or equivalent, including token authentication, pagination, and changelog extraction. Judgment about blast radius — before changing anything you check what else depends on it, and you can be trusted with an instance twenty teams rely on. Willingness to push back: declining the request that would add a field nobody fills in or a status nobody exits, and proposing the lighter alternative. Clear written communication, a habit of documenting as you go, and experience working effectively with colleagues across time zones. 
 Work Environment & Expectations: Noida/NCR based Demonstrates flexibility to work in required shifts. Regular overlap with US-based engineering leadership, targeting 4 hours daily. Compliance with security and remote working policies 
 Compensation & Growth: Competitive compensation aligned to market standards with strong career growth opportunities. 
 Life at Rightsline India: At our India operations, we foster a culture of inclusiveness, accountability, and innovation. We believe in empowering our teams to take ownership, drive impact, and contribute meaningfully to global success. We offer a structured yet flexible work environment that balances performance with employee well-being. Our benefits framework for India includes: Provident Fund, Gratuity, and all statutory benefits in compliance with applicable Indian labour laws Comprehensive Group Medical Insurance covering employees and their eligible dependents Group Personal Accident Insurance for enhanced financial security In-office meal benefits, including sponsored breakfast, lunch, and evening snacks Hybrid work model with clearly defined collaboration days Flexible working hours, role-dependent Structured and transparent leave policy Career growth and advancement opportunities within a rapidly scaling global SaaS organization Continuous learning, upskilling, and leadership development support Quarterly employee engagement initiatives, along with celebrations and recognition programs 
 You will work alongside a globally connected team with strong leadership support and collaborative cross-functional exposure. We encourage proactive thinking, ownership, and initiative—ideas are welcomed, and execution is supported. As a people-first organization, we are committed to building a high-performance culture where growth, accountability, and innovation go hand in hand. 
 Hiring Process: HR Screening Technical / Functional Interview Assessment (As applicable) Leadership Round Offer Rollout

The Technical Support Engineer will support the installation, maintenance and operation of Geolog s mobile mud logging units on onshore and offshore oil rigs. Strong interest in technical and field-based work within the oil and gas industry. Basic understanding of electrical, electronic and instrumentation systems. Good problem-solving and willingness to learn new technical skills. Good communication and interpersonal skills. Ability to work effectively as part of a team and follow instructions. Willingness to work on onshore and offshore oil rigs and in field locations. Good command of English, both written and spoken. Ability to work in a demanding field environment and adapt to different working conditions. This position is based in India, with potential opportunities to transfer to international projects in the future. Previous mud logging or oil and gas experience is an advantage but not essential.

title: Deputy General Manager - Smart Campus
description:
Job Description 
 Deputy General Manager (DGM) Smart Campus 
 Department Digital Technology Reports To Chief Digital Officer Location Ahmedabad, Gujarat Employment Type Full-Time 
 Role Summary
The DGM Smart Campus will lead the strategy, design, and execution of Smart Campus IT infrastructure across the organization's campus locations. This role owns the end-to-end lifecycle of smart campus technologies from strategic planning and vendor selection through deployment, integration, and operations spanning IoT device ecosystems, data center build-outs, network infrastructure, and campus-wide digital systems. The ideal candidate combines strong technical infrastructure expertise with proven program leadership and stakeholder management skills.
Key Responsibilities
Strategy & Planning
 Define and drive the long-term Smart Campus technology roadmap aligned with organizational goals (sustainability, safety, efficiency, user experience).
 Define & design architectures aligned with organizational goals covering the smart campus roadmap
 Evaluate emerging technologies (IoT, edge computing, AI-enabled building systems, 5G/Wi-Fi 6, smart energy management) and assess fit for campus deployment.
¢ Develop business cases, budgets, and ROI models for smart campus initiatives.
¢ Partner with leadership to align IT infrastructure investment with institutional/organizational growth plans.
IoT & Smart Infrastructure Execution
¢ Lead design, procurement, and deployment of IoT device ecosystems across campus smart lighting, HVAC, access control, occupancy sensors, environmental monitoring, surveillance, energy metering, parking, and asset tracking.
¢ Oversee IoT platform architecture including device management, connectivity (LoRaWAN, Zigbee, BLE, Wi-Fi, cellular), edge gateways, and cloud/on-prem integration.
¢ Ensure interoperability across multi-vendor IoT systems and integration with central building management systems (BMS/BAS) and campus management platforms.
¢ Establish standards for IoT security, device provisioning, firmware lifecycle management, and data governance.
Data Center Build & Infrastructure
¢ Lead planning, design, and execution of data center build-outs (greenfield and expansion) including site selection, power and cooling design, redundancy (N+1/2N), and physical security.
¢ Manage data center infrastructure lifecycle: server/storage/network hardware, virtualization, structured cabling, UPS, generators, and environmental monitoring systems.
¢ Ensure compliance with relevant standards (TIA-942, Uptime Institute Tier standards, ISO 27001) and local regulatory requirements.
¢ Drive capacity planning, disaster recovery, and business continuity strategy for campus data infrastructure.
Program & Vendor Management
¢ Manage full project lifecycle: scoping, RFPs, vendor evaluation, contract negotiation, implementation, and handover to operations.
¢ Own budgets, timelines, and delivery quality across concurrent smart campus and infrastructure projects.
¢ Build and manage relationships with OEMs, system integrators, telecom providers, and consultants.
¢ Establish SLAs and governance frameworks for ongoing operations and maintenance.
Team Leadership & Stakeholder Engagement
¢ Build, mentor, and lead a multidisciplinary team spanning network engineering, IoT/embedded systems, data center operations, and project management.
¢ Act as the key liaison between IT, facilities, security, academic/business units, and executive leadership.
¢ Present roadmaps, project status, and risk assessments to senior leadership and governance committees.
¢ Drive change management and user adoption for new smart campus systems.
Governance, Security & Compliance
¢ Ensure infrastructure design adheres to cybersecurity best practices, including network segmentation for OT/IoT environments.
¢ Own risk assessment, audit readiness, and compliance documentation for infrastructure projects.
¢ Establish monitoring, incident response, and maintenance protocols for critical infrastructure.
Required Qualifications
¢ Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Electronics, Electrical Engineering, or related field (Master's/MBA preferred).
¢ 1218+ years of progressive experience in IT infrastructure, with at least 5 years in a leadership role managing smart campus, smart building, or large-scale IoT deployments.
¢ Demonstrated experience leading data center build projects from design through commissioning.
¢ Strong understanding of IoT architectures, protocols, and platforms (AWS IoT, Azure IoT Hub, or equivalent).
¢ Experience with structured cabling, LAN/WAN design, wireless infrastructure, and data center facilities (power, cooling, redundancy).
¢ Proven track record managing multi-crore/multi-million-dollar infrastructure budgets and large vendor ecosystems.
¢ Familiarity with BMS/BAS integration, physical security systems, and energy management platforms.
¢ Strong project management skills (PMP/PRINCE2 certification preferred).
Preferred Qualifications
¢ Certifications such as CDCP/CDCS (Data Center), CCNP/CCIE, or IoT-specific certifications.

title: Mainframe Assembler
description:
We are seeking a highly experienced Mainframe Assembler Practitioner with deep expertise in IBM z/OS Assembler (HLASM) and strong hands on capability to rewrite assembler programs into COBOL, validate functional equivalence, fix defects identified during testing, and optimize performance. The role also requires the ability to analyze and document complex assembler logic, translating low level technical constructs into clear functional and business oriented documentation. 
 
 Responsibilities 
 Assembler Code Analysis Understanding Analyze complex IBM z/OS Assembler (HLASM) programs, macros, and control blocks to fully understand: Business logic and functional flows Data structures, register usage, and storage management Control flow patterns (branching, looping, error handling) Perform call chain and dependency analysis, including interactions with: COBOL programs CICS/Batch environments Databases (DB2, VSAM, IAM, Datacom) Utility and system services Identify and document implicit business rules embedded in assembler logic, including edge cases and exception handling. Assembler to COBOL Rewrite Rewrite assembler programs into functionally equivalent COBOL code, ensuring: Logical equivalence with original assembler behavior Compliance with enterprise COBOL standards Maintainable, readable, and modular COBOL structures Translate low level assembler constructs (register operations, bit manipulation, packed/zoned decimal handling) into appropriate COBOL constructs. Handle conversion of: Batch programs CICS online programs Utility and interface modules Work closely with automated or semi automated rewrite tooling where applicable, validating and refining generated code. Testing Validation Design and execute unit and integration test cases to validate COBOL code against original assembler behavior. Support mainframe comparison testing where original assembler acts as the system of record for validation, a common pattern in complex rewrite programs. Analyze test failures by: Comparing assembler logic, extracted business rules, and rewritten COBOL code Identifying functional mismatches, data handling issues, and boundary condition errors Iteratively fix defects in rewritten COBOL code and re test until functional equivalence is proven. Performance Optimization Analyze performance critical assembler code paths, including: CPU intensive loops I/O heavy operations Storage and memory utilization patterns Optimize assembler or rewritten COBOL code by: Reducing instruction count or inefficient branching Improving data access patterns Minimizing unnecessary I/O or storage operations Ensure that rewritten COBOL meets or exceeds original assembler performance benchmarks where required. Functional Technical Documentation Produce clear, structured documentation describing: Program purpose and high level business functionality Detailed logic flow and decision points Input/output structures and file/database interactions Translate assembler level technical details into language consumable by functional analysts, testers, and downstream developers. Document assumptions, limitations, and known edge cases uncovered during analysis and rewrite. Collaboration Governance Collaborate with: Architects, testers, and modernization leads Automation, tooling, and QA teams Participate in design reviews, code walkthroughs, and defect triage sessions. Adhere to enterprise governance standards for code quality, documentation, and testing artifacts. 
 
 Required Skills Experience 
 Core Technical Skills 10+ years of hands on experience with IBM z/OS Assembler (HLASM). Strong expertise in COBOL (Enterprise COBOL) on z/OS. Deep understanding of: z/OS execution model Register usage and storage management Assembler macros and copybooks Experience with Batch and CICS environments. Solid knowledge of mainframe data technologies: VSAM, IAM DB2 and/or Datacom Rewrite Testing Expertise Proven experience in assembler to COBOL rewrites, preferably in large modernization programs. Strong debugging skills across assembler and COBOL. Experience designing and executing test strategies for legacy rewrites. Ability to reason about behavioral equivalence, not just syntactic conversion. Performance Quality Demonstrated ability to analyze and optimize performance critical mainframe code. Strong attention to detail and root cause analysis skills. Documentation Communication Ability to document complex low level logic in a clear and structured manner. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Comfortable explaining assembler logic to non assembler practitioners.

The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start Caring. Connecting. Growing together.

The team partners across business, technology, and operations to design, build, and scale product-centric solutions that improve customer experiences, optimize operational workflows, and deliver measurable business outcomes. The team drives consistency in product strategy, agile delivery, and design practices, enabling teams to operate with greater speed, clarity, and impact. By aligning cross-functional stakeholders and leveraging modern technologies-including cloud platforms, data, and AI-the organization supports the development of scalable, user-centered solutions that help advance Optum's mission to build a more effective and equitable health care system.

title: User Experience Researcher Intern
description:
UX Research Intern:
 We're looking for a curious, empathetic, and proactive UX Research Intern to help us understand our users and improve their healthcare experiences.
You'll work closely with the Design and Product teams to speak with real users, explore their behaviours, identify pain points, and turn research findings into meaningful product insights.
This role is ideal for someone who loves asking questions, observing human behaviour, challenging assumptions, and understanding the why behind what people do. 
 What you'll do
 Conduct user research: Plan and conduct user interviews, contextual conversations, surveys, and usability testing. Talk to real users: Connect with patients, caregivers, and consumers to understand their healthcare needs, medicine-purchasing habits, and digital experiences. Explore user behaviour: Understand how people discover medicines, evaluate trust, interpret prescriptions, and make healthcare decisions. Identify pain points: Uncover friction, unmet needs, and opportunities across the customer journey. Analyse research findings: Organise qualitative and quantitative data, identify patterns, and synthesise insights. Communicate insights: Create research summaries, interview notes, user personas, journey maps, and insight presentations. Collaborate with teams: Work with Product Managers, Designers, and other stakeholders to translate findings into actionable product opportunities. Stay curious: Explore competitor experiences, emerging user behaviours, and new ways to make digital healthcare simpler and more accessible. 
 What we're looking for
 A student, recent graduate, or early-career candidate interested in UX research, human behaviour, psychology, or product discovery. Strong curiosity and empathy, with a genuine interest in understanding people. Excellent listening, communication, and questioning skills. Comfort speaking with unfamiliar people and conducting interviews in person or remotely. Strong observation and analytical skills, with the ability to identify patterns in qualitative feedback. Clear written communication and the ability to present findings in a structured manner. A self-starter who is organised, resourceful, and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment. 
 Good to have
 Exposure to user research, design thinking, usability testing, or market research. Familiarity with tools such as Google Forms, Google Sheets, Excel, Miro, or Figma. Experience with college research projects, internships, field studies, or independent research. Interest in healthcare, consumer behaviour, accessibility, or digital products. Prior professional experience is not mandatory. Curiosity, empathy, and the ability to learn are more important.
Internship details
 Duration: 6 months Type: Paid internship Work mode: Hybrid Team: Product Design / UX Research Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka

title: PRODUCT MANAGER - Product Management
description:
Introduction - The Strategic Value of the GCC Product Owner 
 The recruitment of Product Owners is an important milestone in the organizations journey toward sustainable, global innovation. By generalizing the role while tailoring it to the specific technological and cultural nuances of the company, the organization aims to attract top-tier talent capable of driving the next generation of DAM solutions. 
 The Product Owner acts as the cornerstone of the squad, ensuring that the strategic vision of global Product Managers is translated into valuable capabilities and enterprise-grade code. This requires a unique blend of technical authority, agile mastery, and a commitment to the "Bynder Operating Principles. 
 About the Role 
 Bynders mission is to inspire brands to thrive through exceptional content experiences. As a Product Owner, you will be at the heart of this mission. This role is not just about managing assets; it is about building the foundational technology that allows the worlds most recognizable brands to conquer the complexity and chaos of proliferating content. 
 The Product Owner serves as the tactical engine for a cross-functional agile squad, working in close collaboration with Engineers, Designers, and Product Managers. This is an execution-focused role where the individual represents the voice of the customer within the development team, ensuring that user needs are understood and addressed through high-quality product increments. By fostering an environment of transparent communication and continuous improvement, the Product Owner drives the team toward maximizing value delivery and supporting the organizations global success. 
 What Youll Be Doing to Drive Impact 
 Own the Backlog: Translate the high-level strategic vision and roadmap provided by Product Managers into actionable requirements and user stories. Maintain and prioritize a healthy backlog that aligns with strategic goals and enterprise-grade standards. 
 Act as the Engineering Sparring Partner: Serve as the primary point of contact for the engineering team on all product-related questions. Confidently discuss the why of the capabilities that are being developed, discuss technical trade-offs, and challenge proposals to ensure every development is optimized for value delivery, performance, scalability, and security. 
 Set priorities for development cycles: Facilitate sprint planning sessions to set clear objectives and determine priorities for development cycles. 
 Ensure Quality and Reliability: Identify and mitigate technical debt, edge cases, and potential failure points within your platform area. Inspect the product increments produced by the team, validating they meet established acceptance criteria and deliver the intended business value. 
 Bridge the Communication Gap: Act as the key liaison between the development team and internal stakeholders. Effectively communicate product goals, progress, and technical complexities to both technical and non-technical audiences, ensuring alignment across the global product organization. 
 Drive Continuous Improvement: Actively seek and provide constructive feedback to facilitate the teams growth. Leverage data-driven insights to make informed decisions and take calculated risks that challenge the status quo. 
 What You Bring: The Essential Skills 
 Proven Product Ownership: At least 3 years of experience as a Product Owner in a high-growth SaaS environment. Demonstrated success in leading cross-functional teams from discovery to delivery of initiatives. 
 Technical Literacy and Authority: A strong understanding of modern technology stacks, cloud-native architectures, and API-first principles. You are comfortable diving into technical details and can translate between business needs and engineering constraints. 
 Agile Mastery: Deep proficiency in Agile methodologies (Scrum/Kanban) and experience managing product backlogs using tools like Jira or Productboard. 
 Analytical Mindset: The ability to break down complex problems into small, manageable increments of value. You utilize data and KPIs to inform your decisions and prioritize the backlog based on business and user impact. 
 Exceptional Communication: The skill to articulate a clear vision and provide precise instructions to development teams while managing the expectations of diverse stakeholders. 
 Cultural Alignment: An entrepreneurial spirit, intellectual curiosity, and a commitment to the Bynder Operating Principles". 
 Nice to Have 
 A Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. 
 Experience in the Digital Asset Management (DAM), MarTech, or AdTech ecosystems. 
 Knowledge of AI and machine learning applications in a product context, such as automated metadata enrichment or agentic workflows. 
 Professional certifications such as Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO) or Professional Scrum Product Owner (PSPO).

title: Product Owner: Securities and Prime Services Delivery (VP)
description:
Job Summary 
 Wells Fargo is seeking an experienced Product Owner (individual contributor) for planning, coordination, and delivering enhancements across Client Reporting, Client Portal, Trade Processing, and Client Billing platforms. The Product Owner manages the backlog, documents requirements, drives Agile delivery, coordinates stakeholders, leads release readiness, and delivers executive reporting to ensure successful execution of strategic, operational, and regulatory initiatives. 

 Responsibilities 
 Lead delivery management activities for assigned product capabilities within the Securities and Prime Services organization, partnering with global product managers and technology teams to manage execution, dependencies, risks, and delivery commitments. 

 Functional and Technical Skills 

 Product Ownership 
 Execute the product roadmap across Client Reporting, Client Portals, Trade Processing, and Client Billing platforms. Evaluate business requests, operational needs, client feedback, and regulatory requirements to prioritize the backlog and plan delivery. Maintain visibility into product initiatives, dependencies, milestones, and delivery commitments. Manage quarterly planning activities, including Big Room Planning (BRP), capacity reviews, dependency management, and roadmap coordination. Manage the product demand and intake process, ensuring requests are documented, tracked, and routed appropriately. 

 Agile Delivery Product Ownership 
 Create, refine, and maintain Epics, Features, and User Stories in Jira. Partner with Business Analysts and Technology teams to translate business requirements into actionable work items. Manage backlog grooming, sprint planning, story refinement, and prioritization sessions. Lead Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, retrospectives, backlog reviews, and daily scrum meetings as needed. Track delivery progress, identify risks and dependencies, and escalate issues when appropriate. Lead user acceptance testing, defect triage, and production validation activities. Evaluate solution options and document impacts to operational workflows and client processes. 

 Stakeholder Coordination Governance 
 Coordinate Product, Operations, Technology, Client Service, Finance, Risk, and Compliance stakeholders to drive delivery activities. Drive communication and coordination across multiple workstreams and delivery teams. Maintain action item, decision, and issue logs for key initiatives. 

 Business Continuity and Operational Readiness 
 Lead client readiness planning and implementation activities for new product capabilities and enhancements. Lead business continuity planning (BCP) exercises and operational readiness reviews. Coordinate stakeholder communications, training materials, and rollout activities. Manage and respond to internal and external inquiries related to product capabilities and ongoing initiatives. 

 Product Domains 
 Client Portal and digital client experience solutions. Trade Processing and post-trade operational workflows. Client Billing and fee management solutions. Regulatory, operational, and client service enhancements across the Securities and Prime Services product suite. 

 Executive Communication 
 Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage credibly with clients, product specialists, technology teams and senior leaders across global businesses. Create concise, executive-ready presentations and updates that clearly explain outcomes, delivery status, trade-offs, risks and decisions required. Translate complex markets, platform and operational issues into clear, outcome-oriented conversations. Build strong communication channels and trusted relationships across business, operations, control and technology partners. Use AI-supported summaries and narratives judiciously for executive communication, ensuring accuracy, context and appropriate review. 

 Change Mindset and Collaboration 
 Work effectively at the intersection of business domain expertise, product ownership and project management. Collaborate across global teams to shape solutions, resolve dependencies and drive decisions through to implementation. Challenge existing processes constructively and identify opportunities to improve efficiency, control and user experience. Demonstrate adaptability, curiosity and continuous learning, including responsible adoption of emerging AI capabilities to increase delivery velocity. 

 Risk Control Mindset 
 Embed risk and control considerations into product design, prioritization, testing and implementation. Ensure product capabilities and delivery processes comply with applicable SEC, FINRA and FRB requirements and Wells Fargo's risk frameworks. Identify and escalate delivery, operational, conduct, regulatory and technology risks in a timely manner. Ensure responsible AI use with awareness of data privacy, information security, ethical and regulatory requirements. 

 Required Qualifications 
 5+ years of Business Execution, Implementation, or Strategic Planning experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education MBA or equivalent relevant experience. 5+ years of experience across Securities, Capital Markets, Prime Brokerage, Trade Processing, Client Reporting, or Billing workflows preferred. Experience working with Agile delivery methodologies and Jira. Strong organizational and project coordination skills. Experience collaborating with business, operations, and technology stakeholders. Strong communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills. Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to create executive-ready presentations and present information to persuade, educate, and enhance understanding at all levels. Ability to work effectively in a demanding, fast-paced, dynamic environment, handling multiple tasks and projects concurrently while maintaining quality, accuracy, integrity, accountability, and attention to detail. Ability to work in a global team, interact at different levels, and manage deliverables with varying levels of complexity, with a focus on execution and results. Advanced Microsoft Office skills, including PowerPoint, Word, and Excel. Experience identifying and driving process improvements in complex environments. 

 Work Arrangement and Shift Timings 
 Work Model: Hybrid working model with a minimum requirement of three (3) days per week from office. Flexibility: The role requires reasonable flexibility to attend stakeholder meetings or calls as needed during US business hours and to provide support for weekend activities, as required, particularly during release and deployment windows.

title: Enterprise Agentic AI Architect
description:
Job Summary 
 Coursera s AI adoption has moved fast - engineering teams code AI-first, dozens of internal tools have shipped, and functions across the business are building their own AI agents and automations. The next phase requires something different: a shared technical foundation that lets many teams build safely and cost-effectively at scale, instead of each team solving governance, security, and cost from scratch. 
 
 Responsibilities 
 Context Semantic Architecture - Design how AI agents access and understand Coursera s internal data and knowledge, so agents retrieve the right information rather than guessing or over-fetching. Establish reusable patterns for RAG, semantic search, structured data access, and enterprise context, partnering with the Data team on existing data models and pipelines. Agentic Architecture Harness Engineering - Design reusable patterns for agent orchestration, tool use, multi-step workflows, state management, and human-in-the-loop decisions. Build the engineering harness around agents, including testing, evaluation, guardrails, retries, observability, and failure recovery, so agentic solutions are reliable and production-ready. Governance Architecture - Build technical guardrails that enforce-not just document-who can build what, what data and systems an agent can access, and what gets logged for audit and review. Establish standards for agent ownership, lifecycle management, and production readiness. Security Architecture - Design defenses specific to agentic AI, including agent identity and access control, least-privilege permissions, prompt injection, data leakage, secure credentials, and safe tool execution. Coordinate with Security to extend existing enterprise security standards. Self-Serve AI Development ( Vibe Coding ) with CI/CD Automation - Extend and mature Coursera s self-serve deployment path so AI-assisted, conversational development ships through automated testing, security checks, and evaluation gates-safe by default, not safe by manual gatekeeping. LLM Cost Performance Optimization - Design caching, model routing (matching task complexity to the right-sized model), token and context optimization, and usage monitoring so AI adoption can scale without costs growing linearly. Establish cost, latency, quality, and usage metrics. Agent Operating Model Adoption - Define agent ownership, lifecycle management, production-readiness standards, adoption metrics, and reusable patterns so business teams can scale AI capabilities consistently across functions. Measure success through usage, workflow outcomes, productivity, quality, and business value. Architecture Strategy Execution - Turn ambiguous business problems into scalable technical direction, practical roadmaps, architecture decisions, and production delivery. Enterprise Systems Integration Architecture - Design AI solutions that understand dependencies across enterprise systems, business processes, integrations, and downstream impacts. Establish reusable patterns for APIs, enterprise tools, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) or comparable integration standards where appropriate. Production Readiness Operational Excellence - Establish standards for reliability, observability, incident response, security, operational ownership, and continuous improvement across AI platforms and solutions. 
 
 How This Role Works With Others 
 This role sits at the intersection of four groups and requires strong cross-functional partnership-it does not operate in isolation. Engineering Leadership: Partner directly with Engineering leadership to align architecture decisions and share resources and infrastructure where possible, avoiding duplicate build efforts across the company. IT: IT owns broader company-wide tooling and platform decisions (procurement, provisioning, cost governance, enterprise policy). Coordinate closely with IT so agentic architecture decisions align with company-wide technical direction rather than creating a parallel, ungoverned stack. Data Team: The Data team owns Coursera s underlying data strategy. Partner with them to ensure context and semantic architecture aligns with existing data models, pipelines, and ownership rather than building a parallel, disconnected data layer for AI. Security Team: Design security architecture specific to agentic AI-including access control, prompt injection defense, and credential handling-in coordination with the Security team, which owns broader security standards and policy. Business Pods: Enable the 3-4 person pods (Business Product Owner, Process Expert, IT Product Owner, AI Engineer) to redesign workflows, build AI-native solutions, and drive measurable business outcomes using reusable architecture. Change Management Enablement: Help teams adopt AI-enabled workflows through enablement, feedback loops, process redesign, and continuous improvement. 
 
 People Leadership 
 Build, coach, and develop the architecture and engineering capability required to scale the platform. This includes hiring, delegation, technical leadership development, performance management, and creating clear ownership across teams. Build strong technical leaders who can independently own architecture, delivery, stakeholder alignment, and operational outcomes. 
 
 AI Center of Excellence / VP, AI and Operations 
 Report directly to the VP, AI and Operations, providing regular updates on architecture progress, risks, business impact, and resourcing needs. 
 
 What We're Looking For 
 
 Must-Have 
 12+ years of experience with clear progression from engineer to senior/staff engineer to architect leader, including ownership of platforms or infrastructure used by multiple teams-not just individual feature delivery. Hands-on experience with agentic AI frameworks and orchestration (e.g., LangGraph or comparable) and familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP) or similar standards for connecting AI systems to enterprise data and tools. Experience designing agent harnesses, evaluation frameworks, guardrails, testing, observability, and failure recovery for production AI systems. Practical experience with enterprise context architecture, RAG, semantic search, or structured data access. Practical experience with LLM cost and performance engineering-prompt caching, model routing, token economics-with quantifiable results. The person must have built fintech or travel products before, not operated them. You will own a product area end to end: discovery, PRDs, roadmap, delivery with engineering, and adoption with clients. Title:- Product Manager / Senior Product Manager Travel Fintech Location- Gurugram Experience- 4-10 years total, with at least 3 years as a PM in travel fintech, payments, or travel tech Who we're looking for This role is open only to product managers whose PM experience comes from one of these backgrounds: Travel fintech / B2B travel payments virtual cards for travel, travel BNPL, B2B travel wallets, airline/hotel payment and settlement platforms Spend management & corporate card fintechs — corporate cards, expense management, T&E platforms OTAs and TMCs — in the payments, wallet, checkout, refunds or finance-product team Travel tech companies — owning payments, billing, invoicing or settlement modules The experience must be in a product management role (owning roadmap, writing PRDs, shipping with engineering). At least part of it must involve travel. A pure payments PM with no travel exposure, or a travel PM who never touched money flows, is a weaker fit. Finance operations, reconciliation teams, payment ops, chargeback handling, collections or customer support do not count toward the 3 years, even at the companies above. Key responsibilities 1. Own the roadmap for corporate cards and payments: physical and virtual cards, single-use virtual cards for bookings, wallets and payouts. 2. Define card controls and authorization logic: MCC limits, per-trip and per-employee limits, policy-linked spend rules, real-time approve/decline decisions. 3. Design KYB/KYC onboarding flows for companies and employees with issuing banks and card program partners. 4. Build payment flows into travel booking: pay at booking with a corporate card, a virtual card or a central bill-to-company account; also refunds, cancellations and reissues. 5. Own auto-matching and reconciliation: card transaction booking invoice expense claim, plus GST/VAT invoice capture. 6. Define integrations with issuing banks, card networks (Visa/Mastercard/RuPay), payment gateways, BSP/airline settlement, and ERP/accounting systems. 7. Work with compliance and risk on RBI (India) and CBUAE (UAE) requirements, fraud rules, disputes and chargebacks. 8. Work daily with engineering, design and QA on PRDs, backlog, UAT and releases. 9. Set and track KPIs: card activation, spend volume, auth success rate, auto-match rate, reconciliation time, interchange revenue. Must-have 3+ years as a Product Manager in travel fintech, spend management, or the payments team of an OTA, TMC or travel tech company Shipped at least one payments or card product to live customers, and can walk through it end to end Solid grasp of card issuing: issuer, processor, program manager and network roles; authorization and clearing; MCC; virtual cards Understanding of travel money flows: BSP/ARC settlement, airline and hotel payment terms, refunds and reissues, the TMC billing model Experience with KYB/KYC, AML basics and working with compliance or banking partners Can read API docs and discuss payment request/response flows, webhooks and idempotency with engineers Strong PRD writing and user flows; comfortable with Jira/Confluence and agile delivery Clear written and spoken English; able to present to client CFOs and finance teams Nice to have Built for both India and the UAE/GCC (RBI PPI/card rules, CBUAE, UPI, local acquirers) Expense management: receipt OCR, GST/VAT input credit, per diems, ERP sync (SAP, Oracle, Tally, Zoho) Experience with B2B travel payment providers or virtual card programs for travel suppliers Fraud and risk rules engines, dispute and chargeback workflows AI features in finance: auto-categorisation, anomaly detection, policy agents SQL or analytics tools for spend and funnel analysis Not a fit Please do not apply if your background is mainly any of the following: Payment operations, reconciliation, settlement or finance operations Chargeback, dispute or collections handling Travel operations, ticketing, fulfilment or back office Customer support, onboarding support or account management Banking relationship, sales or partnerships roles without product ownership Product roles in consumer lending, insurance or retail payments with no B2B or travel exposure Business analyst or project manager roles with no roadmap or PRD ownership

This global team uniquely positions CGS to enable scalable, next-generation platforms and specialized digital tools that make healthcare operations more practical, effective, and efficient. OUR MISSION & VALUES Our Mission: Improving Lives and Communities. Simplifying Healthcare. Expecting More.
 Our Values: Leadership | Community | Integrity | Agility | Diversity JOB PURPOSE Carelon Global Solutions India is seeking a Senior Manager Architecture to lead architecture and end-to-end implementation of enterprise pharmacy management capabilities for CarelonRx. The role owns technical vision, solution architecture, engineering execution, implementation readiness, and platform outcomes across complex, multi-system pharmacy transformation programs. The position is intentionally weighted toward architecture, engineering, AI-enabled Spec-Driven Development, and large-scale implementation leadership. Delivery administration is a supporting responsibility, not the primary mandate. The leader will combine strong software engineering depth with practical pharmacy and PBM domain knowledge to translate business capabilities into secure, scalable, resilient, and operable platforms. JOB RESPONSIBILITY Enterprise Pharmacy Architecture Define and govern target-state solution architecture for end-to-end pharmacy management systems, aligned with enterprise architecture, security, data, privacy, resiliency, and regulatory guardrails. Create capability maps, domain boundaries, reference architectures, reusable patterns, integration standards, and modernization roadmaps across the pharmacy ecosystem. Lead architecture decisions for microservices, APIs, event streaming, workflow orchestration, data platforms, cloud-native services, observability, and interoperability with legacy platforms. Own architecture reviews, trade-off decisions, non-functional requirements, technical debt strategy, and design assurance from concept through production adoption. End-To-End Pharmacy Platform Implementation Lead implementation across relevant pharmacy and PBM capabilities such as benefit configuration, formulary, eligibility, claims adjudication, pricing, prior authorization, pharmacy networks, specialty pharmacy, clinical programs, rebates, member and provider experiences, and operational reporting. Translate business journeys and pharmacy operating models into domain-aligned services, data contracts, interfaces, implementation increments, migration plans, and measurable acceptance criteria. Own the technical implementation lifecycle covering discovery, architecture, engineering, integration, data conversion, testing strategy, cutover, production readiness, stabilization, and benefits realization. Manage cross-platform dependencies and ensure that application, data, infrastructure, security, operations, and vendor workstreams converge into one implementable solution. Drive phased rollout, coexistence, migration, and decommissioning strategies that protect member, client, pharmacy, and operational continuity. AI-Enabled Spec-Driven Development (SDD) Establish an AI-first Spec-Driven Development approach in which approved business, architecture, interface, security, testing, and operational specifications become the governed source for implementation. Enable engineering agents and copilots to accelerate design elaboration, code generation, test creation, documentation, code review, traceability, and impact analysis, with human review and approval at critical control points. Define reusable SDD templates, prompt and context standards, repository conventions, quality gates, evaluation criteria, and responsible AI controls for enterprise adoption. Measure SDD outcomes using baselines and agreed targets for engineering cycle time, specification-to-code traceability, automated test coverage, escaped defects, rework, deployment frequency, and productivity improvement. Ensure AI-generated artifacts meet enterprise standards for security, privacy, intellectual property, explainability, maintainability, and auditability. Engineering Excellence And Hands-On Technical Leadership Provide credible, hands-on technical leadership through design reviews, code and API reviews, proof-of-concept direction, critical problem solving, performance analysis, and production diagnostics. Guide teams on software design principles, domain-driven design, secure coding, automated testing, DevSecOps, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, reliability engineering, and cloud cost optimization. Define engineering scorecards and quality gates covering code health, architecture compliance, security vulnerabilities, reliability, performance, recoverability, maintainability, and operational readiness. Champion platform engineering, reusable services, developer experience, automated environments, and self-service capabilities that reduce implementation friction at scale. Large-Scale Implementation Leadership Lead multiple engineering teams and technical workstreams across product, architecture, software engineering, data, quality engineering, cloud, security, operations, and partner organizations. Create an integrated technical implementation plan that connects architecture runway, dependency sequencing, environment readiness, test strategy, migration, cutover, and operational acceptance. Act as the senior technical decision-maker for complex implementation risks, cross-team conflicts, architecture exceptions, integration failures, and production-readiness gaps. Provide transparent executive-level reporting on architecture health, implementation progress, critical dependencies, risk exposure, quality, readiness, and realized business outcomes. Build governance that is lightweight but effective, emphasizing decision velocity, measurable technical outcomes, and removal of systemic blockers rather than delivery administration. Pharmacy Domain And Stakeholder Partnership Apply working knowledge of the prescription lifecycle, PBM operations, payer and pharmacy interactions, clinical and utilization management, drug data, pricing, formulary, claims, and applicable industry transactions and regulations. Partner with pharmacy business leaders, product managers, enterprise architects, security, operations, compliance, and client teams to shape solutions that are technically sound and operationally adoptable. Convert domain policies, rules, and exceptions into explicit specifications, testable requirements, decision services, and traceable implementation controls. Challenge assumptions using outside-in engineering and pharmacy-platform practices while tailoring recommendations to CarelonRx business priorities and enterprise constraints. People And Capability Leadership Build, lead, and mentor engineering managers, solution architects, principal engineers, technical leads, developers, quality engineers, and platform specialists across distributed teams. Establish clear technical accountabilities, architecture ownership, engineering career paths, succession plans, and communities of practice for pharmacy engineering and AI SDD. Create a culture of engineering rigor, transparent decision-making, experimentation, learning, inclusion, and accountability for outcomes. Assess capability gaps and execute hiring, upskilling, partner augmentation, and workforce plans required for large-scale implementation. Delivery Governance As A Supporting Responsibility Partner with product and program leadership on planning, investment sequencing, release readiness, dependency management, and risk escalation. Use delivery metrics only as supporting indicators. Primary accountability remains architecture quality, end-to-end implementation integrity, engineering excellence, and business capability outcomes. Ensure commitments are realistic, technically grounded, and supported by clear specifications, measurable acceptance criteria, and production-readiness evidence. QUALIFICATION Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline; postgraduate qualification is preferred. Strong foundation in software engineering, enterprise solution architecture, systems integration, cloud engineering, data architecture, cybersecurity, and operational resilience. Demonstrated ability to communicate architecture and implementation choices to business executives, product leaders, engineers, risk partners, and external vendors.
