title: Mulesoft Architect
description:
MuleSoft Enterprise Architect 
Role Summary
We are seeking a highly experienced MuleSoft Enterprise Architect to lead the strategy, architecture, governance, development, delivery, and evolution of the enterprise integration landscape. This is a hands-on architecture role that combines enterprise-level solution ownership with active MuleSoft coding and end-to-end project execution.
The role will serve as the technical authority for MuleSoft and integration initiatives while directly contributing to API development, DataWeave transformations, reusable components, proof-of-concepts, complex troubleshooting, and critical project deliverables. The Architect will remain accountable for the practicality, quality, security, scalability, and successful implementation of the solutions designed.
The Architect will work with enterprise architects, business stakeholders, project teams, AMS teams, vendors, and client leadership to define integration roadmaps, translate requirements into implementable designs, deliver strategic projects, and support stable transition into production and BAU operations.
Key Responsibilities
Enterprise Integration Strategy
 Define and drive the enterprise integration and API strategy in alignment with business and technology objectives. Establish target-state integration architecture, platform roadmaps, reusable patterns, and reference architectures. Promote API-first, API-led connectivity, reuse, standardisation, and reduction of technical debt. Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend practical adoption approaches based on business value, delivery feasibility, cost, risk, and operational impact. Solution & Platform Architecture
 Lead architecture and detailed design of complex enterprise solutions using MuleSoft Anypoint Platform. Design scalable, highly available, secure, resilient, supportable, and cost-effective integration solutions. Create and review solution architecture documents, API specifications, sequence flows, interface contracts, and non-functional requirements. Approve solution designs and ensure alignment with enterprise architecture, security, data, and operational standards. Ensure architecture decisions are technically implementable and validated through hands-on engineering where required. Hands-on Development & Engineering
 Actively design, develop, test, and deploy MuleSoft APIs, applications, and integrations as part of project delivery. Write and optimise DataWeave transformations, error-handling frameworks, logging components, connectors, and reusable integration assets. Develop Experience, Process, and System APIs following API-led connectivity principles. Build proof-of-concepts, technical spikes, prototypes, reference implementations, and accelerators for complex or strategic requirements. Perform source-code reviews and contribute directly to critical modules, technically complex integrations, and high-risk deliverables. Debug and resolve complex defects, performance bottlenecks, connectivity failures, security issues, and production problems. Apply secure coding, testing, version-control, code-quality, and CI/CD practices throughout the delivery lifecycle. Project Delivery & Technical Ownership
 Take end-to-end technical ownership of MuleSoft projects from discovery and estimation through design, build, testing, deployment, hypercare, and transition to BAU. Lead technical workstreams and coordinate developers, testers, infrastructure teams, security teams, application owners, and external vendors. Translate business and functional requirements into implementable technical solutions, delivery plans, estimates, dependencies, and acceptance criteria. Track technical risks, assumptions, dependencies, design decisions, and remediation actions throughout project delivery. Ensure project milestones and technical deliverables are completed to the required quality and within agreed commitments. Provide hands-on support during SIT, UAT, release preparation, production deployment, go-live, and hypercare. Balance architecture responsibilities with active contribution to development and delivery when project demand requires it. API & Architecture Governance
 Establish and enforce API lifecycle management, versioning, cataloguing, reuse, deprecation, and operational governance. Lead architecture reviews, design assurance, technical governance forums, and Architecture Review Board discussions. Define integration security standards covering OAuth 2.0, JWT, TLS, certificates, secrets, service accounts, and access controls. Manage architecture exceptions, technical risks, design deviations, and technology debt with clear remediation plans. Promote standard frameworks, common services, reusable assets, and consistent engineering practices across teams. Technical Leadership & Capability Development
 Act as the senior technical authority and escalation point for MuleSoft architecture, engineering, delivery, and production issues. Mentor architects, technical leads, senior developers, and support engineers through design reviews, pairing, coaching, and technical guidance. Define coding standards, development guardrails, review checklists, and engineering quality expectations. Support recruitment, technical interviews, onboarding, skills assessment, certification planning, and capability development. Build team self-sufficiency while remaining available for complex design, coding, troubleshooting, and delivery challenges. Cloud & Modern Integration Architecture
 Design integrations across cloud, hybrid, and on-premises environments. Apply event-driven, microservices-based, API-centric, batch, real-time, and asynchronous integration patterns as appropriate. Design solutions using enterprise messaging, queues, publish-subscribe patterns, and event-streaming technologies. Architect integrations involving platforms such as Oracle Fusion, Workday, ServiceNow, Salesforce, SAP, Microsoft Azure, AWS, and other enterprise applications. Assess AI-enabled integration and automation opportunities where they provide clear business and operational value. Operational Excellence & Production Support
 Provide senior technical leadership during major incidents, service degradation, recurring problems, and critical production escalations. Lead or support root-cause analysis and identify corrective, preventive, and platform-improvement actions. Improve observability, alerting, error handling, supportability, performance, resilience, and recovery capabilities. Ensure operational readiness through runbooks, monitoring requirements, support models, knowledge transfer, and acceptance criteria. Support platform upgrades, patching, certificate and secret lifecycle activities, capacity planning, and technical debt reduction. Stakeholder, Client & Vendor Engagement
 Engage business stakeholders, enterprise architects, product owners, project managers, client leadership, and service-management teams. Present architecture options, technical decisions, estimates, risks, dependencies, delivery status, and recommendations in clear business language. Act as a trusted advisor while retaining accountability for hands-on technical delivery. Lead workshops, solution walkthroughs, design reviews, project checkpoints, and technical discussions with external vendors and partners. Pre-Sales, Estimation & Financial Governance
 Support proposals, RFPs, solution assessments, due diligence, and transformation opportunities. Provide solution estimates, resource assumptions, delivery approaches, platform sizing, and technical inputs to business cases. Optimise MuleSoft platform utilisation, licensing, infrastructure, and cloud consumption. Balance cost, delivery speed, risk, performance, security, scalability, and maintainability when making architecture decisions. Required Technical Skills
 Strong hands-on expertise in MuleSoft Anypoint Platform, including Anypoint Studio, Design Center, API Manager, Exchange, Runtime Manager, Anypoint Monitoring, CloudHub, and Runtime Fabric. Advanced Mule 4 development and DataWeave 2.x skills. API-led connectivity, API lifecycle management, reusable API design, and integration architecture patterns. REST, SOAP, RAML, OpenAPI, JSON, XML, GraphQL, web services, and enterprise interfaces. Anypoint MQ, enterprise messaging, event-driven architecture, asynchronous processing, and batch integration patterns. Error handling, logging, retries, idempotency, transaction management, security, performance tuning, and production troubleshooting. Core Java, Maven, Git, Postman, MUnit, automated testing, code-quality controls, and CI/CD pipelines. OAuth 2.0, JWT, TLS, SAML, certificates, secrets management, encryption, and API security controls. Monitoring, observability, capacity planning, high availability, disaster recovery, and performance engineering. Azure, AWS, hybrid-cloud, networking, proxies, firewalls, load balancers, and secure connectivity concepts. Enterprise Platform Integration Experience
 Oracle Fusion and other Oracle applications. Workday. ServiceNow. Salesforce. SAP. Microsoft Azure and/or AWS services. Databases, SFTP/file-transfer platforms, SaaS applications, and third-party APIs. Experience Requirements
 15+ years of overall IT experience. 8+ years of enterprise integration, solution architecture, and technical delivery experience. 5+ years of strong hands-on MuleSoft development and architecture experience. Proven experience personally developing MuleSoft solutions while leading architecture and project delivery. Proven experience delivering end-to-end MuleSoft implementation, integration transformation, or modernisation projects. Experience leading distributed technical teams across projects, enhancements, managed services, and production support. Experience managing multiple technical workstreams, estimates, dependencies, risks, and delivery commitments. Strong customer-facing consulting, presentation, and executive stakeholder-management experience. Experience working in global delivery and managed services environments. Preferred Certifications
 MuleSoft Certified Integration Architect. MuleSoft Certified Platform Architect. MuleSoft Certified Developer. TOGAF certification. AWS Solutions Architect or Microsoft Azure Architect certification. ITIL Foundation. Key Competencies
 Hands-on technical depth and willingness to code. Enterprise architecture and practical solution design. End-to-end project ownership and delivery accountability. Architecture governance and solution assurance. Structured problem-solving and complex troubleshooting. Stakeholder management and executive communication. Technical mentoring and capability development. Commercial awareness, estimation, risk management, and prioritisation. Ability to balance strategic architecture with immediate delivery needs. Ideal Candidate Profile
A senior MuleSoft professional who can operate as both an enterprise architect and a hands-on technical delivery leader. The ideal candidate will define integration strategy, design enterprise solutions, write and review MuleSoft code, lead projects through implementation, resolve complex technical issues, mentor engineering teams, engage senior stakeholders, and remain accountable for successful delivery and stable production outcomes.

title: QA/QC Engineer - Civil
description:
Position: QA/QC Engineer - Civil
 Department: Projects
 Location: Project Site, Kerala
 Experience: 5+ Years
 Qualification: B.E./B.Tech in Civil Engineering or Diploma in Civil Engineering
 Employment Type: Full-Time Job Summary We are looking for an experienced QA/QC Engineer (Civil) to ensure that all construction activities comply with approved drawings, project specifications, quality standards, and applicable codes. The candidate will be responsible for implementing quality control procedures, conducting inspections and tests, maintaining quality documentation, and coordinating with project teams, consultants, and clients to ensure the successful execution of projects. Key Responsibilities Implement and monitor the project Quality Assurance and Quality Control (QA/QC) plan. Inspect civil construction activities, including concrete works, reinforcement, formwork, masonry, plastering, waterproofing, and finishing works. Ensure all construction activities are carried out as per approved drawings, specifications, method statements, and applicable IS codes. Conduct inspections at various stages of construction and coordinate with clients and consultants for inspection approvals. Verify the quality of construction materials and ensure testing is conducted as per project requirements. Coordinate concrete sampling, slump tests, cube tests, soil tests, and other required quality tests. Prepare and maintain Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs), checklists, inspection requests, test reports, and quality records. Identify non-conformities, issue Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs), and monitor corrective and preventive actions. Ensure proper implementation of quality procedures at the project site. Review material approvals, technical submittals, and test certificates. Monitor subcontractor activities to ensure compliance with project quality standards. Coordinate with Project Managers, Site Engineers, consultants, and client representatives on quality-related matters. Conduct internal quality audits and ensure timely closure of observations. Prepare and submit daily, weekly, and monthly quality reports. Maintain proper documentation for client inspections, audits, and project handover. Identify recurring quality issues and recommend corrective measures to minimize rework and material wastage. Required Skills and Competencies Strong knowledge of civil construction materials, testing procedures, and quality control practices. Good understanding of IS codes, project specifications, approved drawings, and method statements. Experience in preparing ITPs, inspection checklists, NCRs, and quality reports. Ability to coordinate effectively with clients, consultants, subcontractors, and project teams. Strong analytical, documentation, communication, and problem-solving skills. Proficiency in MS Office and preparation of quality documentation. Ability to work independently at project sites and meet project quality requirements. Preferred Experience Experience in commercial, industrial, infrastructure, or building construction projects. Experience handling client and consultant inspections. Knowledge of concrete technology, construction material testing, and quality auditing. Experience in projects involving strict quality compliance and documentation requirements. Reporting To Project Manager / QA/QC Manager Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Compliance with project quality standards and specifications. Timely completion of inspections and quality documentation. Reduction in construction defects, rework, and material wastage. Timely closure of NCRs and audit observations. Successful completion of client and consultant quality inspections. Accuracy and timely submission of quality reports.

title: AI Risk Engineer Senior Associate 1
description:
About us 
 We are the leading provider of professional services to the middle market globally, our purpose is to instill confidence in a world of change, empowering our clients and people to realize their full potential. Our exceptional people are the key to our unrivaled, inclusive culture and talent experience and our ability to be compelling to our clients. You'll find an environment that inspires and empowers you to thrive both personally and professionally. There's no one like you and that's why there's nowhere like RSM. Position Summary 
 We are seeking a technically strong and analytically minded AI Risk Engineer to join our Technology Risk Consulting team. This role is designed for professionals with a solid academic foundation in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Data Science, Computer Science, or related technical disciplines, combined with hands-on experience supporting AI-enabled products, platforms, or enterprise AI initiatives. The ideal candidate will have demonstrable experience working with global technology organizations or multinational enterprises and will be comfortable collaborating across cross-functional, geographically distributed teams. The role combines technical AI knowledge with risk and advisory thinking to help organizations adopt AI responsibly while managing governance, security, privacy, model performance, compliance, and responsible AI risks. 

 

 Key Responsibilities 
 Perform AI risk, AI governance, responsible AI, and AI assurance assessments across enterprise environments. Evaluate generative AI solutions, machine learning systems, AI agents, AI platforms, and third-party AI services for operational, security, privacy, regulatory, and ethical risks. Assess AI lifecycle processes, including data sourcing, model development, testing, validation, deployment, monitoring, change management, and retirement. Review controls related to bias, fairness, explainability, transparency, accountability, human oversight, model performance, security, and privacy. Analyze AI architectures, workflows, and technical implementations to identify risk exposures and practical mitigation strategies. Support enterprise AI inventory, use-case classification, risk assessment, approval, monitoring, and governance initiatives. Partner with Engineering, Product, Cybersecurity, Legal, Privacy, Compliance, Data, Risk, and business teams to evaluate AI risks and controls. Participate in client workshops and stakeholder interviews, translating technical AI concepts into clear business and risk implications. Prepare client-facing reports, risk assessments, executive summaries, and practical advisory recommendations. Contribute to AI risk methodologies, assessment accelerators, thought leadership, and global engagements delivered through onshore/offshore operating models. 

 

 Required Qualifications 
 Bachelor's or master's degree in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Data Science, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Computational Statistics, Data Analytics, or a closely related technical discipline. 4+ years of experience across AI, machine learning, data science, AI engineering, MLOps, AI platform engineering, Trust & Safety, product risk, technology risk, cybersecurity, model risk management, data governance, or related technology disciplines. Demonstrable experience developing, supporting, evaluating, monitoring, governing, or assessing AI-enabled products, machine learning solutions, or generative AI use cases in production environments. Strong understanding of generative AI, large language models, AI agents, retrieval-augmented generation, model evaluation, AI lifecycle management, and responsible AI principles. Working knowledge of AI risks including bias, fairness, explainability, privacy, security, robustness, model drift, human oversight, and third-party dependencies. Experience working with global firms in cross-functional and geographically distributed teams, including onshore/offshore delivery models. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to technical, business, and executive stakeholders. Demonstrated analytical, problem-solving, consultative, documentation, and stakeholder management skills. 

 

 Preferred Qualifications 
 Experience working for global technology companies, digital-first organizations, cloud providers, hyperscalers, AI product organizations, or large multinational enterprises. Experience supporting AI solutions at scale within production environments. Exposure to Microsoft Copilot, Azure AI, OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Vertex AI, AWS Bedrock, Databricks AI, Hugging Face, or similar enterprise AI technologies. Familiarity with NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, responsible AI frameworks, AI Trust & Safety, AI governance, or AI assurance practices. Experience supporting AI governance programs, AI assurance reviews, AI safety assessments, model evaluations, third-party AI risk reviews, or model risk initiatives. AI or machine learning certification such as AIIA, AIGP, ISO/IEC 42001 Lead Implementer or Auditor, Microsoft Azure AI Engineer Associate, AWS Machine Learning, Google Professional Machine Learning Engineer, or equivalent. Working knowledge of AWS, Azure, or GCP and cloud-native AI services; exposure to cloud governance, IAM, cloud security, DevSecOps, Infrastructure as Code, or cloud resilience is an advantage. Prior experience within a Big 4, leading consulting organization, global technology company, or product engineering environment. 

 

 Success Profile 
 Strong AI and machine learning fundamentals supported by formal education and practical experience. Comfort navigating ambiguity in a rapidly evolving AI and regulatory environment. Ability to apply risk-based judgment and develop practical, business-focused solutions. Confidence working with engineering teams, business stakeholders, and executive audiences.
